abused-as-child-speaking-as-adult.en:
Imagine a 28-year-old in Indore, three months from her wedding. The guest list includes a family friend who sexually abused her when she was nine. She has never said it aloud to anyone. UNICEF estimates that more than 370 million girls and women alive today, about 1 in 8, were raped or sexually assaulted before they turned 18, along with 240 million to 310 million boys and men [[unicef-sexual-violence-children-2024]]. This guide is for the adult who is ready to speak, or is thinking about it.

## Why so many children never tell

India's last national study of child abuse, published by the government in 2007, found that 72.1% of children who had been sexually assaulted had told no one, and only 3.4% had reported it to the police. Among the young adults it interviewed, only 26.8% of those sexually assaulted in childhood had ever told anyone [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]]. The sample was not nationally representative, and no national survey has followed, but the pattern is plain.

So is the reason. In that study, 50% of abusers were people known to the child or in a position of trust and responsibility [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]]. A child depends on those adults, often has no words for what is happening, and is told that speaking will break the family. Staying silent at nine was a way to get through childhood. It does not mean you agreed, and it does not mean it was minor.

## Telling someone now: a partner, family, a friend

You decide who hears this, when, and how much. You do not owe anyone the details, including a partner or a future spouse.

Start with the person most likely to believe you, not the one you feel you ought to tell first. Say what you need before you begin: "I want you to listen. I am not asking you to fix this or confront anyone."

Reactions vary. Some people go quiet, or ask "why didn't you tell us then?", which reflects their shock, not your credibility. When the abuser is a relative, families often close ranks: forget it, think of the family's name, don't spoil the wedding. That response is common, and wrong. A bad first reaction does not make telling a mistake. And nobody should confront the abuser "for you" unless you have agreed to it.

## Therapy, Tele-MANAS and what healing can look like

The World Health Organization says maltreatment in childhood can damage mental and physical health across a lifetime [[who-child-maltreatment]]. In adult life that can look like poor sleep, panic around one person or place, difficulty with trust or sex, or a shame that insists it was your fault. It was not.

Therapy does not erase the memory. A good therapist helps it stop running your days. Look for a clinical psychologist or psychiatrist who works with trauma. At the first session, ask about their experience with childhood sexual abuse, their fees and what stays confidential. If a therapist doubts you, or pushes you to "forgive and move on", find another.

If money or privacy is the barrier, Tele-MANAS on 14416 is the Health Ministry's free, round-the-clock mental-health helpline, launched in October 2022 [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Call it, too, if the memories bring thoughts of ending your life.

Men are often handed a different script: that boys cannot be abused. In the 2007 study, boys were 52.94% of the children who reported sexual abuse [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]].

## The law: the date decides which Act applies

What follows is general information, not legal advice. The Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act came into force on 14 November 2012. It defines a child as anyone under 18 and protects boys and girls alike [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. If the abuse happened on or after that date, POCSO can apply even though you are an adult now. If it happened earlier, police must use the Indian Penal Code as it stood then, which was narrower: its definition of rape was widened only in February 2013 [[indiacode-cla-2013]].

Whether any time limit applies depends on which offence the facts fit under the law of that time, so ask a lawyer about your dates before you assume it is too late. Delay is not proof of lying either: the Supreme Court's 2023 handbook on gender stereotypes rejects that belief, noting that lack of family support or fear of repercussions can make a survivor wait [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

> Delay is not a lie. It does make proof harder.

There is usually no medical evidence, and witnesses have scattered. Only 32.3% of POCSO trials that ended in 2024 produced a conviction [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

So prepare. Write down what you remember, with dates and places, and keep diaries, messages and school or medical records. You can give information at any police station, wherever the offence took place, and the FIR copy is free [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. First, take free advice from your District Legal Services Authority, part of the national legal aid network [[nalsa]].

## If the abuser is still around children

When to take your own case to the police is yours to decide, at your pace. A child at risk today is different. Under Section 19 of POCSO, anyone who knows that a child sexual offence has been committed, or fears that one is likely to be, must tell the Special Juvenile Police Unit or the local police [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]]. Failing to report can mean up to 6 months in prison or a fine [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

So if the person who abused you now tutors children, runs a hostel or lives with young relatives, and you have reason to fear for a child, call the Child Helpline 1098 or go to the police. You need suspicion, not proof. Police may ask how you know; decide beforehand, ideally with a lawyer, what you are ready to say about your own past.

If you are under 18 yourself, a counsellor or doctor cannot promise total secrecy, because the same duty binds them.

The secret was never yours to keep safe. What you do with it now, and how fast, is your decision.
abused-as-child-speaking-as-adult.hg:
Socho, Indore ki ek 28 saal ki ladki hai jiski shaadi teen mahine baad hai. Guest list mein ek family friend ka naam hai, jisne uske saath tab sexual abuse kiya tha jab woh nau saal ki thi. Usne yeh baat aaj tak kisi se nahi kahi. UNICEF ka estimate hai ki aaj zinda 370 million se zyada ladkiyon aur auraton ka, yaani har 8 mein se 1 ka, 18 saal ki hone se pehle rape ya sexual assault hua tha. Ladkon aur mardon mein yeh number 240 million se 310 million ke beech hai [[unicef-sexual-violence-children-2024]]. Yeh guide us adult ke liye hai jo ab bolne ko taiyaar hai, ya bolne ke baare mein soch raha hai.

## Itne saare bachche kabhi batate kyun nahi

Child abuse par India ki aakhri national study sarkar ne 2007 mein publish ki thi. Usmein jin bachchon ka sexual assault hua tha, unmein se 72.1% ne kisi ko nahi bataya tha, aur sirf 3.4% ne police ko report kiya tha. Study mein young adults se bhi baat hui thi: bachpan mein sexual assault jhel chuke young adults mein se sirf 26.8% ne kabhi kisi ko bataya tha [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]]. Sample poore desh ko represent nahi karta tha, aur uske baad koi national survey hua hi nahi, lekin pattern saaf hai.

Wajah bhi saaf hai. Us study mein 50% abusers bachche ke jaan-pehchaan wale the, ya aise log the jin par bharosa aur zimmedaari thi [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]]. Bachcha inhi badon par depend karta hai. Jo ho raha hai, uske liye uske paas aksar words hi nahi hote, aur use kaha jaata hai ki bologe toh ghar toot jayega. Nau saal ki umar mein chup rehna bachpan kaat lene ka ek tareeka tha. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki tum raazi the, aur yeh bhi nahi ki baat chhoti thi.

## Ab kisi ko batana: partner, family, dost

Kaun sunega, kab sunega aur kitna sunega, yeh tum tay karoge. Details dena tumhari koi duty nahi hai, partner ya hone wale pati ya patni ke saamne bhi nahi.

Shuruaat us insaan se karo jo sabse zyada yakeen karega, us se nahi jise "sabse pehle batana chahiye". Baat shuru karne se pehle hi keh do ki tumhe kya chahiye: "Bas meri baat suno. Mujhe yeh nahi chahiye ki tum ise theek karo ya kisi se jaakar bhido."

Reactions alag-alag honge. Kuch log chup ho jaate hain, ya poochte hain "tab kyun nahi bataya?". Yeh sawaal unke shock se aata hai, tumhari sachchai par sawaal nahi hai. Jab abuser rishtedaar ho, toh family aksar ek ho jaati hai: bhool jao, ghar ki izzat ka socho, shaadi kharab mat karo. Yeh reaction common hai, aur galat hai. Pehla reaction bura nikle, toh iska matlab yeh nahi ki batana galti thi. Aur jab tak tum haan na kaho, koi bhi "tumhari taraf se" abuser se bhidne na jaye.

## Therapy, Tele-MANAS, aur healing kaisi dikhti hai

World Health Organization kehta hai ki bachpan mein hua maltreatment poori zindagi mental aur physical health ko nuksaan pahuncha sakta hai [[who-child-maltreatment]]. Bade hone par yeh kai tarah se dikh sakta hai: neend na aana, kisi ek insaan ya jagah ke aas-paas panic, bharosa karne ya sex mein dikkat, ya aisi sharam jo baar-baar kehti hai ki galti tumhari thi. Galti tumhari nahi thi.

Therapy yaad ko mitati nahi. Ek achha therapist itna kar sakta hai ki woh yaad tumhare din na chalaye. Aisa clinical psychologist ya psychiatrist dhoondho jo trauma par kaam karta ho. Pehle session mein hi pooch lo: childhood sexual abuse ke cases ka kitna experience hai, fees kya hai, aur kya-kya confidential rahega. Agar therapist tum par shak kare, ya "maaf karke aage badho" ka pressure daale, toh doosra therapist dhoondho.

Agar paisa ya privacy rukawat hai, toh Tele-MANAS 14416 hai: Health Ministry ki free mental-health helpline, jo din-raat chalti hai aur October 2022 mein launch hui thi [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Agar yaadon ke saath apni jaan lene ke khayal aayein, tab bhi isi par call karo.

Mardon ko aksar ek alag script pakda di jaati hai: ki ladkon ka abuse hota hi nahi. 2007 ki study mein sexual abuse report karne wale bachchon mein 52.94% ladke the [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]].

## Law: kaun-sa Act lagega, yeh date tay karti hai

Aage jo likha hai woh general information hai, legal advice nahi. Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act 14 November 2012 ko laagu hua. Is Act mein 18 se kam umar ka har insaan child hai, aur yeh ladkon aur ladkiyon dono ko barabar protect karta hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Agar abuse us date ko ya uske baad hua, toh POCSO lag sakta hai, chahe aaj tum adult ho. Agar usse pehle hua, toh police ko us waqt ka Indian Penal Code lagana hoga, jiska daayra chhota tha: rape ki definition February 2013 mein jaakar badi hui [[indiacode-cla-2013]].

Koi time limit lagti hai ya nahi, yeh is par depend karta hai ki us waqt ke law mein tumhare saath hua abuse kis offence mein aata hai. Isliye yeh maan lene se pehle ki ab bahut der ho chuki hai, apni dates ke baare mein lawyer se zaroor poocho. Der se bolna jhooth ka saboot bhi nahi hai: Supreme Court ki gender stereotypes wali 2023 ki handbook is soch ko reject karti hai, aur kehti hai ki family ka saath na milna ya anjaam ka darr survivor ko intezaar karwa sakta hai [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

> Der se bolna jhooth nahi hai. Haan, isse saboot jutana mushkil zaroor ho jaata hai.

Aam taur par medical evidence nahi hota, aur gawah idhar-udhar bikhar chuke hote hain. 2024 mein khatam hue POCSO trials mein se sirf 32.3% mein conviction hui [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Isliye taiyaari karo. Jo yaad hai woh date aur jagah ke saath likh lo, aur diary, messages, school ya medical records sambhaal kar rakho. Tum kisi bhi police station mein information de sakte ho, offence chahe kahin bhi hua ho, aur FIR ki copy free milti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Usse pehle apni District Legal Services Authority se free advice lo, jo national legal aid network ka hissa hai [[nalsa]].

## Agar abuser ab bhi bachchon ke aas-paas hai

Apna case police tak kab le jaana hai, yeh tum apni raftaar se tay karoge. Lekin aaj koi bachcha khatre mein ho, toh baat alag hai. POCSO ke Section 19 ke tahat, jise bhi pata ho ki kisi bachche ke saath sexual offence hua hai, ya darr ho ki hone wala hai, use Special Juvenile Police Unit ya local police ko batana hi hoga [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]]. Report na karne par 6 mahine tak ki jail ya fine ho sakta hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

Toh agar jisne tumhara abuse kiya woh ab bachchon ko tuition padhata hai, hostel chalata hai ya ghar ke chhote bachchon ke saath rehta hai, aur tumhe kisi bachche ke liye darr hai, toh Child Helpline 1098 par call karo ya police ke paas jao. Proof nahi, shak kaafi hai. Police pooch sakti hai ki tumhe kaise pata. Isliye pehle se, ho sake toh lawyer ke saath, soch lo ki apne past ke baare mein tum kitna batane ko taiyaar ho.

Agar tum khud 18 se kam ho, toh counsellor ya doctor poori secrecy ka promise nahi kar sakte, kyunki yahi duty un par bhi hai.

Yeh raaz sambhaal kar rakhna kabhi tumhari zimmedaari thi hi nahi. Ab iska kya karna hai, aur kitni jaldi, yeh tumhara faisla hai.

acid-attack-treatment-compensation-steps.en:
India registers about 200 acid attacks a year: 202 in 2022, 207 in 2023 and 207 in 2024, with another 68 attempts in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The trial that follows is slow. Of 804 acid-attack cases involving women before the courts in 2024, trials were completed in 24, and 778 were still pending when the year ended [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

So what a survivor is owed cannot wait for a verdict, and by law it does not have to. This guide is general information, not legal advice.

## The first hour: get to the nearest hospital

- Pour plenty of clean running water over the burn at once and keep it flowing: a long rinse, not a splash. Carefully take off clothing the acid has touched. Do not put on creams, oil or ice.
- Call 112 [[mha-erss]] and go to the nearest hospital, government or private. Do not go to the police station first. The hospital has to inform the police itself [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].
- Someone else should note the time, the place and who saw it.

## Free treatment is the law, and refusing it is a crime

Section 397 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) says every hospital, public or private, must immediately give first aid or medical treatment, free of cost, to the victim of an acid attack [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. The person in charge of a hospital that refuses can be jailed for up to one year under Section 200 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

The law says "victims", not "women". Police registered 207 acid attacks in 2024 across all victims; 118 were recorded as attacks on women [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Men are attacked too, and the same right to free treatment applies to a person of any gender.

Imagine a 22-year-old woman brought to a private hospital in Patna at night. The billing desk asks her brother for a deposit before admission. He can say, calmly, that Section 397 of the BNSS requires immediate free treatment, ask for the person in charge by name, write down the names and the time, and call 112 if they still refuse. He should not move her to save money, and he should keep every bill and prescription.

## The FIR: Section 124 BNS

An acid attack that burns, disfigures or disables is punishable under Section 124(1) of the BNS with at least 10 years in prison and up to life, plus a fine that goes to the victim for treatment. Throwing acid, or trying to, carries 5 to 7 years under Section 124(2) [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

What the family can insist on:

- **Any station, any family member.** Anyone can report at any police station, wherever the attack happened, and the FIR copy is free [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. A relative can do this while the survivor is in hospital.
- **A woman officer.** A woman's complaint of an acid attack must be recorded by a woman officer, and a magistrate must record her statement as soon as police learn of the offence [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].
- **No refusal.** An officer who fails to record an FIR for an acid attack faces six months to two years of rigorous imprisonment under Section 199 of the BNS [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Read the FIR copy and check that Section 124 is on it.

## Money you are owed: Laxmi (2013) and the NALSA scheme

Compensation comes from the state, not the attacker, and it does not wait for the trial. Every state must run a victim compensation scheme, and a victim can apply directly to the State or District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) even if the offender is never traced [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

| Source | Amount | When |
|---|---|---|
| Supreme Court, Laxmi v. Union of India (2013) | At least Rs 3 lakh from the state | Rs 1 lakh within 15 days of the attack, the rest within two months |
| NALSA scheme (2018), face disfigured | Rs 7 lakh to Rs 8 lakh | Rs 1 lakh within 15 days of the case reaching the DLSA, Rs 2 lakh more within two months |
| NALSA scheme, survivor under 18 | Limits 50% higher | Same schedule |
| Fine under Section 124(1) | Set by the court | After conviction, paid to the victim |

The first row is a Supreme Court direction to every state and union territory [[sc-laxmi-2013]]. The next two come from NALSA's 2018 compensation scheme for women, which gives the inquiry into a claim 60 days [[nalsa-compensation-scheme-women-2018]]. It is a model scheme: what is paid depends on state and district authorities. Male and transgender survivors can rely on the Laxmi order, which speaks of "acid attack victims", and on their state's scheme.

The officials to chase:

- **The DLSA Secretary.** Apply in writing in the first week, with the FIR copy, hospital papers, an ID and bank details. Take a dated receipt: the 15 days run from there.
- **The Station House Officer**, for the FIR copy.
- **The hospital's person in charge**, if anyone asks for payment.
- **The State Legal Services Authority**, if the district office stalls.

## The long road: treatment, the trial and support

Treatment after an acid attack can stretch over months or years. The Supreme Court called its Rs 3 lakh an "after care and rehabilitation cost" [[sc-laxmi-2013]]. Set against years of treatment, these sums are a floor to claim, not a measure of what was done.

Meanwhile the criminal case crawls. Of the 24 trials completed in 2024, 13 ended in conviction, and 96.8% of cases were still pending [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Three habits help: one file with every paper and copies kept elsewhere; a free legal aid lawyer from the DLSA to follow both the trial and the claim [[nalsa]]; and every request made in writing, with a date.

If you are a friend or neighbour, do not share photos of the injuries, and do not ask what the survivor did to "provoke" it. The attack was the attacker's decision. For the fear and low days that follow, Tele-MANAS on 14416 is free at any hour [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

The verdict may take years. The treatment, the FIR and the first Rs 1 lakh are owed in days. Count them.
acid-attack-treatment-compensation-steps.hg:
India mein har saal lagbhag 200 acid attacks register hote hain: 2022 mein 202, 2023 mein 207 aur 2024 mein 207, aur 2024 mein 68 attempts alag se [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Iske baad ka trial dheere chalta hai. 2024 mein women se jude 804 acid-attack cases courts ke saamne the; trial sirf 24 mein poora hua, aur saal khatam hone tak 778 pending the [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Isliye survivor ko jo milna hai, woh faisle ka intezaar nahi kar sakta, aur law ke hisaab se use karna bhi nahi padta. Yeh guide general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Pehla ghanta: sabse paas ke hospital pahunchiye

- Burn par turant khoob saara saaf behta paani daaliye aur daalte rahiye: der tak dhona hai, ek chheenta nahi. Jin kapdon par acid laga hai unhe dhyaan se utaariye. Cream, tel ya ice mat lagaiye.
- 112 pe call kijiye [[mha-erss]] aur sabse paas ke hospital jaiye, sarkari ho ya private. Pehle police station mat jaiye. Police ko khabar dena hospital ka kaam hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].
- Koi aur insaan time, jagah aur kisne dekha, yeh sab note kar le.

## Free treatment law hai, aur mana karna crime hai

Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ka Section 397 kehta hai ki har hospital, public ho ya private, acid attack ke victim ko turant first aid ya medical treatment dega, free of cost [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Jo hospital mana kare, uske in-charge ko Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke Section 200 ke under ek saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Law "victims" kehta hai, "women" nahi. Police ne 2024 mein sabhi victims ko milakar 207 acid attacks register kiye; inme 118 women par attacks ke roop mein record hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Men par bhi attack hote hain, aur free treatment ka yahi right har gender ke insaan ko milta hai.

Sochiye, raat ko Patna ke ek private hospital mein 22 saal ki ek woman ko laaya jaata hai. Billing desk uske bhai se admission se pehle deposit maangta hai. Woh shaanti se keh sakta hai ki BNSS ka Section 397 turant aur free treatment zaroori banata hai, in-charge ka naam poochh sakta hai, naam aur time likh sakta hai, aur phir bhi mana ho toh 112 pe call kar sakta hai. Paise bachane ke liye use doosri jagah na le jaaye, aur har bill aur prescription sambhal ke rakhe.

## FIR: BNS ka Section 124

Jo acid attack jalata hai, disfigure ya disable karta hai, us par BNS ke Section 124(1) ke under kam se kam 10 saal aur zyada se zyada life imprisonment ki saza hai, saath mein fine jo ilaaj ke liye victim ko milta hai. Acid phenkne ya phenkne ki koshish par Section 124(2) ke under 5 se 7 saal ki saza hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Family in baaton par ad sakti hai:

- **Koi bhi station, family ka koi bhi member.** Koi bhi insaan kisi bhi police station mein report kar sakta hai, attack kahin bhi hua ho, aur FIR ki copy free hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Survivor hospital mein ho, tab bhi koi relative yeh kar sakta hai.
- **Woman officer.** Woman ki acid attack ki complaint woman officer hi record karegi, aur police ko offence ka pata chalte hi magistrate uska statement record karenge [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].
- **Mana nahi kar sakte.** Jo officer acid attack ki FIR record nahi karta, use BNS ke Section 199 ke under chhe mahine se do saal ki rigorous imprisonment ho sakti hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

FIR ki copy padhiye aur check kijiye ki us par Section 124 likha hai.

## Jo paisa aapka haq hai: Laxmi (2013) aur NALSA scheme

Compensation state deta hai, attacker nahi, aur yeh trial ka intezaar nahi karta. Har state ko victim compensation scheme chalani hoti hai, aur victim seedha State ya District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) mein apply kar sakta hai, chahe offender kabhi pakda na jaaye [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

| Source | Amount | Kab |
|---|---|---|
| Supreme Court, Laxmi v. Union of India (2013) | State se kam se kam Rs 3 lakh | Attack ke 15 din ke andar Rs 1 lakh, baaki do mahine mein |
| NALSA scheme (2018), chehra disfigure hua ho | Rs 7 lakh se Rs 8 lakh | Case DLSA tak pahunchne ke 15 din mein Rs 1 lakh, phir do mahine mein Rs 2 lakh aur |
| NALSA scheme, survivor 18 se kam | Limits 50% zyada | Wahi schedule |
| Section 124(1) ka fine | Court tay karta hai | Conviction ke baad, victim ko milta hai |

Pehli row Supreme Court ka har state aur union territory ko diya gaya direction hai [[sc-laxmi-2013]]. Agli do rows NALSA ki 2018 ki women ke liye compensation scheme se hain, jo claim ki inquiry ke liye 60 din deti hai [[nalsa-compensation-scheme-women-2018]]. Yeh ek model scheme hai: asal mein kitna milta hai, yeh state aur district authorities par depend karta hai. Male aur transgender survivors Laxmi order ka sahaara le sakte hain, jo "acid attack victims" ki baat karta hai, aur apne state ki scheme ka bhi.

Kin officials ke peeche padna hai:

- **DLSA Secretary.** Pehle hafte mein likhit application dijiye, saath mein FIR copy, hospital papers, ID aur bank details. Date wali receipt lijiye: 15 din wahin se gine jaate hain.
- **Station House Officer**, FIR ki copy ke liye.
- **Hospital ka in-charge**, agar koi payment maange.
- **State Legal Services Authority**, agar district office kaam latkaye.

## Lamba raasta: ilaaj, trial aur support

Acid attack ke baad ilaaj mahinon ya saalon tak chal sakta hai. Supreme Court ne apne Rs 3 lakh ko "after care and rehabilitation cost" kaha tha [[sc-laxmi-2013]]. Saalon ke ilaaj ke saamne yeh rakam ek floor hai jise claim karna hai, jo hua uski keemat nahi.

Udhar criminal case rengta rehta hai. 2024 mein jo 24 trials poore hue, unme se 13 mein conviction hui, aur 96.8% cases pending the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Teen aadatein kaam aati hain: ek file jisme har paper ho aur copies kahin aur bhi rakhi hon; DLSA se free legal aid lawyer, jo trial aur claim dono dekhe [[nalsa]]; aur har request likhit mein, date ke saath.

Agar aap dost ya padosi hain, toh choton ki photos share mat kijiye, aur yeh mat poochhiye ki survivor ne aisa kya kiya jisse attacker "provoke" hua. Attack attacker ka faisla tha. Uske baad aane wale dar aur bure dinon ke liye Tele-MANAS 14416 har waqt free hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

Faisle mein saalon lag sakte hain. Ilaaj, FIR aur pehla Rs 1 lakh dinon mein milne chahiye. Din giniye.

after-sexual-assault-first-72-hours.en:
If you were sexually assaulted in the last three days, or someone you love has just told you they were, this page is for you. Three clocks started at that moment: one for the medicine that can stop HIV, one for preventing a pregnancy, one for the evidence. None of them waits for a decision about the police.

Most survivors in India never reach them. In NFHS-5 (2019-21), only 14% of women who had faced physical or sexual violence ever sought help, and 77% never sought help or told anyone [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Those who did seek help went mostly to their own family (61%); only 6% went to the police [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Doctors, who can stop two of the clocks, were approached even more rarely. If you are the family member who was told, you are now the first responder. Here is the order of things.

## Hour 0: a safe place and one person you trust

Get away from the person who did it, and from anyone likely to protect him. In 96.8% of rape cases registered in India in 2024, the accused was someone the survivor knew [[ncrb-cii-2024]], so safe may mean a friend's flat, not home or the hostel. If anyone is in danger, call 112. If the survivor is under 18, the Child Helpline 1098 can also help.

If you are the one who was called, believe them. Do not ask where they were, what they wore or why they did not shout; our guide to that first conversation has the words. The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook on gender stereotypes says there is no "correct" or "appropriate" way for a survivor to behave [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. A calm survivor is not a lying one. Then pack a bag: a change of clothes, a paper bag for the clothes worn during the assault, a charger, and the phone, with nothing deleted.

## The hospital: free care, with or without an FIR

Go to the nearest hospital, government or private. Section 397 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) orders every hospital to give a rape survivor first aid or medical treatment immediately and free of cost [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Treatment does not wait for an FIR or a fee. A hospital in-charge who refuses can be jailed for up to one year under Section 200 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Know two things before you walk in. First, the same Section 397 tells the hospital to inform the police, so a hospital visit can start a police process. Second, the examination for evidence needs the survivor's consent; the law does not make it lawful without that consent [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. You can accept treatment and refuse the evidence exam, or agree to only some parts of it. Our Q&A on the medical exam walks through each step; in 2022 the Supreme Court held that anyone who conducts the two-finger test is guilty of misconduct [[barandbench-two-finger-test-2022]].

## Three clocks: PEP by 72 hours, emergency contraception by day 5, evidence as early as possible

| Clock | Deadline | Ask for |
|---|---|---|
| HIV | Start within 72 hours; 28 days of medicine | "HIV PEP" |
| Pregnancy | Up to 5 days; the sooner, the better | "Emergency contraception" |
| Evidence | As early as possible | "An examination, only with my consent" |

**HIV.** Post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) must start as soon as possible and no later than 72 hours after the assault, and is then taken for 28 days [[who-pep]]. If it is hour 60, still go. Our explainer on PEP covers side effects and follow-up tests.

**Pregnancy.** Emergency contraception works up to 5 days after unprotected sex, and better the sooner it is taken. A copper IUD fitted by a doctor is the most effective option. It is not an abortion, and it gives no protection from infections [[who-ec]]. If a pregnancy does follow, the law lets a survivor of rape end it up to 24 weeks [[gazette-mtp-amendment-rules-2021]].

**Infections.** Many sexually transmitted infections have no symptoms, so ask for tests and treatment, and about the hepatitis B vaccine [[who-sti]].

**Evidence.** It fades with every hour, every wash and every change of clothes. If you can, go before bathing. If you have already showered, go anyway: the medicine does not depend on the evidence. The HIV and evidence clocks run for every survivor, whatever their gender; the pregnancy clock runs for anyone who can become pregnant.

## The FIR: any police station, a woman officer, a free copy

When you are ready, report at any police station in India, whatever area the assault happened in (a Zero FIR), or send the information electronically (an e-FIR) and sign it within 3 days. You are owed a copy of the FIR free of cost [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. A woman's complaint of rape must be recorded by a woman officer. Her statement must be taken at her home or a place she chooses, and can be recorded on video, even on a mobile phone [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Now or later? Waiting does not make a complaint false. The Supreme Court's handbook rejects the belief that a woman who delays reporting is lying, and names lack of family support and fear of consequences as reasons survivors wait [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. But evidence does not wait. The middle path: medical care now, the FIR decision with a clearer head. Because the hospital informs the police, an officer may come to you first; ask for a woman officer. If the survivor is under 18, the timing is not theirs alone to decide: under Sections 19 and 21 of the POCSO Act, anyone who knows of a sexual offence against a child must report it to the police, and failing to report is punishable [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]]. This is general information, not legal advice.

## Days 2 and 3: follow-up, sleep, and a One Stop Centre

If PEP makes you feel unwell, tell the doctor instead of stopping; the full course is 28 days [[who-pep]]. Keep every follow-up appointment.

Not sleeping, not eating, replaying the assault or feeling nothing at all are common after trauma, not signs of weakness. Tele-MANAS, the Health Ministry's free, round-the-clock mental health helpline, answers on 14416 [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

For the rest, find a One Stop Centre, also called Sakhi [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-03]]. In July 2026, 985 were running across India, and since 2015 they had assisted over 15.20 lakh women [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]]. They exist for women facing violence, so ask the hospital for the nearest one and what help it can arrange.

Three days is the medicine's deadline, not justice's. The FIR can come later. The PEP cannot.
after-sexual-assault-first-72-hours.hg:
Agar pichhle teen din mein aapke saath sexual assault hua hai, ya aapke kisi apne ne abhi-abhi aapko yeh bataya hai, toh yeh page aapke liye hai. Usi pal se teen ghadiyan chal rahi hain: ek us dawai ki jo HIV ko rok sakti hai, ek pregnancy rokne ki, aur ek saboot ki. Inmein se koi bhi ghadi police wale faisle ka intezaar nahin karti.

India mein zyadatar survivors in ghadiyon tak pahunchte hi nahin. NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali women mein se sirf 14% ne kabhi help maangi, aur 77% ne na help maangi, na kisi ko bataya [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Jinhone help maangi, unmein se zyadatar (61%) apni hi family ke paas gayin; police tak sirf 6% pahunchin [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Doctor ke paas toh isse bhi kam gayin, jabki do ghadiyan doctor rok sakte hain. Matlab agar aap woh family member hain jise bataya gaya hai, toh first responder ab aap hain. Aage sab kuch order mein hai.

## Hour 0: ek safe jagah aur ek bharose ka insaan

Jisne yeh kiya, usse door ho jaaiye, aur un logon se bhi jo uska saath de sakte hain. 2024 mein India mein darj rape ke 96.8% cases mein accused koi jaan-pehchaan wala tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]], isliye safe jagah ka matlab ghar ya hostel nahin, kisi dost ka flat bhi ho sakta hai. Agar abhi kisi ko khatra hai, toh 112 par call kijiye. Agar survivor 18 saal se kam ka hai, toh Child Helpline 1098 bhi help karegi.

Agar call aapko aaya hai, toh sabse pehle yakeen kijiye. Yeh mat poochhiye ki wahan kyon gaye the, kya pehna tha, ya chillaye kyon nahin; pehli baatcheet mein kya kehna hai, yeh hamari alag guide mein hai. Supreme Court ki 2023 ki handbook saaf kehti hai ki survivor ke behave karne ka koi "sahi" ya "uchit" tareeka nahin hota [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. Shaant dikhne ka matlab jhooth bolna nahin hai. Phir ek bag ready kijiye: badalne ke kapde, hamle ke waqt pehne kapdon ke liye ek paper bag, charger, aur phone. Phone se koi message ya call log delete mat kijiye.

## Hospital: free ilaaj, FIR ho ya na ho

Sabse paas ke hospital jaaiye, sarkari ho ya private. Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ka Section 397 kehta hai ki har hospital ko rape survivor ko turant first aid ya ilaaj dena hoga, aur woh bhi free [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Ilaaj ke liye na FIR chahiye, na fees. Jo hospital in-charge ilaaj se mana kare, use Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke Section 200 ke tehat ek saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Andar jaane se pehle do baatein jaan lijiye. Pehli, isi Section 397 ke hisaab se hospital ko police ko khabar karni hoti hai, yaani hospital jaane se police ki karwai shuru ho sakti hai. Doosri, saboot ke liye hone wala medical exam survivor ki consent se hi ho sakta hai; kanoon bina consent us exam ko sahi nahin maanta [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Aap ilaaj le sakte hain aur saboot wale exam se mana kar sakte hain, ya uske kuch hisson ke liye hi haan keh sakte hain. Medical exam par hamara Q&A har step samjhata hai. Ek baat yaad rakhiye: 2022 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki jo bhi two-finger test karega, woh misconduct ka doshi hoga [[barandbench-two-finger-test-2022]].

## Teen ghadiyan: 72 ghante mein PEP, 5 din mein emergency contraception, saboot jitni jaldi ho sake

| Ghadi | Aakhri time | Kya maangein |
|---|---|---|
| HIV | 72 ghante ke andar shuru; phir 28 din dawai | "HIV PEP" |
| Pregnancy | 5 din tak; jitni jaldi, utna better | "Emergency contraception" |
| Saboot | Jitni jaldi ho sake | "Exam, sirf meri consent se" |

**HIV.** Post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) jitni jaldi ho sake shuru honi chahiye, aur hamle ke 72 ghante ke baad nahin; phir yeh 28 din tak leni hoti hai [[who-pep]]. Agar 60th hour chal raha hai, tab bhi jaaiye. PEP par hamara alag explainer side effects aur baad ke tests ke baare mein batata hai.

**Pregnancy.** Emergency contraception bina protection ke sex ke 5 din baad tak kaam karti hai, aur jitni jaldi li jaye, utna better. Doctor se lagwaya gaya copper IUD sabse effective option hai. Yeh abortion nahin hai, aur isse kisi infection se bachav nahin hota [[who-ec]]. Agar phir bhi pregnancy ho jaye, toh kanoon rape survivor ko 24 hafte tak abortion ki ijaazat deta hai [[gazette-mtp-amendment-rules-2021]].

**Infections.** Sex se failne wale kai infections (STIs) mein koi symptom nahin dikhta, isliye tests aur ilaaj maangiye, aur hepatitis B vaccine ke baare mein bhi poochhiye [[who-sti]].

**Saboot.** Har ghante, har baar nahane aur har baar kapde badalne ke saath saboot mit-te jaate hain. Ho sake toh nahane se pehle jaaiye. Agar naha chuke hain, tab bhi jaaiye: dawai saboot par depend nahin karti. HIV aur saboot wali ghadiyan har survivor ke liye chalti hain, chahe gender kuch bhi ho; pregnancy wali ghadi har us insaan ke liye jo pregnant ho sakta hai.

## FIR: koi bhi police station, woman officer, free copy

Jab aap ready hon, India ke kisi bhi police station mein report kar sakte hain, chahe assault kisi bhi area mein hua ho (Zero FIR). Ya jaankari electronically bhej sakte hain (e-FIR), bas 3 din ke andar us par sign karna hoga. FIR ki copy aapko free milni chahiye [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Agar koi woman rape ki complaint karti hai, toh use woman officer hi record karegi. Uska statement uske ghar par ya uski chuni hui jagah par lena hoga, aur video par, mobile phone se bhi, record kiya ja sakta hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Abhi ya baad mein? Der se complaint karne se complaint jhoothi nahin ho jaati. Supreme Court ki handbook is soch ko galat batati hai ki der se report karne wali woman jhooth bol rahi hai, aur family ka saath na milna aur anjaam ka darr der ki wajah batati hai [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. Lekin saboot intezaar nahin karte. Beech ka raasta: ilaaj abhi, aur FIR ka faisla thoda sambhal kar. Hospital police ko khabar karta hai, isliye ho sakta hai koi officer pehle aapke paas aa jaye; tab woman officer maangiye. Agar survivor 18 saal se kam ka hai, toh yeh faisla sirf uske haath mein nahin rehta: POCSO Act ke Section 19 aur 21 ke hisaab se jis kisi ko bhi kisi bachche ke khilaaf sexual offence ka pata ho, use police ko batana hi hoga, aur na batana saza layak hai [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]]. Yeh general jaankari hai, legal advice nahin.

## Din 2 aur 3: follow-up, neend aur One Stop Centre

Agar PEP se tabiyat kharab lage, toh dawai khud se band mat kijiye, doctor ko bataiye; poora course 28 din ka hai [[who-pep]]. Har follow-up appointment par jaaiye.

Neend na aana, bhookh na lagna, baar-baar wahi sab yaad aana, ya kuch bhi feel na hona, trauma ke baad yeh sab common hai, kamzori ki nishani nahin. Tele-MANAS, Health Ministry ki free mental health helpline, 24 ghante 14416 par baat karti hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

Baaki help ke liye One Stop Centre dhoondhiye, jise Sakhi centre bhi kehte hain [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-03]]. July 2026 mein poore desh mein 985 centres chal rahe the, aur 2015 se ab tak 15.20 lakh se zyada women ki help kar chuke the [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]]. Yeh violence jhel rahi women ke liye bane hain, isliye hospital se sabse paas ka centre poochhiye, aur yeh bhi ki wahan kya help mil sakti hai.

Teen din dawai ki deadline hai, insaaf ki nahin. FIR baad mein bhi ho sakti hai. PEP nahin.

asking-for-pep-emergency-pill-abortion-c.en:
Imagine a 21-year-old in Bhopal. A condom tore on Saturday night. By Sunday evening she has walked past the same chemist three times, because the man at the counter knows her father. She decides to wait and see.

Waiting is the one thing these medicines cannot afford. She is not unusual: in NFHS-5 (2019-21), only 54.4% of young women aged 15-24 knew where to get even a condom, against 87.3% of young men [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Nobody taught her the words. Here they are. This is general information, not medical or legal advice.

## Three clocks: why the first hours matter

| You need | The clock | Where to ask |
|---|---|---|
| HIV PEP | As soon as possible, no later than 72 hours after exposure; then 28 days of medicine | A hospital emergency ward, today |
| Emergency contraceptive pill | Up to 5 days after unprotected sex; the sooner, the better | A chemist or a doctor |
| Abortion pills | Approved only up to nine weeks (63 days) of pregnancy, on a qualified doctor's prescription | A registered doctor, not a counter |

PEP prevents HIV and nothing else [[who-pep]]. The emergency pill delays ovulation; it is not an abortion and gives no protection against infections [[who-ec]]. Abortion pills are approved only inside those nine weeks [[mohfw-cac-guidelines-2023]].

Many Indians already choose the counter over the consulting room: in 2015, an estimated 11.5 million medication abortions took place outside health facilities, and 87% of them used ready-made combipacks [[lancet-gh-abortion-india-2018]]. The state knows this fear: in October 2025 the Health Ministry renamed its Adolescent Friendly Health "Clinics" as "Centres", saying a visit to a "clinic" was "looked upon with suspicion" [[mohfw-afhc-rename-2025]].

## At the chemist: asking for the emergency pill or condoms

Name the product first, in the voice you would use for paracetamol.

- "One emergency contraceptive pill, please."
- "One pack of condoms."

If you cannot say it aloud, show it typed on your phone. A partner of any gender can buy either. If the chemist asks whether you are married, you owe no answer: "Do you have it or not?" If the reply is a lecture, walk to the next shop.

The counter has limits. A chemist cannot judge whether you also need PEP, and if a pregnancy test is already positive, ask for a doctor, not a "kit".

## At the hospital: asking for PEP after an exposure

Go to the emergency (casualty) ward the same day and say: "I had a possible HIV exposure about [number] hours ago. I need to be assessed for PEP."

The doctor needs three facts: when it happened, what kind of exposure it was (a torn condom, a shared needle, an assault) and what you know about the other person's HIV status. Their name, your marriage and who you sleep with are not medical facts. That holds whether you are a woman, a man who has sex with men, a transgender person or a sex worker.

Expect an HIV test first. Under the HIV and AIDS Act, 2017, it needs your informed consent (Section 5), and nobody can be compelled to disclose their HIV status except by a court order (Section 8) [[naco-hiv-aids-act-2017-gazette]]. If the desk has not heard of PEP, ask for the duty doctor and call 1097, NACO's toll-free helpline, which gives confidential counselling round the clock in 16 languages [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

After a sexual assault, say so: "I have been sexually assaulted. I need emergency contraception and PEP." Section 397 of the BNSS obliges every hospital, public or private, to treat a rape survivor immediately and free of cost, and to inform the police [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Know that before you go; the medicine does not depend on what you decide about a case.

For a test rather than an emergency, NACO runs 1,127 Suraksha (STI) Clinics at district hospitals and medical colleges [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. The line: "I had unprotected sex and I want to be tested."

## At a clinic: asking for an abortion, and the signature nobody can demand from an adult

To the gynaecologist: "I am pregnant, about [number] weeks from my last period. I do not want to continue. What are my options for a safe termination?"

Know three rules first. Abortion in India is not on request: it rests on a doctor's opinion, and up to 20 weeks one registered doctor's opinion is enough. Since 2021 the contraceptive-failure ground covers "any woman or her partner", so being unmarried is no reason to turn you away [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]].

Consent: an adult woman's own consent is the only one the law requires. A guardian's written consent is needed only if she is under 18 or mentally ill; the Act asks for no husband's signature [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]]. If the desk says "bring your husband" or "bring your mother", say: "I am over 18. Under the MTP Act, my consent is the one required. Please write your refusal in my file."

Secrecy: a doctor who reveals the name or particulars of a woman whose pregnancy was terminated, to anyone not authorised by law, faces up to one year in prison, a fine, or both [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]].

Under 18, the honest answer is different. A guardian must consent in writing [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]], and because any sexual act with a person under 18 is an offence under POCSO, the doctor must report it to the police [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. No doctor can promise total secrecy. Go anyway. At the first visit, you and your guardian can ask that your name be left out of that report; the Supreme Court has allowed this since September 2022 [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

## If they lecture, refuse or break your confidence

A lecture is not a refusal. Say, "I have heard you. Will you provide this or not?"

A refusal is a reason to move, not to argue. For PEP or the emergency pill, go to the next counter or hospital and call 1097 on the way. For an abortion, ask for the refusal in writing and take it to another registered provider or a government hospital.

If a doctor reveals your abortion to anyone not authorised by law, that is an offence under the MTP Act [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. Write down who told whom, what and when, keep the screenshots, and take them to the police.

The person behind the counter will have forgotten you by dinner. The clock will not. Say the name of the medicine.
asking-for-pep-emergency-pill-abortion-c.hg:
Socho, Bhopal ki ek 21 saal ki ladki. Saturday raat condom phat gaya. Sunday shaam tak woh ek hi chemist ki dukaan ke saamne se teen baar nikal chuki hai, kyunki counter par baitha aadmi uske papa ko jaanta hai. Woh decide karti hai ki ruk kar dekhte hain.

Rukna hi woh ek cheez hai jo in dawaiyon ke saath nahin chalti. Aur woh akeli nahin hai: NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein 15-24 saal ki young women mein se sirf 54.4% ko pata tha ki condom tak kahan milta hai, jabki young men mein 87.3% ko pata tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Use kisi ne shabd sikhaye hi nahin. Woh shabd yahan hain. Yeh general jaankari hai, medical ya legal advice nahin.

## Teen ghadiyan: pehle ghante itne zaroori kyon hain

| Tumhe kya chahiye | Ghadi | Kahan maangna hai |
|---|---|---|
| HIV PEP | Jitni jaldi ho sake, exposure ke 72 ghante ke andar hi; phir 28 din dawai | Hospital ka emergency ward, aaj hi |
| Emergency contraceptive pill | Unprotected sex ke 5 din baad tak; jitni jaldi, utna behtar | Chemist ya doctor |
| Abortion pills | Pregnancy ke sirf nau hafte (63 din) tak approved, woh bhi qualified doctor ke prescription par | Registered doctor, counter nahin |

PEP sirf HIV ko rokta hai, aur kuch nahin [[who-pep]]. Emergency pill ovulation ko delay karti hai; yeh abortion nahin hai aur infections se koi protection nahin deti [[who-ec]]. Abortion pills sirf un nau hafton ke andar approved hain [[mohfw-cac-guidelines-2023]].

Bahut se Indians pehle hi consulting room ki jagah counter chun rahe hain: 2015 mein health facilities ke bahar andaazan 11.5 million medication abortions hue, aur unmein se 87% mein ready-made combipack use hua [[lancet-gh-abortion-india-2018]]. State ko bhi is darr ka pata hai: October 2025 mein Health Ministry ne apne Adolescent Friendly Health "Clinics" ka naam badal kar "Centres" kar diya, yeh kehte hue ki "clinic" jaana "looked upon with suspicion" tha, yaani shaq ki nazar se dekha jaata tha [[mohfw-afhc-rename-2025]].

## Chemist par: emergency pill ya condom kaise maangein

Pehle product ka naam bolo, usi awaaz mein jismein paracetamol maangte ho.

- "Ek emergency contraceptive pill dijiye."
- "Ek pack condom dijiye."

Agar bol nahin pa rahe, toh phone par type karke dikha do. Partner kisi bhi gender ka ho, dono cheezein khareed sakta hai. Chemist pooche ki shaadi hui hai ya nahin, toh jawab dena tumhari duty nahin hai: "Aapke paas hai ya nahin?" Jawab mein lecture mile, toh agli dukaan par chale jao.

Counter ki ek limit hai. Chemist yeh tay nahin kar sakta ki tumhe PEP bhi chahiye ya nahin, aur agar pregnancy test pehle se positive hai, toh "kit" nahin, doctor maango.

## Hospital mein: exposure ke baad PEP kaise maangein

Usi din emergency (casualty) ward jao aur bolo: "Mujhe lagbhag [itne] ghante pehle HIV ka possible exposure hua hai. Mujhe PEP ke liye assess kijiye."

Doctor ko teen baatein chahiye: kab hua, kis tarah ka exposure tha (condom phatna, needle share karna, assault) aur doosre insaan ke HIV status ke baare mein tumhe kya pata hai. Uska naam, tumhari shaadi aur tum kiske saath sote ho, yeh medical facts nahin hain. Yeh baat sab par laagu hai: tum woman ho, aisa aadmi ho jo men ke saath sex karta hai, transgender ho ya sex worker.

Pehle HIV test hoga. HIV and AIDS Act, 2017 ke under yeh test tumhari informed consent ke bina nahin ho sakta (Section 5), aur court ke order ke bina kisi ko apna HIV status batane par majboor nahin kiya ja sakta (Section 8) [[naco-hiv-aids-act-2017-gazette]]. Agar desk par kisi ne PEP ka naam hi nahin suna, toh duty doctor ko bulwao aur 1097 par call karo, jo NACO ki toll-free helpline hai aur 16 languages mein din-raat confidential counselling deti hai [[naco-sankalak-2025]].

Sexual assault hua hai, toh yahi bolo: "Mere saath sexual assault hua hai. Mujhe emergency contraception aur PEP chahiye." BNSS ka Section 397 har hospital par, sarkari ho ya private, yeh duty daalta hai ki woh rape survivor ka turant aur free ilaaj kare, aur police ko inform kare [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Yeh baat jaane se pehle jaan lo; dawai is par depend nahin karti ki tum case ke baare mein kya decide karte ho.

Emergency nahin, sirf test chahiye, toh NACO district hospitals aur medical colleges mein 1,127 Suraksha (STI) Clinics chalata hai [[naco-sankalak-2025]]. Wahan ki line: "Maine unprotected sex kiya hai aur mujhe test karwana hai."

## Clinic mein: abortion kaise maangein, aur woh signature jo adult se koi nahin maang sakta

Gynaecologist se: "Main pregnant hoon, last period se lagbhag [itne] hafte ho gaye hain. Main pregnancy continue nahin karna chahti. Safe termination ke mere options kya hain?"

Pehle teen rules jaan lo. India mein abortion sirf maangne par nahin milta: yeh doctor ki opinion par tika hai, aur 20 hafte tak ek registered doctor ki opinion kaafi hai. 2021 se contraceptive failure wala ground "any woman or her partner" ko cover karta hai, yaani koi bhi woman ya uska partner, isliye unmarried hona tumhe lautane ki wajah nahin ho sakta [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]].

Consent: adult woman ki apni consent hi woh akeli consent hai jo law maangta hai. Guardian ki likhit consent sirf tab chahiye jab woh 18 se kam ho ya mentally ill ho; Act mein pati ka signature kahin nahin maanga gaya [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]]. Agar desk kahe "pati ko lekar aao" ya "mummy ko lekar aao", toh bolo: "Main 18 se upar hoon. MTP Act ke under meri consent hi zaroori hai. Aap mana kar rahe hain toh yeh meri file mein likh dijiye."

Secrecy: jo doctor kisi aisi woman ka naam ya details, jiska pregnancy termination hua hai, kisi aise insaan ko bataye jise law ne authorise nahin kiya, use ek saal tak ki jail, fine, ya dono ho sakte hain [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]].

18 se kam umar ho, toh honest jawab alag hai. Guardian ko likh kar consent deni hogi [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]], aur kyunki 18 se kam umar ke insaan ke saath koi bhi sexual act POCSO ke under offence hai, doctor ko police ko report karna hi padega [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Koi bhi doctor poori secrecy ka promise nahin kar sakta. Phir bhi jao. Pehli visit par hi tum aur tumhare guardian yeh maang sakte ho ki us report mein tumhara naam na likha jaaye; Supreme Court ne September 2022 se iski ijaazat di hai [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

## Agar woh lecture dein, mana karein ya tumhari baat bahar bata dein

Lecture refusal nahin hota. Bolo: "Maine aapki baat sun li. Aap yeh denge ya nahin?"

Refusal aage badhne ki wajah hai, behas karne ki nahin. PEP ya emergency pill ke liye agle counter ya agle hospital jao aur raaste mein 1097 par call karo. Abortion ke liye refusal likh kar maango aur use lekar doosre registered provider ya government hospital jao.

Agar doctor tumhare abortion ki baat kisi aise insaan ko bata de jise law ne authorise nahin kiya, toh yeh MTP Act ke under offence hai [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. Likh lo ki kisne kisko, kya aur kab bataya, screenshots sambhal kar rakho, aur police ke paas le jao.

Counter ke peeche khada insaan tumhe raat ke khaane tak bhool chuka hoga. Ghadi nahin bhoolegi. Dawai ka naam bolo.

bystander-street-harassment-what-to-do.en:
Imagine a crowded morning bus in Lucknow. A man has pushed up against a college student three times. She has shifted twice, and he has followed. Six passengers have noticed. Each is waiting for someone else to say something, and the student can see all six looking away.

This guide is for those six. It asks for no heroics and no fights. It is general information, not legal advice.

## Not 'eve teasing': what the law calls it

The phrase "eve teasing" makes a crime sound like play. In its Handbook on Combating Gender Stereotypes, released on 16 August 2023, the Supreme Court told judges to replace it with "street sexual harassment" [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) treats it as a crime. Sexual harassment carries up to 3 years in prison under Section 75. Stalking carries up to 3 years, and up to 5 on a repeat conviction, under Section 78. Words or gestures meant to insult a woman's modesty carry up to 3 years under Section 79, and assault to outrage her modesty carries 1 to 5 years under Section 74 [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Police data barely registers any of this. In 2024, police across India recorded 459 cases of sexual harassment in public transport, against 525 in 2023 and 422 in 2022. A new category for public places and pathways logged 1,469 cases in the second half of 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Set that beside a 2005 household survey in which 12% of households said unmarried girls in their neighbourhood were "sometimes" or "often" harassed. Police records for that year implied 0.06%, a gap of about 200 times [[aej-iyer-political-voice-2012]]. The comparison is old, but the tiny police counts of 2024 point the same way. What is missing from the data is not harassment. It is people who report it, and people who will say what they saw.

## Safe ways to step in, without heroics

First, read the situation. If he is armed, drunk or with a group, do not confront him; get help.

- **Distract.** Speak to her, not to him. "Is this bus going to Hazratganj?" "Didi, there is a seat here." The aim is to break the moment and give her a way to move.
- **Use your body.** Step into the gap, offer your seat or stand beside her.
- **Bring others in.** Tell the passenger next to you what you are seeing and ask them to move with you. Tell the conductor, the driver, metro staff, a guard or a shopkeeper. A harasser counts on every witness feeling alone.
- **Speak directly only if it is safe.** Short and calm: "Step back. You are troubling her." No abuse, no pushing.
- **Do not start a beating.** A crowd that thrashes a man commits an offence of its own, turns her into a spectacle and can complicate any case against him.

Then ask her: "Are you okay? What would you like me to do?" She may want him reported, or she may only want to reach college on time. Never ask what she was wearing or why she was alone; the same handbook replaces "provocative clothing" with plain "clothing" [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

## Recording: when it helps and when it harms

A video can be evidence. If someone else is already helping her and it is safe, record the harasser's face and what he is doing, and note the route number, the vehicle's registration number, the time and the nearest stop.

- **Helping comes before filming.** A raised phone with nothing else behind it is one more person watching.
- **Film him, not her.** Keep her face out of the frame as far as you can.
- **The video is hers.** Give it to her or to the police, and keep the original file. Do not post it. Once it is online she cannot take back her face, her route or the comments of strangers, and the choice of whether to report is no longer hers.

## Afterwards: checking in and being a witness

When he has got off or been stopped, stay a minute. Tell her it was not okay and it was not her fault. Offer to wait with her, walk her to her stop or call someone she trusts.

Then make the offer that is rarest: "If you report this, I will say what I saw." Give her your name and number. The same day, write down the date, time, route, vehicle number and a description of the man.

Know what that involves. In 2024, courts convicted in 41.9% of the sexual harassment trials they completed and in 15.4% of trials for insulting a woman's modesty, and more than nine in ten such cases were still pending at the end of the year [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. A witness may be called long after the day itself. An independent witness is also one of the few things that makes her account harder to wave away.

If she does not want to report, respect that. Your note costs nothing to keep.

## Calling for help: 112 and the police

Call 112, the emergency number, if he touches her, follows her off the bus, will not stop or is with others, or if she asks you to [[mha-erss]]. Give the route number, the vehicle number, the direction of travel and the next stop.

If she decides to report, Section 173 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) lets her do it at any police station, wherever the offence happened, which matters on a bus that crosses several station limits. Her complaint of sexual harassment or stalking must be recorded by a woman police officer or woman officer [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Sections 75 and 78 are worded so that only a man can commit them [[indiacode-bns-2023]], and the law's cover for adult men and transgender people harassed in public is thinner. Your help should not be. And if the person being harassed is a child, reporting is a legal duty for anyone who knows [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]: call the Child Helpline, 1098, which is linked to 112 [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].

A harasser on a crowded bus is betting that forty people will behave like none. It takes one of them to prove him wrong, and usually not much: a question, a seat, a phone call.
bystander-street-harassment-what-to-do.hg:
Sochiye, Lucknow ki ek subah ki bhari hui bus hai. Ek aadmi teen baar ek college student se sat ke khada ho chuka hai. Woh do baar khisak chuki hai, aur woh peechhe-peechhe aa gaya hai. Chhe passengers ne yeh dekha hai. Har koi intezaar kar raha hai ki koi aur kuch bole, aur student un chheon ko nazrein pherte hue dekh sakti hai.

Yeh guide un chhe logon ke liye hai. Isme na hero banna hai, na ladai karni hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## 'Eve teasing' nahi: law ise kya kehta hai

"Eve teasing" bolne se ek crime khel jaisa lagne lagta hai. 16 August 2023 ko release hui apni Handbook on Combating Gender Stereotypes mein Supreme Court ne judges se kaha ki iski jagah "street sexual harassment" likhein [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ise crime maanta hai. Sexual harassment pe Section 75 ke under 3 saal tak ki jail hai. Stalking pe Section 78 ke under 3 saal tak, aur dobara conviction pe 5 saal tak. Kisi woman ki modesty ka apmaan karne wale shabdon ya ishaaron pe Section 79 ke under 3 saal tak, aur uski modesty outrage karne ke liye assault pe Section 74 ke under 1 se 5 saal ki saza hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Police data mein yeh sab mushkil se dikhta hai. 2024 mein poore India ki police ne public transport mein sexual harassment ke 459 cases record kiye, jabki 2023 mein 525 aur 2022 mein 422 the. Public places aur pathways ki ek nayi category mein 2024 ke doosre half mein 1,469 cases darj hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Ab ise 2005 ke ek household survey ke saath rakh ke dekhiye, jisme 12% households ne kaha ki unke mohalle mein unmarried ladkiyon ko "sometimes" ya "often" harass kiya jaata hai. Us saal ke police records ke hisaab se yeh 0.06% banta tha, yaani lagbhag 200 guna ka gap [[aej-iyer-political-voice-2012]]. Yeh comparison puraana hai, par 2024 ke chhote-chhote police counts bhi usi taraf ishaara karte hain. Data se harassment gaayab nahi hai. Gaayab woh log hain jo report karein, aur woh jo bataayein ki unhone kya dekha.

## Beech mein aane ke safe tareeke, bina hero bane

Sabse pehle situation ko samjhiye. Agar uske paas hathiyaar hai, woh nashe mein hai ya group ke saath hai, toh usse mat bhidiye; help bulaiye.

- **Dhyaan bhatkaiye.** Usse baat kijiye, us aadmi se nahi. "Yeh bus Hazratganj jaayegi?" "Didi, yahan seat khaali hai." Maksad us pal ko todna aur use hatne ka raasta dena hai.
- **Apni jagah ka use kijiye.** Beech ki jagah mein aa jaaiye, apni seat offer kijiye ya uske bagal mein khade ho jaaiye.
- **Doosron ko saath lijiye.** Bagal wale passenger ko bataiye ki aap kya dekh rahe hain aur use apne saath aane ko kahiye. Conductor, driver, metro staff, guard ya dukaandaar ko bataiye. Harasser isi bharose pe hota hai ki har gawah khud ko akela samjhega.
- **Seedhe tabhi boliye jab safe ho.** Chhota aur shaant: "Peechhe hatiye. Aap inhe pareshaan kar rahe hain." Na gaali, na dhakka.
- **Pitaai shuru mat kijiye.** Jo bheed kisi aadmi ko peetti hai, woh khud ek offence karti hai, us ladki ko tamaasha bana deti hai aur us aadmi ke khilaaf case ko uljha sakti hai.

Phir usse poochhiye: "Aap theek ho? Aap kya chahti ho ki main karun?" Ho sakta hai woh chahe ki uski report ho, ya bas itna ki woh time pe college pahunch jaaye. Yeh kabhi mat poochhiye ki usne kya pehna tha ya woh akeli kyun thi; wahi handbook "provocative clothing" ki jagah seedha "clothing" likhne ko kehti hai [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

## Recording: kab madad karti hai aur kab nuksaan

Video saboot ban sakta hai. Agar koi aur pehle se uski madad kar raha hai aur safe hai, toh harasser ka chehra aur woh jo kar raha hai, record kijiye, aur route number, vehicle ka registration number, time aur sabse paas ka stop note kar lijiye.

- **Pehle madad, phir filming.** Uthaya hua phone, jiske peechhe aur kuch nahi, bas ek aur tamaashbeen hai.
- **Use nahi, us aadmi ko film kijiye.** Jahan tak ho sake, uska chehra frame se bahar rakhiye.
- **Video uska hai.** Use ya police ko dijiye, aur original file sambhaal ke rakhiye. Post mat kijiye. Ek baar online jaane ke baad woh apna chehra, apna route ya anjaan logon ke comments wapas nahi le sakti, aur report karni hai ya nahi, yeh faisla phir uske haath mein nahi rehta.

## Baad mein: haal poochhna aur gawah banna

Jab woh aadmi utar jaaye ya rok diya jaaye, toh ek minute rukiye. Use bataiye ki jo hua woh theek nahi tha aur isme uski koi galti nahi thi. Uske saath rukne, uske stop tak chalne ya uske kisi bharose wale ko call karne ki offer kijiye.

Phir woh offer kijiye jo sabse kam log karte hain: "Agar aap iski report karengi, toh maine jo dekha, uski gawahi main dunga ya dungi." Use apna naam aur number dijiye. Usi din date, time, route, vehicle number aur us aadmi ka huliya likh lijiye.

Yeh jaan lijiye ki iska matlab kya hai. 2024 mein courts ne jitne sexual harassment trials poore kiye, unme se 41.9% mein conviction hui, aur woman ki modesty ke apmaan ke trials mein 15.4% mein, aur saal ke end mein aise das mein se nau se zyada cases abhi bhi pending the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Gawah ko us din ke kaafi baad bulaya ja sakta hai. Par ek independent gawah un gini-chuni cheezon mein se bhi hai jinki wajah se uski baat ko taal dena mushkil ho jaata hai.

Agar woh report nahi karna chahti, toh uska faisla maaniye. Apna note rakhe rehne mein aapka kuch nahi jaata.

## Help bulana: 112 aur police

Agar woh use chhue, bus se utar ke uska peechha kare, ruke nahi ya doosron ke saath ho, ya agar woh khud aapse kahe, toh 112 pe call kijiye, jo emergency number hai [[mha-erss]]. Route number, vehicle number, bus kis taraf ja rahi hai aur agla stop bataiye.

Agar woh report karne ka faisla kare, toh Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ka Section 173 use kisi bhi police station mein report karne deta hai, chahe offence kahin bhi hua ho, aur yeh us bus mein kaam aata hai jo kai thaanon ki hadd se guzarti hai. Sexual harassment ya stalking ki uski complaint ek woman police officer ya woman officer ko hi record karni hoti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Sections 75 aur 78 aise likhe gaye hain ki yeh offences sirf koi aadmi hi kar sakta hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]], aur public mein harass hone wale adult mardon aur transgender logon ke liye law ka cover kamzor hai. Aapki madad kamzor nahi honi chahiye. Aur agar harass hone wala ek bachcha hai, toh report karna har us insaan ki legal duty hai jise pata hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]: Child Helpline 1098 pe call kijiye, jo 112 se judi hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].

Bhari bus mein harasser is baat pe daav lagata hai ki chaalis log aise behave karenge jaise wahan koi hai hi nahi. Use galat saabit karne ke liye un mein se ek hi kaafi hai, aur aksar zyada kuch nahi chahiye hota: ek sawaal, ek seat, ek phone call.

check-fir-sections-downgraded-complaint.en:
Consider a 22-year-old in Nagpur who tells the duty officer that her landlord's son raped her. At home her cousin reads the top of the copy: Sections 74 and 115(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). Assault to outrage modesty, and hurt. The word she used at the station is not on the page.

That box sets the ceiling for the case. Rape under Section 64 carries a minimum of 10 years; Section 74 carries 1 to 5; sexual harassment under Section 75 up to 3; voluntarily causing hurt at most 1 year [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. This is general information, not legal advice.

## Your free FIR copy: what is on it

Section 173 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) says the victim must get a copy of the FIR free of cost [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Read three things before you sign:

- **The narrative.** Your account: what was done, by whom, where, when, any threat, your age and how you know the accused. If there was penetration of any kind, it must say so; police pick sections from these lines.
- **The 'Acts and Sections' box.** Note every number.
- **The dates and times** of the incident and of your report.

A woman's complaint of rape, sexual harassment, stalking or voyeurism must be recorded by a woman officer [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Ask for the text to be read back to you before you sign.

## Which section fits what happened: Sections 63 to 79 BNS in plain words

| What happened | Section | Punishment |
|---|---|---|
| Penetration of any kind, or oral sexual contact, without consent (as Section 63 defines it) | 63, 64 | At least 10 years, up to life |
| Rape of a girl under 16 | 65 | At least 20 years |
| Rape by a group | 70 | At least 20 years |
| Sex obtained by deceit or a false promise of marriage | 69 | Up to 10 years |
| Assault to outrage modesty | 74 | 1 to 5 years |
| Sexual harassment | 75 | Up to 3 years (1 year for sexually coloured remarks) |

Disrobing (76), voyeurism (77), stalking (78) and insulting words or gestures (79) have their own sections [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Three checks catch most errors. If your account includes any penetration or oral contact and the box shows only 74 or 75, the section is wrong [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. If it was rape and the accused is a relative, guardian, teacher, police officer or hospital staff, it is aggravated rape, carrying 10 years to the rest of his natural life [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. If the survivor is under 18, boy or girl, POCSO sections must appear too; penetrative sexual assault on a child carries at least 10 years [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

The BNS has no rape offence for an adult man or a transgender person; police can register only general offences such as hurt, which carries up to 1 year, a fine of up to Rs 10,000, or both [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. The Transgender Persons Act punishes sexual abuse with 6 months to 2 years [[indiacode-transgender-persons-2019]]. For them a weak section may be the only one on offer: the law's failure, not theirs.

## Why the section changes everything: punishment and deadlines

- **The clock.** Police must finish investigating rape (Sections 64 to 68, 70 and 71) and POCSO Sections 4, 6, 8 and 10 within two months [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Sections 69, 74 and 75 are not on that list.
- **The start.** For offences punishable with three to under seven years, a window Section 74 can fall into, police may, with a Deputy Superintendent's permission, hold a preliminary enquiry of up to 14 days before registering a case. Rape, with its 10-year minimum, falls outside that window [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].
- **The proof.** In aggravated rape under Section 64(2), once intercourse is proved and the woman testifies that she did not consent, the court must presume she did not [[indiacode-bsa-2023]]. Leave out the fact that he was her teacher, and that presumption is gone.

## If it is wrong: asking for corrections and a further statement

At the desk, do not sign a narrative that is not yours; ask for the missing words to be added. The sections typed on the first day are not the last word: the case still has to pass through the investigation, the chargesheet and the charges a court frames. A written request now puts the right section on record while the investigation is open. So:

1. **Apply in writing** to the station in-charge and the investigating officer: "FIR number __ records Sections __. The facts I reported disclose an offence under Section __. Please add it and record my further statement." Keep a stamped receiving copy.
2. **Give a further statement.** In a rape case it is taken at your home or a place you choose, as far as practicable by a woman officer, and may be video-recorded [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].
3. **Use the magistrate's statement.** In rape, sexual harassment and stalking cases a magistrate, as far as practicable a woman, must record your statement [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Say everything there.
4. **Escalate.** If the officer refuses, write to the Superintendent of Police, and ask a lawyer about approaching the magistrate. A public servant who fails to record information about rape or a sexual assault under Section 74 commits a crime under Section 199 BNS, with 6 months to 2 years' rigorous imprisonment [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. The District Legal Services Authority gives free legal aid [[nalsa]].

You are owed a progress update within 90 days [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Use it to ask which sections the chargesheet will carry.

## When charges are reduced later in court

Sections can also shrink later: in the chargesheet, when the trial court frames charges, or on revision by a higher court.

Acting on its own motion over a High Court order that had reduced the charges in a child sexual assault case from attempt to rape to lesser offences, a Supreme Court bench led by Chief Justice Surya Kant said on 10 February 2026 that efforts to sensitise judges "have not borne the fruit that was expected". It asked a National Judicial Academy expert committee to draft guidelines on sensitivity in sexual-offence cases [[sc-judgments-and-gender-2026]].

If it happens in your case and you have a lawyer, you get free copies of the police report and statements within 14 days of the accused's first appearance, and no court may allow a prosecution to be withdrawn without hearing you [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. A lawyer, including a free legal-aid lawyer, can tell you whether and how an order that reduces the charge can be challenged.

Read the copy tonight. A wrong section is easiest to fix early, harder at the chargesheet, and hardest after the court has framed the charge.
check-fir-sections-downgraded-complaint.hg:
Socho, Nagpur ki ek 22 saal ki ladki duty officer ko batati hai ki uske landlord ke bete ne uska rape kiya. Ghar par uski cousin copy ka upar wala hissa padhti hai: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke Sections 74 aur 115(2). Yaani modesty outrage karne ke liye assault, aur hurt. Station mein usne jo shabd bola tha, woh page par hai hi nahin.

Wahi box case ki ceiling tay karta hai. Section 64 ke under rape ki saza minimum 10 saal hai; Section 74 mein 1 se 5 saal; Section 75 ke sexual harassment mein 3 saal tak; aur voluntarily causing hurt mein zyada se zyada 1 saal [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Yeh general jaankari hai, legal advice nahin.

## Tumhari free FIR copy: us par kya-kya hota hai

Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ka Section 173 kehta hai ki victim ko FIR ki copy free of cost milni chahiye [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Sign karne se pehle teen cheezein padho:

- **Narrative.** Yeh tumhara bayaan hona chahiye: kya kiya gaya, kisne kiya, kahan, kab, koi dhamki, tumhari umar aur tum accused ko kaise jaanti ho. Agar kisi bhi tarah ka penetration hua tha, toh yeh likha hona chahiye; police inhi lines se sections chunti hai.
- **'Acts and Sections' wala box.** Har number note karo.
- **Dates aur times:** incident ke bhi, aur tumhari report ke bhi.

Rape, sexual harassment, stalking ya voyeurism ki complaint agar woman kar rahi hai, toh use woman officer hi record karegi [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Sign karne se pehle bolo ki likha hua tumhe padh kar sunaya jaaye.

## Jo hua us par kaunsa section lagta hai: Sections 63 se 79 BNS, seedhe shabdon mein

| Kya hua | Section | Saza |
|---|---|---|
| Bina consent ke kisi bhi tarah ka penetration ya oral sexual contact (jaisa Section 63 define karta hai) | 63, 64 | Kam se kam 10 saal, life tak |
| 16 se kam umar ki ladki ka rape | 65 | Kam se kam 20 saal |
| Group dwara rape | 70 | Kam se kam 20 saal |
| Dhokhe se ya shaadi ke jhoothe promise par sex | 69 | 10 saal tak |
| Modesty outrage karne ke liye assault | 74 | 1 se 5 saal |
| Sexual harassment | 75 | 3 saal tak (sexually coloured remarks par 1 saal tak) |

Disrobing (76), voyeurism (77), stalking (78) aur modesty ko insult karne wale words ya gestures (79) ke apne alag sections hain [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Teen checks zyada tar galtiyan pakad lete hain. Agar tumhare bayaan mein kisi bhi tarah ka penetration ya oral contact hai aur box mein sirf 74 ya 75 likha hai, toh section galat hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Agar rape hua hai aur accused relative, guardian, teacher, police officer ya hospital staff hai, toh yeh aggravated rape hai, jiski saza 10 saal se lekar uski baaki natural life tak hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Agar survivor 18 se kam ka hai, ladka ho ya ladki, toh POCSO ke sections bhi likhe hone chahiye; bachche par penetrative sexual assault ki saza kam se kam 10 saal hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

BNS mein adult aadmi ya transgender insaan ke rape ka koi offence nahin hai; police sirf hurt jaise general offences darj kar sakti hai, jismein zyada se zyada 1 saal ki jail, Rs 10,000 tak ka fine, ya dono hain [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Transgender Persons Act sexual abuse par 6 mahine se 2 saal ki saza deta hai [[indiacode-transgender-persons-2019]]. Inke liye ho sakta hai kamzor section hi akela option ho: yeh law ki naakaami hai, unki nahin.

## Section se sab kuch kyon badal jaata hai: saza aur deadlines

- **Ghadi.** Police ko rape (Sections 64 se 68, 70 aur 71) aur POCSO ke Sections 4, 6, 8 aur 10 ki investigation 2 mahine mein poori karni hoti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Sections 69, 74 aur 75 is list mein nahin hain.
- **Shuruaat.** Jin offences mein 3 saal ya usse zyada lekin 7 saal se kam ki saza hai, aur Section 74 is window mein aa sakta hai, unmein police Deputy Superintendent ki permission se case darj karne se pehle 14 din tak preliminary enquiry kar sakti hai. Rape, jiski minimum saza 10 saal hai, is window ke bahar hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].
- **Saboot.** Section 64(2) wale aggravated rape mein, jab intercourse prove ho jaaye aur woman court mein gawahi de ki usne consent nahin diya tha, toh court ko yahi maan kar chalna hota hai ki consent nahin tha [[indiacode-bsa-2023]]. FIR mein yeh baat chhoot jaaye ki woh uska teacher tha, toh yeh presumption bhi chala jaata hai.

## Agar section galat hai: correction aur further statement kaise maangein

Desk par hi, us narrative par sign mat karo jo tumhara nahin hai; chhooti hui baatein judwane ko kaho. Pehle din likhe gaye sections aakhri faisla nahin hote: case ko abhi investigation, chargesheet aur court ke frame kiye charges se guzarna hai. Abhi di gayi likhit application investigation khuli rehte hue sahi section ko record par le aati hai. Isliye:

1. **Likh kar application do** station in-charge aur investigating officer ko: "FIR number __ mein Sections __ likhe hain. Maine jo facts bataye the, unse Section __ ka offence banta hai. Kripya ise jodiye aur mera further statement record kijiye." Stamp lagi receiving copy apne paas rakho.
2. **Further statement do.** Rape case mein yeh tumhare ghar par ya tumhari pasand ki jagah par liya jaata hai, jahan tak ho sake woman officer dwara, aur iski video recording bhi ho sakti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].
3. **Magistrate wale statement ka use karo.** Rape, sexual harassment aur stalking ke cases mein magistrate ko, jahan tak ho sake woman magistrate ko, tumhara statement record karna hota hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Wahan sab kuch bolo.
4. **Upar tak jao.** Agar officer mana kare, toh Superintendent of Police ko likho, aur magistrate ke paas jaane ke baare mein kisi lawyer se poochho. Jo public servant rape ya Section 74 wale sexual assault ki information record nahin karta, woh Section 199 BNS ke under crime karta hai, jiski saza 6 mahine se 2 saal ki rigorous imprisonment hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. District Legal Services Authority free legal aid deti hai [[nalsa]].

Tumhe 90 din ke andar investigation ka progress update milne ka haq hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Usi mauke par poochho ki chargesheet mein kaunse sections honge.

## Jab charges baad mein court mein kam kar diye jaayein

Sections baad mein bhi ghat sakte hain: chargesheet mein, jab trial court charges frame karta hai, ya jab upar ka court revision mein unhe badal de.

Ek High Court ke order ne child sexual assault ke ek case mein charges ko attempt to rape se ghata kar lesser offences kar diya tha. Supreme Court ne is par khud (suo motu) case liya, aur 10 February 2026 ko Chief Justice Surya Kant ki bench ne kaha ki judges ko sensitise karne ki koshishein "have not borne the fruit that was expected", yaani unka woh nateeja nahin nikla jiski ummeed thi. Bench ne National Judicial Academy ki expert committee se sexual-offence cases mein sensitivity par guidelines banane ko kaha [[sc-judgments-and-gender-2026]].

Agar tumhare case mein aisa ho aur tumhare paas lawyer hai, toh accused ki pehli peshi ke 14 din ke andar tumhe police report aur statements ki free copies milti hain, aur koi bhi court tumhe sune bina prosecution wapas lene ki ijazat nahin de sakta [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Lawyer, free legal-aid lawyer bhi, tumhe bata sakta hai ki charge kam karne wale order ko challenge kiya ja sakta hai ya nahin, aur kaise.

Copy aaj raat hi padho. Galat section ko jaldi theek karwana sabse aasaan hai, chargesheet ke time mushkil, aur court ke charge frame kar dene ke baad sabse mushkil.

domestic-violence-safety-plan.en:
One in four ever-married women in India who faced physical or sexual violence from a husband was injured by it: 25% in NFHS-5 (2019-21). In the same group, 6% had deep wounds, broken bones or broken teeth, and 3% had severe burns [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Of women who faced physical or sexual violence, 77.2% never sought help or told anyone [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

A safety plan is a set of decisions made in a calm hour, so that in a bad one you do not have to think. It is not a promise to leave, and it does not make his violence your job to prevent.

## Why a plan, and when to make it

The person living with violence usually knows its signs: a certain tone, a silence, the nights he drinks, the week the money runs out. A plan uses that knowledge.

Make it now, on an ordinary day, and start with one person. Only 14.1% of women who faced physical or sexual violence ever sought help.
