The committee can extend this by up to three more months, but only if it records in writing that circumstances kept her from complaining in time [[gazette-posh-act-2013]].

After that, the clocks bind the employer's side: 90 days to complete the inquiry, 10 days to send the report to the employer and 60 days for the employer to act on it. An appeal must be filed within 90 days [[gazette-posh-act-2013]]. These limits apply to the committee process only; a police complaint is a separate route.

## When the clock runs out: what a missed deadline means

Usually, nothing happens by itself. The BNSS sets no consequence for police who miss the two-month investigation limit, and none for courts that miss the trial and appeal limits [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

The backlog shows how often that happens. On 31 December 2025, about 2,45,579 rape and POCSO cases were pending before India's Fast Track Special Courts, which disposed of far fewer cases that year than were registered with them [[pib-ftsc-rajya-sabha-2026-07]]. A two-month trial is what the law promises. The backlog is what the courts deliver.

> A deadline with no penalty is still a date you can put in writing.

Penalties sit at only a few points: a police officer who fails to record an FIR for rape faces six months to two years in prison under Section 199 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Everywhere else, a clock works only when someone points to it.

- **Put it in writing.** Name the section, the date the clock started and the date it ran out. Send it to the investigating officer and the Superintendent of Police, and keep a copy. A free legal aid lawyer can advise you on the next step [[nalsa]].
- **Escalate a takedown.** If an image is still up after two hours, report it on cybercrime.gov.in or by calling 1930 [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]].

Write down four dates: your complaint, the FIR, the medical examination and the chargesheet. Every clock here starts from one of them, and nobody else will keep count for you.
legal-deadlines-every-survivor-should-kn.hg:
Police station mein koi aapke haath mein deadlines ki list nahi thamata. Phir bhi Indian law inse bhara pada hai: platform ke liye ghante, doctor ke liye din, police aur courts ke liye mahine. Sexual violence ke zyada tar survivors yeh numbers kabhi sunte hi nahi, aur jis deadline ke baare mein aapne suna hi nahi, uska aap istemaal bhi nahi kar sakte.

Yeh wahi list hai, har number ke peeche ke section aur us office ke saath jis pe woh laagu hota hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi. In mein se zyada tar ghadiyon ke khatam hone pe koi automatic penalty nahi lagti, par jis letter mein section aur date likhi ho, use ignore karna us letter se mushkil hota hai jisme bas "please kuch kijiye" likha ho.

## Ghante: do ghante ka takedown aur 24 ghante ka exam

**2 ghante.** 20 February 2026 se, platform ko kisi insaan ki nude, sexual ya morphed images us insaan ki complaint ke do ghante ke andar hataani hoti hain. Isse pehle uske paas 24 ghante the [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]]. Yeh ghadi platform pe laagu hoti hai aur aapki complaint se shuru hoti hai, isliye sabse pehle app ya site ke andar report kijiye aur complaint number aur time save kar lijiye.

**24 ghante.** Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ke Section 184 ke under, police ko offence ki information milne ke 24 ghante ke andar rape survivor ko medical examination ke liye bhejna hota hai, aur sirf uski consent se [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Yeh ghadi police pe laagu hoti hai, aur tab shuru hoti hai jab unhe bataya jaata hai, tab nahi jab offence hua tha.

Saath mein do medical ghadiyaan bhi chalti hain. HIV post-exposure medicine exposure ke 72 ghante ke andar shuru ho jaani chahiye, usse der nahi [[who-pep]], aur emergency contraception 5 din tak li ja sakti hai, jitni jaldi utna behtar [[who-ec]]. Jo hospital rape survivor ko free treatment dene se mana kare, uske in-charge ko ek saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

## Din: e-FIR sign karne ke 3, medical report ke 7, aapke documents ke 14

**3 din.** BNSS ka Section 173 aapko kisi bhi police station pe report karne deta hai, chahe uska area koi bhi ho (Zero FIR), ya electronic communication se (e-FIR). e-FIR record pe tabhi li jaati hai jab aap use 3 din ke andar sign kar dein [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Yeh ghadi survivor ke liye nahi, uske khilaaf chalti hai. Yahi section aapko FIR ki free copy bhi deta hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

**7 din.** Rape survivor ko examine karne wale doctor ko report 7 din ke andar investigating officer ko bhejni hoti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

**14 din.** Jis victim ke paas lawyer hai, use accused ke court mein pehli baar pesh hone ke 14 din ke andar police report, FIR aur statements ki free copies milne ka haq hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Lawyer ke bina yeh haq laagu nahi hota, aur yeh ek wajah hai ki District Legal Services Authority se free legal aid jaldi maang li jaaye [[nalsa]].

## Mahine: investigation ke 2, trial ke 2, appeal sunne ke 6

| Ghadi | Kis pe laagu | Kahan likha hai |
|---|---|---|
| Rape ki investigation poori karne ke 2 mahine | Police | Section 193(2) BNSS |
| Victim ko update dene ke 90 din | Police | Section 193(3) BNSS |
| Chargesheet ke baad rape trial poora karne ke 2 mahine | Trial court | Section 346 BNSS |
| Rape ki saza ke khilaaf appeal pe faisla karne ke 6 mahine | Appeal court | Section 415(4) BNSS |
| Bachche ka evidence record karne ke 30 din | POCSO Special Court | Section 35, POCSO Act |
| Compensation claim pe faisla karne ke 2 mahine | Legal Services Authority | Section 396 BNSS |

Investigation ki ghadi us din se chalti hai jis din police information record karti hai, aur yeh POCSO ke under bachchon pe penetrative aur doosre sexual assault ko bhi cover karti hai. 90 din wala update kisi bhi tareeke se aa sakta hai, electronic communication se bhi [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Bachchon ke cases mein 30 din us din se gine jaate hain jis din Special Court cognisance leta hai, aur trial ek saal ke andar poora hona chahiye, "as far as possible", yaani jahan tak ho sake [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

Compensation woh ek ghadi hai jo survivor khud shuru kar sakti hai. Woh seedha State ya District Legal Services Authority ko apply kar sakti hai, chahe offender kabhi pakda na jaaye aur koi trial na ho [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

## Kaam ki jagah: complaint ke 3 mahine, inquiry ke 90 din

Workplace sexual harassment ka apna calendar hai, 2013 ke POSH Act ke under, aur iski pehli deadline woman pe hi aati hai. Written complaint incident ke teen mahine ke andar deni hoti hai, ya agar incidents ka silsila hai toh aakhri incident ke teen mahine ke andar. Committee ise teen aur mahine tak badha sakti hai, par tabhi jab woh likh ke record kare ki haalaat ne use time pe complaint karne se roka [[gazette-posh-act-2013]].

Iske baad ghadiyaan employer ki taraf laagu hoti hain: inquiry poori karne ke 90 din, report employer ko bhejne ke 10 din, aur employer ke us pe action lene ke 60 din. Appeal 90 din ke andar file karni hoti hai [[gazette-posh-act-2013]]. Yeh limits sirf committee ke process pe laagu hoti hain; police complaint ek alag raasta hai.

## Jab ghadi khatam ho jaaye: missed deadline ka matlab

Aam taur pe, apne aap kuch nahi hota. BNSS mein us police ke liye koi consequence nahi likha jo do mahine ki investigation limit miss kare, aur un courts ke liye bhi nahi jo trial aur appeal ki limits miss karein [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Yeh kitni baar hota hai, backlog dikha deta hai. 31 December 2025 ko India ke Fast Track Special Courts mein lagbhag 2,45,579 rape aur POCSO cases pending the, aur us saal in courts mein jitne cases register hue, unse kaafi kam cases ka faisla hua [[pib-ftsc-rajya-sabha-2026-07]]. Do mahine ka trial woh hai jiska law vaada karta hai. Backlog woh hai jo courts asal mein de paate hain.

> Jis deadline pe koi penalty nahi, woh bhi ek aisi date hai jo aap likh ke de sakte hain.

Penalty sirf kuch hi jagah hai: jo police officer rape ki FIR record nahi karta, use Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ke Section 199 ke under chhe mahine se do saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Baaki har jagah ghadi tabhi kaam karti hai jab koi uski taraf ishaara kare.

- **Likh ke dijiye.** Section ka naam, ghadi shuru hone ki date aur khatam hone ki date likhiye. Ise investigating officer aur Superintendent of Police ko bhejiye, aur ek copy apne paas rakhiye. Free legal aid ka lawyer aapko agla kadam samjha sakta hai [[nalsa]].
- **Takedown ko escalate kijiye.** Agar image do ghante baad bhi upar hai, toh cybercrime.gov.in pe ya 1930 pe call karke report kijiye [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]].

Chaar dates likh ke rakhiye: aapki complaint, FIR, medical examination aur chargesheet. Yahan ki har ghadi inhi mein se kisi ek date se shuru hoti hai, aur aapke liye ginti koi aur nahi rakhega.

marital-rape-legal-options-today.en:
In NFHS-5, 4.6% of ever-married women aged 18 to 49 said their husband had physically forced them to have intercourse when they did not want to, and 6.3% reported sexual violence by him [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Indian criminal law does not call this rape. As of 19 November 2026 the Supreme Court had still not ruled on whether it should; it said it would fix the final hearing for 9 or 10 December 2026 [[lawbeat-marital-rape-hearing-2026]].

A woman living with this cannot wait for a judgment. These are the options that exist today, with their limits stated plainly. This is general information, not legal advice.

## Is it rape in law?

Not if you are 18 or older and living with him. Exception 2 to Section 63 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) says sexual intercourse or sexual acts by a man with his own wife, the wife not being under 18, is not rape [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Your refusal is real. The law declines to give it that name.

The exception has two limits. If you are under 18, it does not apply: the Supreme Court ruled in 2017 that sex with a wife under 18 is rape [[sc-independent-thought-2017]]. And it shields him only from the charge of rape. Beating, injuring or threatening a wife is a crime like any other assault, whatever happens to the sexual charge.

## What can the Domestic Violence Act do?

It can get a court to order him to stop. The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 counts "sexual abuse", meaning any sexual conduct that abuses, humiliates, degrades or violates a woman's dignity, as domestic violence [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Forced sex fits that definition without any argument over the word rape.

The Act is mainly a civil law. A magistrate can pass protection, residence and maintenance orders, and you do not need an FIR first [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. You can ask the district Protection Officer, a lawyer or a One Stop Centre for help applying; 985 were operating in July 2026 [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]].

Its limit is punishment. Nobody goes to prison under this Act for the forced sex itself. Breaking a protection order is the offence, and it carries at most a year in prison, a fine of up to Rs 20,000, or both [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]].

Treat it as a safety tool. Imagine a woman in Pune whose husband forces her after every quarrel. A protection order names that conduct, tells him to stop, and gives the police something to act on the next time.

## Can the police register a criminal case?

Sometimes, under two sections.

**Section 85 BNS: cruelty.** Cruelty by a husband or his relatives carries up to three years in prison and a fine. It covers wilful conduct likely to cause a woman grave injury, and harassment over unlawful demands for property [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Forced sex is not named. Police and the court must accept that repeated sexual coercion is conduct of that kind, so describe the whole pattern: dates, injuries, threats, the effect on your health.

**Section 67 BNS: if you live apart.** If you are living separately from him, under a court decree or otherwise, sex without your consent is an offence punishable with two to seven years in prison [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Rape of any other woman carries at least ten years [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. That gap is the law's own measure of how much less a wife's refusal counts. Still, the section is usable: if you have moved to your parents' home, a hostel or a shelter, it can apply to you.

Police must record a complaint about a cognisable offence at any police station, wherever the offence took place, and give you a free copy of the FIR [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

## I am pregnant from forced sex. Can I end the pregnancy?

Yes. On 29 September 2022 the Supreme Court held that "rape" in the abortion law includes marital rape. A married woman pregnant from forced sex by her husband can seek an abortion up to 24 weeks as a survivor of rape, without filing an FIR or proving the rape in court [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. An adult woman's own consent is the only consent the law requires; it does not ask for her husband's [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]].

Go to a registered doctor or a government hospital, and go early. Up to 20 weeks one doctor's opinion is enough; between 20 and 24 weeks two doctors must agree [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. Do not take pills on your own. If the forced sex was within the last five days, emergency contraception can still prevent a pregnancy, and sooner is better; it is not an abortion pill [[who-ec]].

The ruling changed abortion law only. It did not make a husband prosecutable for rape.

## What could the Supreme Court change, and what should I check?

A bench of Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana has the case. On 9 September 2026 it said it would decide two things: whether the exception is valid, and whether a husband can be prosecuted while it stands [[livelaw-marital-rape-final-hearing-2026]]. The lead case is a husband's appeal against a March 2022 Karnataka High Court ruling that he could be prosecuted under the rape provision [[indianexpress-marital-rape-final-hearing-2026]].

If the court strikes the exception down, or allows prosecutions despite it, forced sex by a husband could be tried as rape under Section 63. If it does neither, everything above stays as it is. Do not plan your safety around the date: a hearing is not a verdict, and none of the remedies above depends on one.

If you are reading this after 10 December 2026, search a court-reporting site for the Supreme Court's decision on "Exception 2 to Section 63".

Until then, write down what happens and tell one person you trust. In NFHS-5, 77.2% of women who had faced physical or sexual violence had never sought help or told anyone [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. The law is narrower than it should be. It still leaves you more than silence.
marital-rape-legal-options-today.hg:
NFHS-5 mein 18 se 49 saal ki 4.6% ever-married women ne kaha ki unke husband ne unhe tab intercourse ke liye physically force kiya jab woh nahi chahti thi, aur 6.3% ne husband ki sexual violence report ki [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. India ka criminal law ise rape nahi kehta. 19 November 2026 tak Supreme Court ne is pe faisla nahi diya tha ki ise rape kaha jaana chahiye ya nahi; court ne kaha ki woh final hearing 9 ya 10 December 2026 ke liye fix karega [[lawbeat-marital-rape-hearing-2026]].

Jo woman yeh jhel rahi hai, woh judgment ka intezaar nahi kar sakti. Neeche woh options hain jo aaj maujood hain, aur unki limits bhi saaf-saaf likhi hain. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Kya law mein yeh rape hai?

Agar aap 18 ya usse badi hain aur uske saath reh rahi hain, toh nahi. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke Section 63 ka Exception 2 kehta hai ki agar wife 18 se kam umar ki nahi hai, toh husband ka apni wife ke saath sexual intercourse ya sexual acts rape nahi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Aapka mana karna asli hai. Law bas use yeh naam dene se inkaar karta hai.

Is exception ki do limits hain. Agar aap 18 se kam hain, toh yeh laagu nahi hota: Supreme Court ne 2017 mein kaha ki 18 se kam umar ki wife ke saath sex rape hai [[sc-independent-thought-2017]]. Aur yeh use sirf rape ke charge se bachata hai. Wife ko maarna, chot pahunchana ya dhamkana kisi bhi doosre assault ki tarah crime hai, sexual charge ka jo bhi ho.

## Domestic Violence Act kya kar sakta hai?

Yeh court se use rukne ka order dilwa sakta hai. Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 "sexual abuse" ko domestic violence maanta hai, yaani sexual nature ka koi bhi bartaav jo woman ko abuse kare, humiliate kare, neecha dikhaye ya uski dignity ko violate kare [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Zabardasti sex is definition mein seedha aata hai, "rape" shabd pe koi behes kiye bina.

Yeh Act mainly ek civil law hai. Magistrate protection, residence aur maintenance ke orders de sakte hain, aur pehle FIR zaroori nahi hai [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Apply karne mein madad ke liye aap district ke Protection Officer, lawyer ya One Stop Centre se baat kar sakti hain; July 2026 mein 985 centres chal rahe the [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]].

Iski limit saza hai. Is Act ke under zabardasti sex ke liye koi jail nahi jaata. Offence protection order todna hai, aur us mein zyada se zyada ek saal ki jail, Rs 20,000 tak ka fine, ya dono hain [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]].

Ise safety tool ki tarah dekhiye. Sochiye, Pune mein ek woman hai jiska husband har jhagde ke baad uske saath zabardasti karta hai. Protection order us bartaav ka naam leta hai, use rukne ko kehta hai, aur agli baar police ke paas action lene ke liye kuch thos hota hai.

## Kya police criminal case register kar sakti hai?

Kabhi-kabhi, do sections ke under.

**Section 85 BNS: cruelty.** Husband ya uske relatives ki cruelty pe teen saal tak ki jail aur fine hai. Is mein aisa jaan-boojhkar kiya gaya bartaav aata hai jisse woman ko grave injury hone ka khatra ho, aur property ki unlawful demands ke liye harassment [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Zabardasti sex ka naam is mein nahi hai. Police aur court ko yeh maanna hoga ki baar-baar ka sexual coercion isi tarah ka bartaav hai, isliye poora pattern bataiye: dates, chotein, dhamkiyan, aapki health pe asar.

**Section 67 BNS: agar aap alag rehti hain.** Agar aap usse alag reh rahi hain, court ke decree ke saath ya uske bina, toh aapki consent ke bina sex ek offence hai jis mein do se saat saal ki jail hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Kisi bhi aur woman ke rape pe kam se kam das saal ki saza hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Yeh gap khud law ka naap hai ki wife ke mana karne ko woh kitna kam ginta hai. Phir bhi yeh section kaam ka hai: agar aap maayke, hostel ya shelter mein shift ho chuki hain, toh yeh aap pe laagu ho sakta hai.

Cognisable offence ki complaint police ko kisi bhi police station mein record karni hoti hai, offence kahin bhi hua ho, aur FIR ki copy aapko free mein deni hoti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

## Main zabardasti sex se pregnant hoon. Kya main pregnancy khatam karwa sakti hoon?

Haan. 29 September 2022 ko Supreme Court ne kaha ki abortion law mein "rape" ke andar marital rape bhi aata hai. Husband ke zabardasti sex se pregnant hui married woman, rape survivor ke taur pe 24 weeks tak abortion maang sakti hai, FIR file kiye bina aur court mein rape saabit kiye bina [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. Law sirf adult woman ki apni consent maangta hai; husband ki consent nahi maangta [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]].

Registered doctor ya government hospital jaiye, aur jaldi jaiye. 20 weeks tak ek doctor ki opinion kaafi hai; 20 se 24 weeks ke beech do doctors ka sehmat hona zaroori hai [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. Apne aap pills mat lijiye. Agar zabardasti sex pichhle paanch din ke andar hua hai, toh emergency contraception ab bhi pregnancy rok sakta hai, aur jitni jaldi utna behtar; yeh abortion pill nahi hai [[who-ec]].

Is ruling ne sirf abortion law badla. Isse husband pe rape ka case chalana mumkin nahi hua.

## Supreme Court kya badal sakta hai, aur mujhe kya check karna chahiye?

Case Chief Justice Surya Kant aur Justices Joymalya Bagchi aur V. Mohana ki bench ke paas hai. 9 September 2026 ko bench ne kaha ki woh do cheezein tay karegi: exception valid hai ya nahi, aur jab tak exception hai tab tak husband pe case chal sakta hai ya nahi [[livelaw-marital-rape-final-hearing-2026]]. Lead case ek husband ki appeal hai, March 2022 ki us Karnataka High Court ruling ke khilaaf jis mein kaha gaya tha ki us pe rape provision ke under case chal sakta hai [[indianexpress-marital-rape-final-hearing-2026]].

Agar court exception ko khatam kar deta hai, ya exception ke rehte hue bhi prosecution ki ijaazat de deta hai, toh husband ke zabardasti sex pe Section 63 ke under rape ka case chal sakega. Agar court dono mein se kuch nahi karta, toh upar likha sab kuch waisa hi rahega. Apni safety ka plan date ke bharose mat banaiye: hearing verdict nahi hoti, aur upar ke kisi bhi raaste ko verdict ki zaroorat nahi hai.

Agar aap yeh 10 December 2026 ke baad padh rahi hain, toh kisi court-reporting site pe "Exception 2 to Section 63" pe Supreme Court ka decision search kijiye.

Tab tak, jo ho raha hai use likhti rahiye aur ek aise insaan ko bataiye jis pe aapko bharosa ho. NFHS-5 mein physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali 77.2% women ne na kabhi help maangi thi, na kisi ko bataya tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Law utna chauda nahi hai jitna hona chahiye. Phir bhi woh aapke paas chuppi se zyada chhodta hai.

medical-exam-after-rape-what-to-expect.en:
Imagine a 22-year-old in Bhopal deciding, the morning after she was raped, whether to go to a hospital. She fears the examination room more than the police: who will touch her, what they will look for, what they will write. Fears like hers help explain why, in NFHS-5, 77% of women who had faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. The law answers each question, mostly in her favour. This is general information, not legal advice.

## Do I have to agree to the examination?

No. Section 184 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023 says police must send a rape survivor for a medical examination within 24 hours of receiving information, preferably to a government doctor, and only with her consent. Nothing in it makes an examination without her consent lawful [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Consent is not one signature for everything: you can accept treatment but refuse evidence collection, or ask the doctor to stop halfway. Refusing the evidence exam does not cancel your right to care: Section 397 of the BNSS obliges every hospital, public or private, to treat a rape survivor immediately and free of cost [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. A hospital in-charge who refuses can face up to a year in jail under Section 200 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Two honest caveats. The hospital must also inform the police, so a visit can start a police process. And skipping the exam can weaken a case, because some evidence fades within days. The choice stays yours; a One Stop Centre can help you make it, and 985 were running in July 2026 [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]].

## What happens in the room, step by step

Ask the doctor to explain each step first:

1. **Consent:** each part explained, your yes or no noted.
2. **Your account:** what happened and when, and whether you have bathed or changed. It guides the exam; it is not a cross-examination.
3. **A check for injuries** anywhere on the body.
4. **Samples, only if you agree:** swabs and sometimes clothes, for forensic tests.
5. **Treatment:** injuries, a pregnancy test, medicine against infection.

Ask for two medicines by name if nobody offers them: emergency contraception, which works up to 5 days after unprotected sex and better the sooner it is taken [[who-ec]], and HIV post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), which must start within 72 hours and runs for 28 days [[who-pep]]. Our 72-hour plan after an assault explains both clocks. You can ask for a woman doctor and for someone you trust to stay with you.

Men and transgender people are assaulted too; the BNS has no rape offence covering them as adults [[indiacode-bns-2023]], but their medical needs are the same.

## The two-finger test is banned: what to do if anyone tries it

The so-called two-finger test claimed to judge whether a woman was "habituated to sex". In April 2013, in Lillu v. State of Haryana, the Supreme Court held that it violates a rape survivor's right to privacy, physical and mental integrity and dignity [[barandbench-lillu-2013]].

On 31 October 2022, in State of Jharkhand v. Shailendra Kumar Rai, the court said the test has "no scientific basis" and "re-victimizes and re-traumatizes" women, and declared anyone who conducts it guilty of misconduct [[theprint-sc-two-finger-test-2022]]. It told governments to send the Health Ministry's 2014 guidelines, which ban the test, to every government and private hospital, and to review medical curricula so that the test is not prescribed [[scconline-shailendra-rai-2022]].

Think about what that means: nine years after the first ruling, the Supreme Court still had to order medical curricula checked for this test. A ban that has to be repeated is a warning. Do not assume every examination room has heard of it.

If a doctor attempts a finger test, or talks about your hymen being "intact" or "torn", say clearly: "I do not consent. The Supreme Court has banned this test." Note the doctor's name, the hospital and the time, and tell the investigating officer, the One Stop Centre or your lawyer. The hymen cannot show whether someone has had sex.

## What the report says, who gets it and by when

The report records what was examined, any injuries and which samples went for testing. Under Section 184, the doctor must forward it to the investigating officer within 7 days. Police must then finish investigating a rape case within two months of recording the information [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Three things the report cannot honestly say. It cannot say you "consented": consent is about what you agreed to, not a physical finding. It cannot call you "habituated to sex", a phrase that belongs to the banned test. And "no injuries" does not mean "no rape": Section 63 of the BNS says a woman who does not physically resist is not, for that reason alone, consenting [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

## Can my past or my body be used against me in court?

Not on the question of consent. Since 2013, Section 53A of the Indian Evidence Act has made a survivor's character and previous sexual experience irrelevant to consent [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]], a rule the new Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam carries forward in Section 48 [[indiacode-bsa-2023]]. In its 2022 ruling the Supreme Court also called it patriarchal and sexist to doubt a rape complaint because a woman is sexually active [[scconline-shailendra-rai-2022]].

> Your body is not a witness against you.

What decides it is whether you agreed to that specific act; the BNS defines consent as an "unequivocal voluntary agreement" [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Going to a hospital? Take someone you trust and ask questions at every step. If a doctor breaks these rules, that is their misconduct, not your failure. For anyone under 18, POCSO adds safeguards, explained in our guide on reporting child sexual abuse.
medical-exam-after-rape-what-to-expect.hg:
Sochiye, Bhopal mein ek 22 saal ki ladki hai. Uske saath rape hua hai. Agli subah woh soch rahi hai ki hospital jaaye ya nahi. Use police se zyada darr examination room ka hai: kaun use chhuega, kya-kya dekha jayega, report mein uske baare mein kya likha jayega. Aise darr bhi ek wajah hain ki zyada tar auratein help tak pahunchti hi nahi. NFHS-5 mein, physical ya sexual violence jhel chuki 77% auraton ne na kabhi help maangi, na kisi ko bataya [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Achhi baat yeh hai ki law ke paas uske har sawaal ka jawab hai, aur zyada tar jawab uske favour mein hain. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Kya exam ke liye haan kehna zaroori hai?

Nahi. Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023 ka Section 184 kehta hai: police ko information milne ke 24 ghante ke andar rape survivor ko medical exam ke liye bheja jaaye. Ho sake toh exam sarkari doctor kare. Aur exam sirf survivor ke consent se ho. Isi section mein saaf likha hai ki consent ke bina koi bhi exam legal nahi hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Consent ka matlab yeh nahi ki ek sign kiya aur sab kuch maan liya. Aap treatment ke liye haan keh sakti hain aur evidence lene se mana kar sakti hain. Exam ke beech mein bhi doctor ko rukne ke liye keh sakti hain. Evidence wale exam se mana karne par ilaaj ka haq khatam nahi hota. BNSS ke Section 397 ke hisaab se har hospital ko, sarkari ho ya private, rape survivor ka ilaaj turant aur free karna hoga [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Agar hospital ka in-charge ilaaj se mana kare, toh use jail ho sakti hai: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke Section 200 mein iske liye ek saal tak ki saza hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Do baatein saaf-saaf jaan lijiye. Pehli, hospital ko police ko bhi khabar deni hoti hai, yaani hospital jaane se police process shuru ho sakta hai. Doosri, exam na karwane se aage chalkar case kamzor pad sakta hai, kyunki kuch evidence kuch hi dinon mein mit jaata hai. Phir bhi faisla aapka hai. Yeh faisla lene mein One Stop Centre aapki help kar sakta hai. July 2026 mein poore India mein aise 985 centres chal rahe the [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]].

## Room ke andar kya hota hai, step by step

Doctor se kahiye ki shuru karne se pehle har step samjhayein:

1. **Consent:** har part samjhaya jaaye, aur aapne kis cheez par haan kaha aur kis par na, yeh likha jaaye.
2. **Aapki baat:** kya hua, kab hua, aur kya aapne uske baad nahaya ya kapde badle. Isse doctor ko exam mein madad milti hai. Yeh koi cross-examination nahi hai.
3. **Chot ka check:** body par kahin bhi chot ho toh use dekha jaata hai.
4. **Samples, sirf aapki haan se:** jaise swab aur kabhi-kabhi kapde, forensic test ke liye.
5. **Treatment:** chot ka ilaaj, pregnancy test aur infection se bachane wali dawa.

Agar koi khud na de, toh do dawaiyan naam lekar maangiye. Pehli, emergency contraceptive pill. Yeh ghatna ke 5 din baad tak kaam karti hai, par jitni jaldi lein utna achha [[who-ec]]. Doosri, HIV se bachane wali PEP (post-exposure prophylaxis). Ise 72 ghante ke andar shuru karna zaroori hai, aur yeh 28 din tak leni hoti hai [[who-pep]]. In dono ki ghadi kaise chalti hai, yeh hamari '72 ghante wali guide' mein detail mein bataya gaya hai. Aap lady doctor maang sakti hain, aur kisi bharose wale insaan ko saath rakh sakti hain.

Mard aur transgender log bhi sexual assault jhelte hain. BNS mein adult mard ya transgender person ke saath rape ka koi offence hai hi nahi [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Lekin ilaaj ki zaroorat sabki ek jaisi hai.

## Two-finger test banned hai: koi karne lage toh kya karein

Is 'two-finger test' ke naam par daawa kiya jaata tha ki isse pata chalta hai ki aurat 'sex ki aadi' hai ya nahi. April 2013 mein Lillu v. State of Haryana case mein Supreme Court ne saaf kaha: yeh test rape survivor ki privacy, uske body aur mind par uske haq, aur uski dignity ke khilaaf hai [[barandbench-lillu-2013]].

31 October 2022 ko court ek kadam aur aage gaya. State of Jharkhand v. Shailendra Kumar Rai case mein court ne kaha ki is test ka "koi scientific basis nahi" hai, aur yeh auraton ko dobara dard aur trauma deta hai. Jo bhi yeh test karega, woh misconduct ka doshi hoga [[theprint-sc-two-finger-test-2022]]. Court ne governments se kaha ki Health Ministry ki 2014 ki guidelines har sarkari aur private hospital tak pahunchayi jaayein. Yeh guidelines is test par ban lagaati hain. Saath hi medical padhai check ki jaaye, taaki usme yeh test karne ko na kaha jaaye [[scconline-shailendra-rai-2022]].

Zara sochiye, iska matlab kya hai. Pehle faisle ke nau saal baad bhi Supreme Court ko medical padhai check karne ka order dena pada. Jis ban ko baar-baar dohrana pade, woh ek warning hai. Yeh maan kar mat chaliye ki yeh ban har examination room tak pahunch chuka hai.

Agar doctor finger test karne lagein, ya aapke hymen ko 'intact' ya 'torn' batane lagein, toh saaf kahiye: "Mera isme consent nahi hai. Supreme Court is test par ban laga chuka hai." Doctor ka naam, hospital aur time note kar lijiye. Phir investigating officer, One Stop Centre ya apne lawyer ko bataiye. Yaad rakhiye, hymen se yeh pata hi nahi chal sakta ki kisi ne sex kiya hai ya nahi.

## Report mein kya hota hai, kise milti hai aur kab tak

Report mein likha jaata hai ki kya-kya check hua, koi chot mili ya nahi, aur kaun-se samples test ke liye bheje gaye. Section 184 ke tahat doctor ko yeh report 7 din ke andar investigating officer ko bhejni hoti hai. Uske baad police ko information record hone ke do mahine ke andar rape case ki investigation poori karni hoti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Teen baatein aisi hain jo report imaandari se keh hi nahi sakti. Pehli, report yeh nahi keh sakti ki aapka 'consent' tha. Consent is baat se tay hota hai ki aapne kis cheez ke liye haan kaha tha. Yeh body par dikhne wali cheez nahi hai. Doosri, report aapko 'sex ki aadi' nahi keh sakti. Yeh usi banned test ki bhasha hai. Teesri, 'chot nahi mili' ka matlab 'rape nahi hua' nahi hota. BNS ka Section 63 kehta hai ki agar aurat ne physically resist nahi kiya, toh sirf is wajah se uska consent nahi maana jayega [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

## Kya court mein mera past ya meri body mere khilaaf use ho sakti hai?

Consent ke sawaal par, bilkul nahi. 2013 mein purane Indian Evidence Act mein Section 53A joda gaya tha. Iske hisaab se, consent ke sawaal par survivor ka character ya uska purana sexual experience koi matter nahi karta [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]]. Naya law, Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA), bhi apne Section 48 mein yahi rule aage le jaata hai [[indiacode-bsa-2023]]. 2022 ke faisle mein Supreme Court ne ek aur baat kahi. Agar koi aurat sexually active hai, toh sirf is wajah se uski complaint par shak karna patriarchal aur sexist soch hai [[scconline-shailendra-rai-2022]].

> Aapki body aapke khilaaf gawah nahi hai.

Faisla is baat se hota hai ki aapne us khaas act ke liye haan kaha tha ya nahi. BNS consent ko "saaf aur apni marzi se di gayi haan" maanta hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Hospital ja rahi hain? Kisi bharose wale insaan ko saath le jaiye aur har step par sawaal poochiye. Agar doctor yeh rules todein, toh yeh unka misconduct hai, aapki koi kami nahi. 18 saal se kam umar walon ke liye POCSO law alag se protection deta hai. Iske baare mein hamari guide "bachchon ke sexual abuse ko report kaise karein" mein bataya gaya hai.

myths-that-stop-survivors-reporting.en:
Most women in India who face violence tell nobody. In NFHS-5, 77.2% of women who had experienced physical or sexual violence had never sought help or told anyone; of those who did seek help, 6.3% went to the police [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Fear and a lack of family support are part of that. So are a few beliefs about what a "real" case looks like, repeated by relatives, friends and sometimes the police. The law has already rejected each one. This is general information, not legal advice.

## "There are no injuries, so there is no case"

Section 63 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) lists seven circumstances in which sex is rape: against a woman's will; without her consent; with consent obtained through fear of death or hurt; with consent given because the man posed as her husband; with consent given while she was intoxicated or of unsound mind; when she cannot communicate consent; and with any girl under 18, whatever she says [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Injury is not on the list. Nor is a struggle.

The same section defines consent as an "unequivocal voluntary agreement" and says a woman who does not physically resist is not, for that reason alone, to be treated as consenting [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Freezing is not agreeing.

Courts have corrected the same error for children. In November 2021 the Supreme Court set aside a High Court ruling that had demanded skin-to-skin contact, holding that what makes an act sexual assault under POCSO "is sexual intent and not skin to skin contact with the child" [[barandbench-satish-2021]].

**Next step:** a medical examination helps, but it can be done only with your consent [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Every hospital, public or private, must treat a rape survivor immediately and free of cost, and must inform the police [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

## "I have to report where it happened"

Section 173 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) lets anyone report a cognizable offence at any police station, "irrespective of the area where the offence is committed", or electronically, with a signature within three days. The FIR copy is free [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Consider a student assaulted on a college trip to another state: she can report at the station nearest her home.

A woman's complaint of rape must be recorded by a woman police officer or woman officer [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. An officer who fails to record it commits an offence punishable with six months to two years' rigorous imprisonment under Section 199 BNS [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

**Next step:** if the desk says "not our area", name Section 173 and hand over a written complaint.

## "He was my boyfriend, so it doesn't count"

In 96.8% of rape cases registered in India in 2024, 28,597 of 29,536, the offender was known to the survivor [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Those are only the cases that reached the police. The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook on gender stereotypes says it plainly: "Very often men sexually assault or rape a woman known to them in some capacity" [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

Section 63 makes no exception for a boyfriend, fiancé, friend, relative or employer, and rape by a relative, guardian or teacher is punished as an aggravated form [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. An earlier yes does not protect him: a survivor's character and previous sexual experience are irrelevant to the question of consent [[indiacode-bsa-2023]].

The law's gaps are elsewhere. Forced sex by a husband on a wife aged 18 or over is still not rape, and Section 63 recognises only a woman as the victim [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Boys are protected until 18: POCSO covers every child, boy or girl [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

**Next step:** in your complaint, say who he is and how you know him. The relationship is not a defence.

## "If it were real, she would have reported it at once"

The Supreme Court's handbook lists this belief as a stereotype. It says "lack of familial support or fear of repercussions may cause a survivor / victim to delay their reporting", and that there is no "correct" or "appropriate" way for a survivor to behave [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

A Delhi court said the same in its 2021 #MeToo defamation verdict: most women who suffer abuse do not speak up, often for years, because of "The Shame" and social stigma [[delhi-court-metoo-defamation-judgment-2021]]. The survey figure at the top of this page is that sentence in numbers. Silence is the usual response, not evidence of a lie.

Delay has a cost: medical findings fade and messages get deleted. But a late complaint is still a complaint. Expect to be asked why you waited. The honest answer, whether fear, family or shame, is one the courts have already recognised.

**Next step:** write down what you remember, save chats and call logs, and note whom you told and when.

## "Everyone will know my name"

Publishing a rape survivor's name, or any detail that could identify her, is a crime under Section 72 BNS, punishable with up to two years in prison and a fine, unless she authorises it in writing [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Rape trials are held in camera, and nothing about the proceedings may be published without the court's permission [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Her statement is to be taken at her home or a place of her choice [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. The Supreme Court has ordered that FIRs in rape and POCSO cases must not be put in the public domain [[sc-nipun-saxena-2018]].

Here is the honest limit. The law punishes publication, not gossip, and it is rarely used: police registered just 11 cases under Section 72 in 2024, the new code's first six months, though NCRB counts each FIR only under its most serious offence, so cases filed alongside a graver charge do not show up [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

**Next step:** if a news site, a WhatsApp group or a relative posts your name or photo, screenshot it and report it. That offence is theirs, not yours.

None of this makes reporting easy. If you are an adult, going to the police remains your decision; when a child is abused, anyone who knows is required by law to report it [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. But the law does not ask for injuries, the "right" police station, a stranger, speed or publicity. It asks whether you agreed, and if you were under 18, not even that.
myths-that-stop-survivors-reporting.hg:
India mein violence jhelne wali zyada tar women kisi ko nahi batati. NFHS-5 mein physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali 77.2% women ne na kabhi help maangi thi, na kisi ko bataya tha; jinhone help maangi, un mein se 6.3% police ke paas gayi [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Iski ek wajah dar aur family ka saath na milna hai. Kuch maanyataayein bhi hain ki "asli" case kaisa dikhta hai, jinhe rishtedaar, dost aur kabhi-kabhi police bhi dohraati hai. Law in mein se har ek ko pehle hi reject kar chuka hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## "Chot nahi hai, toh case nahi banega"

Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka Section 63 saat circumstances ginata hai jin mein sex rape hai: woman ki marzi ke khilaaf; uski consent ke bina; jab consent maut ya chot ka dar dikhakar li gayi ho; jab consent isliye di gayi ho ki aadmi ne khud ko uska husband bataya; jab consent nashe ya unsound mind ki haalat mein di gayi ho; jab woh consent communicate hi na kar sake; aur 18 se kam umar ki kisi bhi ladki ke saath, woh kuch bhi kahe [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Chot is list mein nahi hai. Haatha-paai bhi nahi.

Yahi section consent ko "unequivocal voluntary agreement" kehta hai, aur kehta hai ki jo woman physically resist nahi karti, use sirf isi wajah se consent dene wali nahi maana ja sakta [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Freeze ho jaana haan kehna nahi hai.

Courts ne bachchon ke maamle mein bhi yahi galti sudhaari hai. November 2021 mein Supreme Court ne us High Court ruling ko radd kiya jisne skin-to-skin contact ki shart rakhi thi, aur kaha ki POCSO ke under sexual assault ke liye zaroori cheez "is sexual intent and not skin to skin contact with the child" hai, yaani sexual intent, skin-to-skin contact nahi [[barandbench-satish-2021]].

**Agla step:** medical examination se madad milti hai, lekin woh sirf aapki consent se ho sakta hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Har hospital ko, sarkari ho ya private, rape survivor ka ilaaj turant aur free karna hota hai, aur police ko inform karna hota hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

## "Report wahin karni padegi jahan yeh hua"

Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ka Section 173 kehta hai ki koi bhi insaan cognizable offence ki report kisi bhi police station mein kar sakta hai, "irrespective of the area where the offence is committed", ya electronically, jis pe teen din ke andar signature karna hota hai. FIR ki copy free milti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Ek student ke baare mein sochiye jiske saath doosre state ki college trip pe assault hua: woh apne ghar ke sabse paas wale station mein report kar sakti hai.

Woman ki rape ki complaint woman police officer ya woman officer ko hi record karni hoti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Jo officer use record nahi karta, woh Section 199 BNS ke under offence karta hai, jis mein chhe mahine se do saal ki rigorous imprisonment hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

**Agla step:** agar desk pe kaha jaaye "yeh hamara area nahi hai", toh Section 173 ka naam lijiye aur written complaint de dijiye.

## "Woh mera boyfriend tha, toh yeh count nahi hota"

2024 mein India mein register hue 96.8% rape cases mein, yaani 29,536 mein se 28,597 mein, offender survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh sirf woh cases hain jo police tak pahunche. Gender stereotypes pe Supreme Court ki 2023 ki handbook seedha kehti hai: "Very often men sexually assault or rape a woman known to them in some capacity" [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

Section 63 boyfriend, fiancé, dost, rishtedaar ya employer ke liye koi exception nahi banata, aur relative, guardian ya teacher ka kiya rape aggravated form maana jaata hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Pehle kabhi kaha gaya "haan" use nahi bachata: consent ke sawaal pe survivor ka character aur uska pichhla sexual experience irrelevant hai [[indiacode-bsa-2023]].

Law ki kamiyan kahin aur hain. 18 ya usse badi wife ke saath husband ka zabardasti sex aaj bhi rape nahi hai, aur Section 63 sirf woman ko victim maanta hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Ladke 18 ki umar tak protected hain: POCSO har bachche ko cover karta hai, ladka ho ya ladki [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

**Agla step:** apni complaint mein bataiye ki woh kaun hai aur aap use kaise jaanti hain. Rishta koi defence nahi hai.

## "Agar sach hota, toh woh turant report karti"

Supreme Court ki handbook is soch ko stereotype ginti hai. Woh kehti hai ki "lack of familial support or fear of repercussions may cause a survivor / victim to delay their reporting", yaani family ka saath na milna ya anjaam ka dar report mein deri kara sakta hai, aur yeh bhi ki survivor ke behave karne ka koi "correct" ya "appropriate" tareeka nahi hota [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

Delhi ki ek court ne 2021 ke #MeToo defamation verdict mein yahi kaha: abuse jhelne wali zyada tar women bolti nahi, aksar saalon tak, "The Shame" aur social stigma ki wajah se [[delhi-court-metoo-defamation-judgment-2021]]. Is page ke shuru mein diya survey figure isi baat ko numbers mein kehta hai. Chuppi aam response hai, jhooth ka saboot nahi.

Deri ki keemat hoti hai: medical findings mit jaati hain aur messages delete ho jaate hain. Lekin der se ki gayi complaint bhi complaint hai. Yeh sawaal zaroor aayega ki aapne intezaar kyun kiya. Sachcha jawaab, chahe dar ho, family ho ya sharm, aisa jawaab hai jise courts pehle hi maan chuki hain.

**Agla step:** jo yaad hai use likh lijiye, chats aur call logs save kijiye, aur note kijiye ki aapne kise aur kab bataya tha.

## "Sabko mera naam pata chal jaayega"

Rape survivor ka naam, ya koi bhi aisi detail jisse uski pehchaan ho sake, publish karna Section 72 BNS ke under crime hai, jis mein do saal tak ki jail aur fine hai, jab tak woh khud likhkar ijaazat na de [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Rape ke trials in camera hote hain, aur court ki permission ke bina proceedings ke baare mein kuch bhi publish nahi kiya ja sakta [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Uska statement uske ghar pe ya uski pasand ki jagah pe liya jaana hota hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Supreme Court ne order diya hai ki rape aur POCSO cases ki FIRs public domain mein nahi daali ja sakti [[sc-nipun-saxena-2018]].

Imaandaar limit yeh hai. Law publication ko saza deta hai, gossip ko nahi, aur iska istemaal kam hi hota hai: 2024 mein, naye code ke pehle chhe mahine mein, police ne Section 72 ke under sirf 11 cases register kiye, haalaanki NCRB har FIR ko sirf uske sabse serious offence ke under ginta hai, isliye kisi bade charge ke saath file hue cases is ginti mein nahi dikhte [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

**Agla step:** agar koi news site, WhatsApp group ya rishtedaar aapka naam ya photo post kare, toh screenshot lekar report kijiye. Woh offence unka hai, aapka nahi.

In mein se koi bhi baat reporting ko aasaan nahi banati. Agar aap adult hain, toh police ke paas jaana hai ya nahi, yeh faisla aapka hi hai; jab kisi bachche ka abuse ho raha ho, toh jise bhi pata hai use law ke hisaab se report karna hi hota hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Lekin law chot, "sahi" police station, anjaan accused, jaldi ya publicity nahi maangta. Woh poochhta hai ki aapne haan kaha tha ya nahi, aur agar aap 18 se kam thi, toh yeh bhi nahi.

one-stop-centre-sakhi-what-you-get.en:
Consider a 24-year-old in Nashik. Her husband hit her again last night. This morning she has a swollen wrist, a three-year-old daughter, a little cash and no place to go that he does not know. To get help the usual way she would have to find five places: a hospital, a police station, a lawyer, a counsellor and somewhere to sleep. At each one she would tell her story again to a stranger.

A One Stop Centre exists so that she has to find only one door. Most women never find it. In NFHS-5, 77.2% of women who had faced physical or sexual violence had never sought help or told anyone [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. This explainer is general information, not legal advice.

## One door instead of five: what a One Stop Centre is for

One Stop Centres, also called Sakhi centres, are part of the Women and Child Development Ministry's Mission Shakti. Each is meant to put police help, medical care, legal aid, counselling and short-stay shelter under one roof, for women facing violence at home or outside it [[wcd-mission-shakti]]. You are not charged for any of it.

In December 2018 the Supreme Court asked every state and union territory to set up at least one centre in every district within a year [[sc-nipun-saxena-2018]]. The network grew slowly: 802 centres by March 2025 [[pib-nirbhaya-fund-2025]], 926 by March 2026 [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-03]], and 985 running out of 1,033 approved by July 2026. Between April 2015, when the scheme began, and June 2026, the centres assisted over 15.20 lakh women [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]].

That is the reach of eleven years. The door works only for the woman who knows where it is.

## Who can walk in, and for what kinds of violence

Any woman can walk in, whatever her age, caste, religion or marital status. The violence may be a husband's beating, dowry harassment, rape, stalking, an acid attack, harassment at work, threats to leak photographs or a forced marriage. It does not matter who the abuser is [[wcd-mission-shakti]].

You do not need an FIR, a referral or money, and walking in does not by itself start a police case. An adult woman decides whether to file a complaint. One thing to know first: a hospital that treats a survivor of rape or an acid attack must inform the police [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Ask the case worker what will be reported, and to whom.

For a girl under 18 the rule is stricter. Anyone who learns that a child has been sexually abused must report it to the police, so no centre can promise her secrecy [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]].

The centres are a women's scheme. A boy under 18 can reach help through the Child Helpline, 1098 [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]. An adult man, or a transgender person the centre does not accept, has no equivalent single door. That is a gap in the system.

## The first visit: what happens and what to bring

You need to bring nothing. If you can, carry your phone and charger, an ID, medicines, your children's papers and anything that shows the violence: photographs of injuries, hospital slips, messages. Do not go back into danger to fetch documents.

A case worker asks what happened and what you need first, then connects you to systems that already owe you help:

- **Medical care.** The centre gets you to a hospital. Every hospital, government or private, must treat a survivor of rape or an acid attack immediately and free of cost [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. After a sexual assault, HIV-prevention medicine (PEP) has to start as soon as possible and within 72 hours [[who-pep]], and emergency contraception works for up to 5 days [[who-ec]].
- **Police.** If you want to complain, the staff help you. An FIR can be registered at any police station, wherever the offence took place, and you must get a free copy [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].
- **A lawyer.** Free legal aid for a criminal case, for a protection or residence order under the Domestic Violence Act [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]], or for victim compensation.
- **Counselling.** This is for you. If it turns into pressure to "adjust" and go home, say no and ask for the legal options.
- **Shelter.** A bed for a few nights while the next step is arranged. It is not a long-term home.

## The Women Helpline and the centre: how one call connects

The Women Helpline belongs to the same Mission Shakti scheme as the centres [[wcd-mission-shakti]]. If you cannot travel, cannot speak freely at home or do not know where your centre is, call the helpline first. Give your district and say what you need: the operator can refer you to the nearest centre, a hospital or the police.

If the danger is immediate, call 112. A friend, neighbour or relative can make either call for you. You can also ask for the centre's address at a police station's women help desk.

## If your district's centre is hard to reach

The Supreme Court's one-year deadline passed in December 2019. In July 2026, 48 approved centres were still not running [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]]. One centre per district is also one building for every village around it. And the official count is of centres made "operational". It does not say how many have a counsellor, a lawyer or a free bed on the night you arrive.

So keep a second plan. None of these rights depends on the centre:

- Any hospital must treat a survivor of rape or an acid attack free of cost. A hospital in-charge who refuses faces up to 1 year in jail [[indiacode-bns-2023]].
- Any police station must take your complaint. By March 2025, 14,658 women help desks had been set up in police stations, 13,743 of them headed by women officers [[pib-nirbhaya-fund-2025]].
- The District Legal Services Authority, usually in the district court complex, gives women and children a free lawyer [[nalsa]] and decides victim compensation, even if the offender is never traced [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].
- Tele-MANAS (14416) offers free counselling round the clock [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

If the centre turns you away, note the date and the person's name, call the Women Helpline again and write to the District Magistrate's office.

Of the few women who do seek help, 60.9% turn to their own family and only 6.3% go to the police [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. The first call usually goes to a mother, a brother or a friend. If that is you, find out today where your district's door is.
one-stop-centre-sakhi-what-you-get.hg:
Ek situation sochiye. Nashik ki ek 24 saal ki ladki hai. Kal raat uske pati ne use phir maara. Aaj subah uske paas ek sooji hui kalai hai, teen saal ki beti hai, thode se paise hain, aur aisi koi jagah nahi jahan woh ja sake aur pati ko pata na ho. Aam tareeke se help lene ke liye use paanch jagah dhoondhni padengi: hospital, police station, vakeel, counsellor aur raat ko sone ki jagah. Aur har jagah use apni kahani ek naye ajnabi ko dobara sunani padegi.

One Stop Centre isiliye bana hai ki use sirf ek darwaza dhoondhna pade. Zyada tar auratein woh darwaza kabhi dhoondh hi nahi paati. NFHS-5 mein physical ya sexual violence jhel chuki 77.2% auraton ne kabhi help nahi maangi thi aur kisi ko bataya bhi nahi tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Yeh explainer general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Paanch ki jagah ek darwaza: One Stop Centre kis liye hai

One Stop Centres, jinhe Sakhi centres bhi kehte hain, Women and Child Development Ministry ke Mission Shakti ka hissa hain. Har centre ka kaam hai police help, medical care, legal aid, counselling aur thode din ka shelter ek hi chhat ke neeche dena, un auraton ko jo ghar ke andar ya bahar violence jhel rahi hain [[wcd-mission-shakti]]. Inmein se kisi cheez ke paise nahi lagte.

December 2018 mein Supreme Court ne har state aur union territory se kaha ki ek saal ke andar har district mein kam se kam ek centre banaye [[sc-nipun-saxena-2018]]. Network dheere-dheere badha: March 2025 tak 802 centres [[pib-nirbhaya-fund-2025]], March 2026 tak 926 [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-03]], aur July 2026 tak 1,033 approved centres mein se 985 chal rahe the. April 2015 mein scheme shuru hui thi, aur tab se June 2026 tak centres 15.20 lakh se zyada auraton ki madad kar chuke the [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]].

Gyarah saal mein pahunch itni hi hai. Yeh darwaza usi aurat ke kaam aata hai jise pata ho ki yeh hai kahan.

## Kaun andar ja sakta hai, aur kis tarah ke violence ke liye

Koi bhi aurat andar ja sakti hai, uski umar, caste, religion ya marital status kuch bhi ho. Violence pati ki maar-peet ho sakti hai, dowry ke liye harassment, rape, stalking, acid attack, kaam ki jagah par harassment, photos leak karne ki dhamki ya zabardasti ki shaadi. Abuse karne wala kaun hai, isse fark nahi padta [[wcd-mission-shakti]].

Aapko na FIR chahiye, na kisi ka referral, na paise, aur sirf andar jaane se police case shuru nahi ho jaata. Adult aurat khud tay karti hai ki complaint karni hai ya nahi. Ek baat pehle jaan lijiye: jo hospital rape ya acid attack ki survivor ka ilaaj karta hai, use police ko batana hota hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Case worker se poochiye ki kya report hoga, aur kise.

18 saal se kam ki ladki ke liye rule zyada sakht hai. Jise bhi pata chale ki kisi bachche ka sexual abuse hua hai, use police ko report karna hi hota hai, isliye koi bhi centre us ladki se poori secrecy ka waada nahi kar sakta [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]].

Yeh centres auraton ki scheme hain. 18 saal se kam ka ladka Child Helpline 1098 ke zariye help tak pahunch sakta hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]. Adult aadmi ke liye, ya us transgender insaan ke liye jise centre na le, aisa koi ek darwaza nahi hai. Yeh system ki kami hai.

## Pehli visit: kya hota hai aur kya saath le jaayein

Kuch bhi laana zaroori nahi hai. Ho sake toh apna phone aur charger, ek ID, dawaiyan, bachchon ke papers aur woh sab le aaiye jo violence dikhata ho: choton ki photos, hospital ki parchi, messages. Documents lene ke liye khatre mein wapas mat jaiye.

Case worker poochti hai ki kya hua aur aapko sabse pehle kya chahiye, phir aapko un systems se jodti hai jinki zimmedari pehle se hi aapki help karna hai:

- **Medical care.** Centre aapko hospital tak pahunchata hai. Har hospital ko, sarkari ho ya private, rape ya acid attack ki survivor ka ilaaj turant aur free karna hota hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Sexual assault ke baad HIV se bachane wali dawai (PEP) jitni jaldi ho sake, aur 72 ghante ke andar, shuru karni hoti hai [[who-pep]], aur emergency contraception 5 din tak kaam karti hai [[who-ec]].
- **Police.** Agar aap complaint karna chahti hain, toh staff aapki help karta hai. FIR kisi bhi police station mein darj ho sakti hai, offence chahe kahin bhi hua ho, aur aapko uski copy free milni chahiye [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].
- **Vakeel.** Free legal aid: criminal case ke liye, Domestic Violence Act ke tahat protection ya residence order ke liye [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]], ya victim compensation ke liye.
- **Counselling.** Yeh aapke liye hai. Agar yeh "adjust kar lo" aur ghar laut jao wale pressure mein badalne lage, toh mana kar dijiye aur legal options poochiye.
- **Shelter.** Kuch raaton ke liye bistar, jab tak agla step tay ho. Yeh lambe waqt ka ghar nahi hai.

## Women Helpline aur centre: ek call kaise jodti hai

Women Helpline usi Mission Shakti scheme ka hissa hai jiska centres hain [[wcd-mission-shakti]]. Agar aap travel nahi kar sakti, ghar par khul kar baat nahi kar sakti, ya pata nahi ki aapka centre kahan hai, toh pehle helpline par call kijiye. Apna district bataiye aur kahiye ki aapko kya chahiye: operator aapko sabse nazdeeki centre, hospital ya police ke paas refer kar sakti hai.

Agar khatra isi waqt hai, toh 112 par call kijiye. Dono mein se koi bhi call aapki taraf se koi dost, padosi ya rishtedaar bhi kar sakta hai. Centre ka address aap police station ke women help desk par bhi pooch sakti hain.

## Agar aapke district ka centre pahunch se door ho

Supreme Court ki ek saal wali deadline December 2019 mein nikal gayi. July 2026 mein 48 approved centres ab bhi shuru nahi hue the [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]]. Har district mein ek centre ka matlab yeh bhi hai ki aas-paas ke saare gaon ke liye bas ek building. Aur sarkari ginti un centres ki hai jo "operational" ho gaye. Yeh nahi batati ki jis raat aap pahunchengi, us raat kitne centres mein counsellor, vakeel ya khaali bistar hoga.

Isliye ek doosra plan bhi rakhiye. Inmein se koi bhi haq centre par depend nahi karta:

- Har hospital ko rape ya acid attack ki survivor ka ilaaj free karna hi hota hai. Jo hospital in-charge mana kare, use 1 saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].
- Har police station ko aapki complaint leni hi hogi. March 2025 tak police stations mein 14,658 women help desks ban chuke the, jinmein se 13,743 ki head mahila officers thi [[pib-nirbhaya-fund-2025]].
- District Legal Services Authority, jo aam taur par district court complex mein hoti hai, auraton aur bachchon ko free vakeel deti hai [[nalsa]] aur victim compensation bhi tay karti hai, chahe offender kabhi pakda hi na jaye [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].
- Tele-MANAS (14416) chaubees ghante free counselling deta hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

Agar centre aapko lauta de, toh date aur us insaan ka naam note kijiye, Women Helpline par dobara call kijiye aur District Magistrate ke office ko likh kar bhejiye.

Jo thodi si auratein help maangti hain, unmein se 60.9% apni hi family ke paas jaati hain aur sirf 6.3% police ke paas [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Pehli call aksar maa, bhai ya kisi dost ke paas aati hai. Agar woh insaan aap hain, toh aaj hi pata kar lijiye ki aapke district ka darwaza kahan hai.

pocso-case-parents-guide-special-court.en:
Imagine a mother in Indore. In March her 11-year-old son told her what his tuition teacher had been doing to him, and she went to the police that week. By November she has an FIR number, a Special Court, a hearing date that keeps moving, and no one to explain what comes next.

On paper, the law has thought of almost everything. The Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act protects every child under 18, boys and girls alike [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. It promises a Special Court in every district, the child's evidence recorded within 30 days of that court taking cognizance, and a trial finished, "as far as possible", within a year [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. The reality is a queue. At the end of 2024, 2,86,903 POCSO cases were pending trial, 87.7% of all POCSO cases before the courts, and courts convicted in 32.3% of the trials that ended [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

This guide answers what parents ask, in order. It is general information, not legal advice.

## After the FIR: who takes my child's statement, and where?

The police come to your child. The statement must be recorded at home or a place your child chooses, as far as practicable by a woman officer of at least sub-inspector rank, not in uniform. Your child must never come into contact with the accused, and no child may be kept at a police station at night [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

Every hospital, government or private, must treat your child immediately and free of cost [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Police must finish investigating penetrative and other sexual assault on a child within two months, and update you on progress within 90 days [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. The law sets no penalty for missing that deadline, and at the end of 2024, 21,256 POCSO cases were still pending investigation [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Note the investigating officer's name and number, and keep calling.

## The Special Court: will my child have to face the accused?

No. The court must make sure your child is not exposed to the accused while testifying, using a video link, a one-way mirror or a curtain if needed. The trial is held behind closed doors, with you or another trusted adult present. Lawyers put their questions through the judge, and aggressive questioning, character assassination and repeated summons to testify are not allowed [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. As far as practicable the judge should be a woman, and nothing about the hearing may be published without the court's permission [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Ask the Special Public Prosecutor, the government's lawyer, which of these your court actually uses.

Then prepare for the wait. By November 2026, 779 Fast Track Special Courts were working, 399 of them only for POCSO cases [[pib-ftsc-scheme-continuation-2026]]. These courts alone had about 2,45,579 rape and POCSO cases pending at the end of 2025 [[pib-ftsc-rajya-sabha-2026-07]], and their disposals fell 22% that year [[pib-fast-track-courts-impact-2026]]. The 30-day clock starts only at cognizance. Press for an early evidence date: the sooner your child testifies, the sooner the courtroom is behind them.

## Bail: can the accused come near us?

He may get bail while the trial drags on. But in Aparna Bhat v. State of Madhya Pradesh (18 March 2021), the Supreme Court struck down a bail condition telling a man accused of sexual assault to ask the complainant to tie a rakhi on him, and ruled that bail conditions must not require or permit any contact with the victim [[livelaw-aparna-bhat-2021]].

Use that ruling. Ask the prosecutor to seek conditions that keep the accused away from your home and your child's school. If he breaks them, tell the court in writing and ask for his bail to be cancelled. And if the FIR names Section 65 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (rape of a girl under 16) or Section 70(2) (gang rape of a girl under 18), anticipatory bail is barred [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Check the sections printed on your FIR copy.

## Pressure to 'settle': what if they offer money or threaten us?

In 96.6% of POCSO penetrative assault cases registered in 2024, the offender was someone the child knew [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. So pressure to drop a case, when it comes, can come from inside the circle: a relative, a neighbour, an elder who says a case will "ruin two families".

The law leans towards your child. Under Section 29, the Special Court must presume the accused committed the offence unless the contrary is proved [[indiacode-pocso-2012]], and the Supreme Court has told courts not to suggest compromise or marriage [[livelaw-aparna-bhat-2021]]. But the presumption still needs the case to be proved in court, and your child's testimony is often central to it. If the family withdraws its support, the case is weakened.

In 2024, POCSO trials ended in 12,672 convictions, 25,476 acquittals and 1,101 discharges [[ncrb-cii-2024]]: about two acquittals for every conviction. The data does not say why each trial failed, but a case whose main witness has been pressured into silence is easy to lose. If anyone offers money or threatens you, note the date and the words, and report it to the police and the prosecutor the same day.

## Compensation, school and your child's mind during the wait

Compensation does not depend on a conviction. You can apply directly to the District Legal Services Authority, even if the offender is never traced and no trial takes place, and it must finish its inquiry within two months [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Under NALSA's 2018 scheme for women and girls, a rape survivor is entitled to Rs 4 lakh to Rs 7 lakh, and the limits are 50% higher for a minor [[nalsa-compensation-scheme-women-2018]]; for a boy, apply under your state's scheme. A girl under 18 made pregnant by rape can also get shelter, medical care, legal aid, counselling and education support under a 2023 central scheme [[mwcd-pocso-victim-support-scheme-2023]].

School is one place where a case can leak. No media report may reveal your child's name, photograph, family, school or neighbourhood without the Special Court's permission [[indiacode-pocso-2012]], but WhatsApp groups do not read the law. Tell the principal only what is needed to cover court dates and exams.

Watch your child, not only the case. The child-protection group Darkness to Light lists sleep problems, nightmares, bedwetting and changes in mood or in attitude to school among the signs to take seriously [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]]. Tele-MANAS (14416) counsels anyone who needs it, free and round the clock, your child and you included [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]; the Child Helpline is 1098 [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]. The case may take years. Your child's recovery does not have to wait for it.
pocso-case-parents-guide-special-court.hg:
Sochiye, Indore ki ek maa hai. March mein uske 11 saal ke bete ne use bataya ki tuition teacher uske saath kya karta raha hai, aur woh usi hafte police ke paas gayi. November aa gaya hai. Uske paas ek FIR number hai, ek Special Court hai, ek hearing date hai jo baar-baar aage khisak jaati hai, aur koi nahi jo samjhaye ki ab aage kya hoga.

Kaagaz par law ne lagbhag sab kuch soch rakha hai. Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act 18 saal se kam ke har bachche ko protect karta hai, ladka ho ya ladki [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Yeh har district mein ek Special Court ka waada karta hai, yeh ki court ke cognizance lene ke 30 din ke andar bachche ka evidence record hoga, aur yeh ki trial "jahan tak ho sake" ek saal ke andar poora hoga [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Asliyat ek lambi line hai. 2024 ke end mein 2,86,903 POCSO cases trial ke liye pending the, yaani courts ke saamne aaye saare POCSO cases ka 87.7%, aur jo trials khatam hue unmein se 32.3% mein conviction hua [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Yeh guide unhi sawaalon ke jawab deti hai jo parents poochte hain, usi order mein. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## FIR ke baad: mere bachche ka bayaan kaun lega, aur kahan?

Police aapke bachche ke paas aati hai. Bayaan ghar par ya us jagah record hona chahiye jo bachcha chune, aur jahan tak ho sake ek mahila officer le, jo kam se kam sub-inspector rank ki ho aur uniform mein na ho. Bachche ka accused se kabhi aamna-saamna nahi hona chahiye, aur kisi bhi bachche ko raat mein police station mein nahi rakha ja sakta [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

Har hospital ko, sarkari ho ya private, aapke bachche ka ilaaj turant aur free karna hoga [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Bachche par penetrative ya doosre sexual assault ki investigation police ko do mahine mein poori karni hoti hai, aur 90 din ke andar aapko progress batani hoti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Yeh deadline chhootne par law mein koi saza nahi hai, aur 2024 ke end mein 21,256 POCSO cases ki investigation abhi pending thi [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Investigating officer ka naam aur number note kar lijiye, aur call karte rahiye.

## Special Court: kya mere bachche ko accused ke saamne aana padega?

Nahi. Court ko pakka karna hota hai ki gawahi dete waqt bachcha accused ke saamne na aaye, aur zaroorat ho toh iske liye video link, one-way mirror ya parda use hota hai. Trial band kamre mein hota hai, aur aap ya bharose ka koi aur adult saath rehta hai. Vakeel apne sawaal judge ke zariye poochte hain. Aggressive sawaal, bachche ke character par keechad uchhalna aur use baar-baar gawahi ke liye bulana allowed nahi hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Jahan tak ho sake judge mahila honi chahiye, aur court ki permission ke bina hearing ke baare mein kuch bhi publish nahi ho sakta [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Special Public Prosecutor, yaani sarkar ke vakeel, se poochiye ki aapki court mein inmein se asal mein kya-kya use hota hai.

Phir intezaar ke liye taiyaar rahiye. November 2026 tak 779 Fast Track Special Courts chal rahi thi, jinmein se 399 sirf POCSO cases ke liye thi [[pib-ftsc-scheme-continuation-2026]]. Sirf inhi courts mein 2025 ke end mein lagbhag 2,45,579 rape aur POCSO cases pending the [[pib-ftsc-rajya-sabha-2026-07]], aur us saal inke niptaye hue cases 22% gir gaye [[pib-fast-track-courts-impact-2026]]. 30 din ki ghadi cognizance ke baad hi chalu hoti hai. Evidence ki date jaldi lagwane par zor dijiye: bachcha jitni jaldi gawahi de dega, courtroom utni jaldi uske peeche chhoot jayega.

## Bail: kya accused hamare paas aa sakta hai?

Trial khinchta rahe toh use bail mil sakti hai. Lekin Aparna Bhat v. State of Madhya Pradesh (18 March 2021) mein Supreme Court ne woh bail condition radd kar di jismein sexual assault ke ek accused se kaha gaya tha ki woh complainant se rakhi bandhwane ki request kare. Court ne kaha ki bail conditions victim se kisi bhi tarah ke contact ko na zaroori bana sakti hain, na uski permission de sakti hain [[livelaw-aparna-bhat-2021]].

Is ruling ka use kijiye. Prosecutor se kahiye ki aisi conditions maange jo accused ko aapke ghar aur bachche ke school se door rakhein. Agar woh conditions tode, toh court ko likh kar bataiye aur bail cancel karne ki maang kijiye. Aur agar FIR mein Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ka Section 65 (16 saal se kam ki ladki ka rape) ya Section 70(2) (18 saal se kam ki ladki ka gang rape) laga hai, toh anticipatory bail nahi mil sakti [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Apni FIR copy par likhe sections check kar lijiye.

## 'Samjhauta' ka pressure: agar woh paise offer karein ya dhamki dein?

2024 mein darj hue POCSO ke penetrative assault cases mein se 96.6% mein offender bachche ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Isliye case wapas lene ka pressure, jab aata hai, toh aksar apne hi daayre se aa sakta hai: koi rishtedaar, koi padosi, ya woh buzurg jo kehta hai ki case se "do parivaar barbaad ho jayenge".

Law aapke bachche ki taraf jhukta hai. Section 29 ke tahat Special Court ko yeh maan kar chalna hota hai ki accused ne offence kiya hai, jab tak iska ulta saabit na ho jaye [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Supreme Court ne courts se yeh bhi kaha hai ki woh compromise ya shaadi ka sujhaav na dein [[livelaw-aparna-bhat-2021]]. Lekin presumption ke baad bhi case court mein saabit karna hota hai, aur aksar aapke bachche ki gawahi hi uska centre hoti hai. Agar family saath dena chhod de, toh case kamzor ho jaata hai.

2024 mein POCSO trials 12,672 convictions, 25,476 acquittals aur 1,101 discharges par khatam hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]]: yaani har conviction par lagbhag do acquittals. Data yeh nahi batata ki har trial kyun fail hua, lekin jis case ke main witness ko pressure daal kar chup kara diya gaya ho, use haarna aasaan hai. Agar koi paise offer kare ya dhamki de, toh date aur uske words note kijiye aur usi din police aur prosecutor ko report kijiye.

## Intezaar ke dauraan compensation, school aur bachche ka mann

Compensation conviction par depend nahi karta. Aap seedhe District Legal Services Authority mein apply kar sakte hain, chahe offender kabhi pakda na jaye aur trial ho hi na, aur Authority ko apni inquiry do mahine mein poori karni hoti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Women aur girls ke liye NALSA ki 2018 ki scheme mein rape survivor Rs 4 lakh se Rs 7 lakh ki haqdaar hai, aur minor ke liye yeh limits 50% zyada hain [[nalsa-compensation-scheme-women-2018]]; ladke ke liye apne state ki scheme ke tahat apply kijiye. Rape se pregnant hui 18 saal se kam umar ki ladki ko 2023 ki ek central scheme ke tahat shelter, medical care, legal aid, counselling aur padhai ka support bhi mil sakta hai [[mwcd-pocso-victim-support-scheme-2023]].

School ek aisi jagah hai jahan se case ki baat bahar nikal sakti hai. Special Court ki permission ke bina koi bhi media report aapke bachche ka naam, photo, family, school ya mohalla nahi bata sakti [[indiacode-pocso-2012]], lekin WhatsApp groups law nahi padhte. Principal ko sirf utna bataiye jitna court dates aur exams sambhalne ke liye zaroori hai.

Sirf case par nahi, bachche par nazar rakhiye. Child protection par kaam karne wali sanstha Darkness to Light ke mutabik neend ki dikkat, darawne sapne, bistar geela karna, aur mood ya school ke prati rawaiye mein badlaav aise signs hain jinhe seriously lena chahiye [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]]. Tele-MANAS (14416) har zarooratmand ko free aur chaubees ghante counselling deta hai, aapke bachche ko bhi aur aapko bhi [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]; Child Helpline ka number 1098 hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]. Case mein saalon lag sakte hain. Aapke bachche ki recovery ko uska intezaar karne ki zaroorat nahi hai.

police-duties-after-sexual-offence-compl.en:
Imagine a 19-year-old in Kanpur who walks into a police station at 11 pm to report a rape. A male constable tells her to come back at 10 am, alone, and give her statement to "sir". Nearly every part of that instruction breaks the law.

The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS), which replaced the CrPC, says who records a sexual-offence complaint, where, and what the survivor must be told. Each rule below comes with a sentence you or your family can say at the station. This is general information, not legal advice.

## Your statement: where, by whom, and on video

When a woman reports rape, sexual harassment, stalking, voyeurism or an acid attack, Section 173 says the information must be recorded by a woman officer, and she must get a copy of the FIR free of cost [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. "Come back tomorrow" is not an option: failing to record an FIR for rape or sexual assault is a crime under Section 199 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), punishable with 6 months to 2 years' rigorous imprisonment [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

In a rape case, Section 176 says her detailed statement must be recorded at the survivor's home or a place of her choice, as far as practicable by a woman officer, and may be recorded on video, including on a mobile phone [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. "As far as practicable" is the loophole: a station with no woman officer on duty will say it was not practicable. Ask anyway, and ask for the refusal to be written down.

**Say:** "Please have a woman officer record my statement at my home, on video. Section 176 BNSS provides for that."

## No summons to the station: Section 179

Section 179(1) lets police call witnesses for questioning. Its proviso carves people out: no woman, no boy under 15, no man over 60, and no person with a mental or physical disability or an acute illness "shall be required to attend at any place other than the place in which such person resides" [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. She may go if she is willing; that is her choice, not the officer's.

The rule matters most in the weeks after the FIR, when the calls begin: come and sign, come and clarify. For a survivor in a hostel, a joint family or the accused's own lane, every trip to the station is a public announcement.

Children get a stronger version. Under Section 24 of the POCSO Act, which protects boys as well as girls, the officer recording a child's statement must not be in uniform, the child must never come into contact with the accused, and no child may be kept at a police station at night [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Most BNSS sections here are written for women; an adult man or a transgender person can ask for the same treatment, but the code does not promise it.

**Say:** "Under Section 179 BNSS, I cannot be required to come to the station. Please question me where I live."

## The magistrate's statement and the medical exam

Under Section 183(6), a magistrate, as far as practicable a woman, must record the survivor's statement as soon as the offence is brought to the notice of the police [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. It is made to a judge, not to the investigating officer. If she has a disability, the magistrate must use an interpreter or special educator and record it on video [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Section 184 says a rape survivor must be sent for a medical examination within 24 hours of police receiving the information, and the doctor must send the report to the investigating officer within 7 days. The same section says nothing in it makes an examination lawful without her consent [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Police can take her to a doctor. They cannot make her submit.

**Say:** "When will the magistrate record my statement? And please write down that I consent to the medical examination" (or that you refuse it).

## Privacy: your name, your FIR, your photos
