Section 23 of POCSO bars any media report from revealing them unless the Special Court permits it in the child's interest, with 6 months to 1 year in prison, a fine, or both for a violation [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. The Supreme Court has also ruled that FIRs in POCSO cases must not be put in the public domain [[sc-nipun-saxena-2018]].

The trial is where the system is slowest. POCSO asks the Special Court to record the child's evidence within 30 days of taking cognizance and to finish the trial, as far as possible, within a year [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Hearings must be held in camera, before a woman judge where practicable [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Yet at the end of 2024, 2,86,903 POCSO cases were pending trial, 87.7% of all POCSO cases before the courts that year [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

> A report starts a long road. The child will need adults who stay on it.

Not everyone will thank you for making this call. Make it anyway. The law asks you to, and a child chose you.
report-child-sexual-abuse-1098-pocso.hg:
Sochiye, aap Kanpur ke kisi school mein Class 6 padhate hain. Class ke baad ek chup-chup rehne wali 11 saal ki bachchi ruk jaati hai. Woh batati hai ki jab mummy-papa ghar par nahi hote, toh uske chacha "kuch karte hain", aur chacha ne kaha hai ki kisi ko batana mat. Us pal, bachche ko bachane wala system aap hi hain. Bahut kam bachche yahan tak pahunch paate hain. Sarkar ki 2007 ki Study on Child Abuse mein, sexual assault jhel chuke 72.1% bachchon ne kisi ko nahi bataya tha, aur sirf 3.4% ne police ko bataya tha [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]]. Abuse karne wala aksar ajnabi nahi hota. 2024 mein POCSO ke tahat child rape (penetrative sexual assault) ke jo cases darj hue, unmein se 96.6% mein accused bachche ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Bachcha bataye toh: kya kehna hai, kya nahi poochna

Shaant rahiye, chahe andar se ji ghabra raha ho ya gussa aa raha ho. Bachcha aapka chehra dekh kar tay karta hai ki batakar usne galti toh nahi kar di. Yeh kahiye:

- "Mujhe tum par yakeen hai."
- "Tumne mujhe batakar bilkul sahi kiya."
- "Isme tumhari koi galti nahi hai. Tum kisi musibat mein nahi ho."
- "Ab hum aise logon se help lenge jo tumhe safe rakhenge."

Aisa promise mat kijiye ki aap kisi ko nahi batayenge, kyunki yeh promise aap nibha nahi payenge. Kahiye ki aap sirf unhi logon ko batayenge jinka kaam help karna hai. "Kya usne tumhe yahan chhua?" jaise sawaal mat poochiye, jinmein jawab pehle se bhara ho. Rishtedaron ke saamne bachche se baar-baar kahani mat dohrwaiye. Bachche ko yeh baat police, doctor aur shayad court mein bhi batani padegi. Aapka kaam sunna hai, investigation karna nahi.

Usi din likh lijiye: bachche ke apne words, date aur time, wahan aur kaun tha, aur aapne kya-kya notice kiya. Jiska naam bachche ne liya hai, usse mat bhidiye. Isse bachcha khatre mein pad sakta hai.

Bahut se bachche kabhi words mein nahi batate. Child protection par kaam karne wali sanstha Darkness to Light kehti hai ki body ke nishaanon se zyada, behaviour mein badlaav dikhte hain: ghabrahat, darawne sapne, kisi khaas insaan se darr, phir se bistar geela karna, mood ya school ke prati attitude mein badlaav, ya umar se zyada sexual baaton ki jaankari. Yeh signs dhyaan dene ke liye hain, seedha nateeje par pahunchne ke liye nahi [[d2l-identifying-reporting-abuse-2026]].

## Section 19 aur 21: aapki legal duty

Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012 ka Section 19 is par saaf hai. Agar aapko pata hai ki kisi bachche ke saath sexual offence hua hai, toh aapko police ko batana hoga. Agar sirf shak hai, ya lagta hai ki aisa hone wala hai, tab bhi batana hoga. Report Special Juvenile Police Unit (SJPU) ya local police ko karni hai [[indiacode-pocso-act-2012]]. Section 21 ke tahat report na karne par, ya case record na karne par, 6 mahine tak ki jail ya fine ho sakta hai. School, company ya kisi institution ke head ke liye saza aur kadi hai. Agar unke neeche kaam karne wala koi insaan abuse kare aur head report na kare, toh 1 saal tak ki jail aur fine ho sakta hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

Yaani proof ki zaroorat nahi, shak kaafi hai. Accused rishtedaar ho, teacher ho ya koi powerful insaan, aapki duty wahi rehti hai. Jo principal maamla "andar hi andar nipta" dete hain aur police ko nahi batate, woh school ka naam nahi bacha rahe, woh law tod rahe hain. Ladkon ke liye bhi yahi rule hai: 2007 ki study mein sexual abuse ke baare mein batane wale bachchon mein 52.94% ladke the [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]].

## Kahan report karein: 1098, 112, SJPU ya police station

- **1098:** yeh Child Helpline hai, jo 24x7 chalti hai aur emergency number 112 se judi hai. March 2023 mein yeh 568 districts mein chal rahi thi, aur ise har district tak pahunchaya ja raha tha [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].
- **112:** agar bachcha isi waqt khatre mein hai.
- **Nazdeeki police station ya district ki SJPU:** koi bhi police station complaint lega, offence chahe kahin bhi hua ho. Complaint online bhi bheji ja sakti hai, aur FIR ki copy free milti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Call par apni raay nahi, seedhi-seedhi baatein bataiye: bachche ki umar, woh abhi kahan hai, aaj raat safe hai ya nahi, usne apne words mein kya kaha, aur kiska naam liya. Agar koi officer case record na kare, toh yaad rakhiye: Section 21 sirf report na karne par nahi, case record na karne par bhi saza deta hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

## Aage kya hota hai: bachche ka bayaan, ilaaj aur support

24 ghante ke andar police ko case ki jaankari Child Welfare Committee (CWC) aur Special Court ko deni hoti hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Koi bhi hospital, sarkari ho ya private, bachche ka ilaaj turant aur free karega. Police ko case record hone ke do mahine ke andar investigation poori karni hoti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Kaun-sa office kya karta hai, yeh hamare "child protection system ka map" wale article mein samjhaya gaya hai.

Jab bachche ka bayaan ho, toh kahiye ki maa-baap ya koi aur bharosemand bada uske saath rahe. Kaagaz par investigation zyada tar chargesheet tak pahunchti hai: 2024 mein police ne jin POCSO cases ki investigation nipta di, unmein se 95.3% mein chargesheet file hui. Lekin saal ke end mein 21,256 cases ki investigation ab bhi baaki thi [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Investigating officer se lagaataar updates lete rahiye.

## Bachche ki pehchaan chhupana, aur trial ka lamba intezaar

Bachche ka naam, photo, school, mohalla ya family ki koi bhi detail kisi se share mat kijiye, society ke WhatsApp group mein bhi nahi. POCSO ke Section 23 ke tahat koi bhi media report yeh baatein nahi bata sakti, jab tak Special Court bachche ke bhale ke liye permission na de. Rule todne par 6 mahine se 1 saal tak ki jail, fine, ya dono ho sakte hain [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Supreme Court bhi keh chuka hai ki POCSO cases ki FIR public nahi ki jayegi [[sc-nipun-saxena-2018]].

Sabse slow hissa hai court ka trial. POCSO Act kehta hai ki Special Court case haath mein lene ke 30 din ke andar bachche ki gawahi record kare, aur jahan tak ho sake, ek saal mein trial poora kare [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Hearing band kamre mein hogi, aur jahan ho sake, lady judge ke saamne [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Phir bhi 2024 ke end mein 2,86,903 POCSO cases trial ke intezaar mein the. Yaani us saal court ke saamne jitne POCSO cases the, unmein se 87.7% atke hue the [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

> Report karna ek lambe raaste ki shuruaat hai. Is raaste par bachche ko aise badon ki zaroorat hai jo saath tike rahein.

Har koi is call ke liye aapko thank you nahi kahega. Phir bhi call kijiye. Law aapse yahi chahta hai, aur ek bachche ne aapko chuna hai.

sc-st-atrocities-act-survivor-rights.en:
Police in India registered 4,262 rape cases with Scheduled Caste victims in 2024, about 12 a day, and 1,268 with Scheduled Tribe victims [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. In 2023 courts convicted in 30.5% of the trials they completed in rape cases with Scheduled Caste victims, and 92.3% of such cases were still pending when the year ended [[ncrb-cii-2023-vol2]].

Between the FIR and that verdict sits a law that gives Dalit and Adivasi survivors rights other survivors do not have: the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, which Parliament strengthened in 2015. Those rights work only if someone asks for them. This is general information, not legal advice.

## When the Atrocities Act applies to sexual violence

Two things must be true: the survivor belongs to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe, and the accused does not [[gazette-sc-st-poa-amendment-act-2015]].

The rape itself is charged under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, with POCSO added if the survivor is under 18. The Act's sections go into the same FIR. Since 2015 the Act also spells out a specific sexual offence: under Section 3(1)(w), intentionally touching a Dalit or Adivasi woman in a sexual way without her consent, or using sexual words, acts or gestures towards her, knowing her caste or tribe, carries six months to five years in prison and a fine [[gazette-sc-st-poa-amendment-act-2015]].

If the accused is himself from a Scheduled Caste or Tribe, the Act does not apply, but every right under the general criminal law still does. The counts above include child cases under POCSO, which protects children of any sex [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## The FIR: why the right sections matter

Everything else in the Act hangs on one line in the FIR. Police have a duty to register it under the appropriate sections of the Act [[gazette-sc-st-poa-amendment-act-2015]]. Since a 2018 amendment, the law says no preliminary enquiry is needed before the FIR, no senior officer's approval is needed for arrest, and anticipatory bail is barred [[prs-sc-st-poa-amendment-bill-2018]].

The ordinary rules apply too. Any police station must record the complaint, wherever the crime took place, and the FIR copy is free [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. An officer who fails to record an FIR for rape faces six months to two years of rigorous imprisonment under Section 199 of the BNS [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Imagine a 19-year-old Dalit woman in a town in western Uttar Pradesh, raped by the son of the family her mother works for. At the station the officer writes down the rape section and says the caste part "can be added later". Her family can do four things before they leave. State her caste on record, and that the accused is not SC/ST. Ask in writing for the Act to be added. Read the FIR copy. If the Act is not on it, write to the Superintendent of Police. If the family has a caste certificate, they carry a copy.

## Deadlines and duties: 60 days, and penalties for officials

| Stage | What the Act says | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| FIR | Registered under the Act; no preliminary enquiry | Read the FIR copy before you leave |
| Arrest | No approval needed; no anticipatory bail | Report any threat in writing |
| Investigation | Charge sheet within 60 days; delay explained in writing | Note the FIR date; ask on day 60 |
| Trial | Exclusive Special Court, hearings day to day | Ask the prosecutor for every date |
| Throughout | Protection, and notice of every hearing | Give the prosecutor your phone number |

These are duties with a penalty behind them. Under Section 4, a public servant who is not SC/ST and wilfully neglects them, including registering the FIR under the right sections and filing the charge sheet within 60 days, faces six months to one year in prison [[gazette-sc-st-poa-amendment-act-2015]]. The Act also tells states to set up Exclusive Special Courts and, as far as possible, to finish a trial within two months of the charge sheet [[gazette-sc-st-poa-amendment-act-2015]].

Police mostly do file: they charge-sheeted 88.1% of the rape cases with Scheduled Caste victims they disposed of in 2023 [[ncrb-cii-2023-vol2]]. The wait is in court. That year courts convicted in 508 such cases, acquitted in 1,073 and left 20,622 pending [[ncrb-cii-2023-vol2]]. So keep the calendar yourself. "Wilfully" is a high bar, but a dated letter asking why the charge sheet is late is the record that the delay was no accident.

## Section 15A: protection, and notice of every hearing

The years of waiting are when families are worn down: threats, offers of money, elders asking them to "settle". Section 15A, added in 2015, makes it the state's duty to protect victims, their dependants and witnesses from intimidation, coercion, inducement and violence [[gazette-sc-st-poa-amendment-act-2015]]. An offer of money to withdraw the case is inducement: report it, do not only refuse it.

The same section says:

> "A victim or his dependent shall have the right to reasonable, accurate, and timely notice of any Court proceeding including any bail proceeding"

This matters because the accused often lives in the same village or lane. A family that learns of bail only when he is back has had no chance to tell the court about threats. Give the public prosecutor and the investigating officer your phone number and address in writing. Ask the District Legal Services Authority for a free lawyer [[nalsa]]. Apply there for victim compensation too: it does not depend on the trial, or even on the offender being traced [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

## Why some cases never enter the caste count

NCRB counts a crime as an atrocity against a Scheduled Caste person only when the Atrocities Act is invoked. Cases registered only under the general penal code are left out, on the assumption that the accused was also SC or ST [[ncrb-cii-2023-vol2]].

So an FIR without the Act costs twice. The survivor loses the 60-day deadline, the special court and Section 15A. And the case drops out of the country's caste data, which is why 4,262 is a floor. Checking that one line of the FIR protects one family, and makes next year's count a little more honest.
sc-st-atrocities-act-survivor-rights.hg:
India mein police ne 2024 mein 4,262 rape cases register kiye jinme victim Scheduled Caste se the, yaani roz lagbhag 12, aur 1,268 cases jinme victim Scheduled Tribe se the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. 2023 mein Scheduled Caste victims wale rape cases mein courts ne jitne trials poore kiye, unme se 30.5% mein conviction hui, aur saal khatam hone tak aise 92.3% cases pending the [[ncrb-cii-2023-vol2]].

FIR aur us faisle ke beech ek law hai jo Dalit aur Adivasi survivors ko woh rights deta hai jo baaki survivors ke paas nahi hain: Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, jise Parliament ne 2015 mein aur mazboot kiya. Yeh rights tabhi kaam karte hain jab koi inhe maange. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Sexual violence mein Atrocities Act kab lagta hai

Do baatein sach honi chahiye: survivor Scheduled Caste ya Scheduled Tribe se ho, aur accused na ho [[gazette-sc-st-poa-amendment-act-2015]].

Rape ka charge Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke under lagta hai, aur survivor 18 se kam ho toh POCSO bhi judta hai. Act ke sections usi FIR mein jaate hain. 2015 se Act ek specific sexual offence bhi saaf likhta hai: Section 3(1)(w) ke under, kisi Dalit ya Adivasi woman ko, uski caste ya tribe jaante hue, uski consent ke bina sexual tareeke se intentionally chhoona, ya uski taraf sexual words, acts ya gestures karna, aisa offence hai jisme chhe mahine se paanch saal ki jail aur fine hai [[gazette-sc-st-poa-amendment-act-2015]].

Agar accused khud Scheduled Caste ya Tribe se hai, toh Act nahi lagta, lekin general criminal law ka har right phir bhi milta hai. Upar ke counts mein POCSO ke child cases bhi shaamil hain, aur POCSO har sex ke bachchon ko protect karta hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## FIR: sahi sections kyun zaroori hain

Act ki baaki har cheez FIR ki ek line par tiki hai. Police ki duty hai ki FIR Act ke appropriate sections ke under register kare [[gazette-sc-st-poa-amendment-act-2015]]. 2018 ke amendment ke baad law kehta hai ki FIR se pehle preliminary enquiry ki zaroorat nahi, arrest ke liye kisi senior officer ki approval ki zaroorat nahi, aur anticipatory bail par rok hai [[prs-sc-st-poa-amendment-bill-2018]].

Aam rules bhi lagte hain. Koi bhi police station complaint record karega, crime kahin bhi hua ho, aur FIR ki copy free hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Jo officer rape ki FIR record nahi karta, use BNS ke Section 199 ke under chhe mahine se do saal ki rigorous imprisonment ho sakti hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Sochiye, western Uttar Pradesh ke ek kasbe ki 19 saal ki Dalit woman hai, jiska rape us family ke bete ne kiya jiske ghar uski maa kaam karti hai. Thaane mein officer rape ka section likhta hai aur kehta hai ki caste wala hissa "baad mein jud jayega". Nikalne se pehle uski family chaar kaam kar sakti hai. Uski caste record pe likhwana, aur yeh bhi ki accused SC/ST nahi hai. Likhit mein maangna ki Act joda jaaye. FIR copy padhna. Aur agar Act us par nahi hai, toh Superintendent of Police ko likhna. Family ke paas caste certificate ho, toh uski copy saath le jaati hai.

## Deadlines aur duties: 60 din, aur officials ke liye saza

| Stage | Act kya kehta hai | Aap kya karein |
|---|---|---|
| FIR | Act ke under register; preliminary enquiry nahi | Nikalne se pehle FIR copy padhiye |
| Arrest | Approval zaroori nahi; anticipatory bail nahi | Har dhamki likhit mein report kijiye |
| Investigation | 60 din mein charge sheet; delay ki wajah likhit mein | FIR ki date note kijiye; 60 din poore hote hi poochhiye |
| Trial | Exclusive Special Court, roz-ba-roz hearing | Prosecutor se har date poochhiye |
| Poore case mein | Protection, aur har hearing ka notice | Prosecutor ko apna phone number dijiye |

In duties ke peeche saza bhi hai. Section 4 ke under, jo public servant SC/ST nahi hai aur jaan-boojhkar (wilfully) in duties ko neglect karta hai, jaise FIR sahi sections mein register karna aur 60 din mein charge sheet file karna, use chhe mahine se ek saal ki jail ho sakti hai [[gazette-sc-st-poa-amendment-act-2015]]. Act states se yeh bhi kehta hai ki Exclusive Special Courts banayein aur, jahan tak ho sake, charge sheet ke do mahine ke andar trial khatam karein [[gazette-sc-st-poa-amendment-act-2015]].

Police zyada tar charge sheet file kar deti hai: 2023 mein Scheduled Caste victims wale jin rape cases ko police ne dispose kiya, unme se 88.1% mein charge sheet hui [[ncrb-cii-2023-vol2]]. Intezaar court mein hai. Us saal courts ne aise 508 cases mein conviction di, 1,073 mein acquittal, aur 20,622 pending rahe [[ncrb-cii-2023-vol2]]. Isliye calendar khud sambhaliye. "Wilfully" saabit karna mushkil hai, lekin date wali chitthi, jisme poochha gaya ho ki charge sheet late kyun hai, yeh record banati hai ki delay galti se nahi hua.

## Section 15A: protection, aur har hearing ka notice

Intezaar ke yahi saal families ko thaka dete hain: dhamkiyan, paise ke offer, "settle" kar lene ko kehte buzurg. Section 15A, jo 2015 mein joda gaya, state ki duty banata hai ki woh victims, unke dependants aur witnesses ko intimidation, coercion, inducement aur violence se protect kare [[gazette-sc-st-poa-amendment-act-2015]]. Case wapas lene ke liye paise ka offer inducement hai: use sirf thukraiye nahi, report bhi kijiye.

Yahi section kehta hai:

> "A victim or his dependent shall have the right to reasonable, accurate, and timely notice of any Court proceeding including any bail proceeding"

Yaani har court proceeding ka, bail ki bhi, sahi aur time par notice milna victim ya uske dependant ka haq hai. Yeh isliye zaroori hai kyunki accused aksar usi gaon ya gali mein rehta hai. Jis family ko bail ka tab pata chalta hai jab woh wapas aa chuka hota hai, use court ko dhamkiyon ke baare mein batane ka mauka hi nahi mila. Public prosecutor aur investigating officer ko apna phone number aur address likhit mein dijiye. District Legal Services Authority se free lawyer maangiye [[nalsa]]. Wahin victim compensation ke liye bhi apply kijiye: yeh trial par depend nahi karta, offender ke pakde jaane par bhi nahi [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

## Kuch cases caste count mein kabhi kyun nahi aate

NCRB kisi crime ko Scheduled Caste insaan ke khilaaf atrocity tabhi ginta hai jab Atrocities Act lagaya gaya ho. Jo cases sirf general penal code ke under register hote hain, unhe chhod diya jaata hai, yeh maan kar ki accused bhi SC ya ST tha [[ncrb-cii-2023-vol2]].

Yaani Act ke bina likhi FIR ki keemat do baar chukani padti hai. Survivor se 60 din ki deadline, special court aur Section 15A chhin jaate hain. Aur case desh ke caste data se bahar ho jaata hai, isiliye 4,262 ek floor hai. FIR ki us ek line ko check karna ek family ko protect karta hai, aur agle saal ki ginti ko thoda zyada sachcha banata hai.

sextortion-what-to-do-step-by-step.en:
Imagine a 16-year-old in Lucknow. A friendly new follower starts chatting late one night, the talk turns flirty, a photo is exchanged, and within the hour it flips: his photo comes back with a list of his followers and family, a money demand and a deadline. This is the usual pattern of financial sextortion. Its main targets are boys aged 13 to 17 who believe they are talking to a young woman, and the move from first message to threat can take minutes to hours [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]].

Worldwide, it has become a mass crime against children. NCMEC, the US child-protection clearinghouse, logged more than 10,000 reports of financially motivated sextortion in 2022, more than 28,000 in 2023, more than 36,000 in 2024 and more than 50,000 in 2025, an average of 137 a day [[ncmec-sextortion-data-2026]]. In a 2023 Snap survey of over 6,000 teens and young adults in six countries including India, 65% said they or their friends had been targeted [[weprotect-snap-sextortion-research-2023]].

Panic is the blackmailer's tool; the deadline exists to make you act before you think. Our myth-check covers why paying does not end it. This is the to-do list, and general information, not legal advice.

## The first minutes: stop, don't pay, don't delete

**Stop replying.** Every plea, apology or argument tells the blackmailer you are frightened and still listening. You cannot talk your way out, and you owe them nothing.

**Don't pay**, not even a small amount to buy time. Money proves that pressure works. Research cited by WeProtect suggests most victims who ignore payment demands do not have their images shared afterwards [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. That is not a promise, but the threat is usually bigger than what follows.

**Don't delete anything yet.** Wiping the chat or your account feels like escape, but it destroys the evidence and does nothing to the copy they hold. Mute or archive the chat if you need quiet.

## Evidence: what to screenshot and save

Before you block anyone, take screenshots of:

- the profile page, with the username or handle (display names can be changed), and copy the profile link;
- the whole chat, including the threats and the deadline;
- every payment demand: UPI ID, QR code, bank account or phone number;
- any list of your friends or family they sent back as a threat;
- the date and time of each message, and any numbers that called you.

Do not screenshot, save or forward the intimate image itself, not even to prove what happened. The threats, usernames and payment details are what identify the blackmailer. Keep the screenshots somewhere only you can open.

## Report it: the platform, 1930 and the police

First the platform: report the account for blackmail, sextortion or nudity, then block it. If anything has been posted, platforms in India must remove nude, sexual or morphed images within two hours of a complaint, under a rule in force since 20 February 2026 [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]].

Then report the crime. Call the national cyber crime helpline, 1930, or file at cybercrime.gov.in, run by the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]], a portal set up with a specific focus on crimes against women and children [[pib-mha-i4c-launch-2020]]. Keep the acknowledgement number. If you have already paid, say so and give the transaction details.

You can also walk into any police station, ideally with an adult. Under Section 173 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, police must record a complaint about a cognizable offence wherever it happened (a Zero FIR), can take it electronically if you sign it within three days, and must give you a free copy [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

One warning: the blackmail is sometimes followed by calls from people posing as police [[bhaskar-alwar-sextortion-2021]], asking for money to "close the case", a second wave our investigation into the video-call racket describes. Real police do not settle cases over UPI; hang up and call your local station yourself.

## If the images were taken under 18: Take It Down

If the photo or video was taken when you were under 18, NCMEC's Take It Down can help remove it from participating platforms and stop it being uploaded again. It is free and anonymous, works in Hindi, and never asks for the image: it makes a digital fingerprint (a hash) of the image and sends only that [[ncmec-take-it-down]]. By the end of 2025 it was available in 36 languages, and India sent it more visitors than any country except the United States [[ncmec-cybertipline-data-2025]].

You can use it before anything is posted. It works only on public or unencrypted platforms that have joined, not inside private encrypted chats. For images taken at 18 or older, StopNCII.org does the same job [[swgfl-stopncii-2-million-2025]].

## Telling a parent, and what a parent should say back

Tell one adult today: a parent, an older cousin, a teacher. "Tell anyone and I post it" is the blackmailer's most important line, because telling is what defeats them. And children do tell. Among sextortion reports made to NCMEC by the public where the relationship was known, 94% came from the child or a parent, most of them from children themselves [[ncmec-sextortion-data-2026]].

Parents, your first minute decides whether your child ever brings you a problem again. Don't shout. Don't ask "why did you send it?" Don't grab the phone and start replying to the blackmailer. Say: "I'm glad you told me. You are not in trouble. The person doing this is the criminal, and we will handle it together." Then do the steps with them: no payment, screenshots, report, 1930.

Then watch the days after, when shame can hit harder than the threat. If your child stops eating or sleeping, pulls away, or says anything about not wanting to live, stay close and call Tele-MANAS on 14416, the Health Ministry's free, round-the-clock helpline [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Adults being blackmailed can call too; the steps are the same at any age.
sextortion-what-to-do-step-by-step.hg:
Socho, Lucknow ka ek 16 saal ka ladka hai. Ek friendly naya follower raat ko chat shuru karta hai, baat jaldi flirty ho jaati hai, ek photo exchange hoti hai, aur ghante bhar mein sab palat jaata hai: uski photo wapas aati hai, saath mein uske followers aur family ki list, paison ki demand aur ek deadline. Financial sextortion aksar aise hi hota hai. Iska main target 13 se 17 saal ke ladke hote hain jinhe lagta hai ki woh kisi young woman se baat kar rahe hain, aur pehle message se dhamki tak pahunchne mein kuch minute se kuch ghante lagte hain [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]].

Duniya bhar mein yeh ab bachchon ke against mass crime ban chuka hai. US ki child-protection clearinghouse NCMEC ko financially motivated sextortion ki 2022 mein 10,000 se zyada reports mili, 2023 mein 28,000 se zyada, 2024 mein 36,000 se zyada aur 2025 mein 50,000 se zyada, yaani roz average 137 [[ncmec-sextortion-data-2026]]. 2023 ke ek Snap survey mein India samet chhe deshon ke 6,000 se zyada teens aur young adults mein se 65% ne kaha ki unhe ya unke friends ko target kiya gaya tha [[weprotect-snap-sextortion-research-2023]].

Panic blackmailer ka hathiyaar hai; deadline isliye hoti hai ki tum sochne se pehle kuch kar baitho. Pay karne se baat khatam kyun nahi hoti, yeh humare myth-check mein hai. Yeh to-do list hai, aur general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Pehle kuch minute: ruko, pay mat karo, delete mat karo

**Reply karna band karo.** Har request, sorry ya argument blackmailer ko batata hai ki tum dare hue ho aur abhi bhi sun rahe ho. Baaton se tum isse nahi nikal sakte, aur tum use koi jawab dene ke liye bound nahi ho.

**Pay mat karo**, time khareedne ke liye thoda sa bhi nahi. Paisa milte hi use pata chal jaata hai ki pressure kaam karta hai. WeProtect jis research ko cite karta hai, uske hisaab se payment demand ignore karne wale zyada tar logon ki images baad mein share nahi hui [[weprotect-web-of-deceit-2024]]. Yeh guarantee nahi hai, par dhamki aksar asli nateeje se badi hoti hai.

**Abhi kuch bhi delete mat karo.** Chat ya account mitana escape jaisa lagta hai, par isse evidence mit jaata hai aur blackmailer ke paas padi copy pe koi asar nahi hota. Shanti chahiye toh chat mute ya archive kar do.

## Evidence: kiska screenshot lo, kya save karo

Kisi ko bhi block karne se pehle inke screenshots lo:

- profile page, username ya handle ke saath (display name badla ja sakta hai), aur profile ka link copy kar lo;
- poori chat, dhamkiyon aur deadline samet;
- har payment demand: UPI ID, QR code, bank account ya phone number;
- tumhare friends ya family ki woh list jo dhamki ke taur pe bheji gayi;
- har message ki date aur time, aur jin numbers se call aaye.

Intimate photo ka screenshot mat lo, use save ya forward bhi mat karo, "kya hua yeh dikhane ke liye" bhi nahi. Blackmailer ki pehchaan dhamkiyon, usernames aur payment details se hoti hai. Screenshots aisi jagah rakho jise sirf tum khol sako.

## Report karo: platform, 1930 aur police

Pehle platform: account ko blackmail, sextortion ya nudity ke liye report karo, phir block karo. Agar kuch post ho chuka hai, toh 20 February 2026 se laagu rule ke under India mein platforms ko complaint ke do ghante ke andar nude, sexual ya morphed images hatani hoti hain [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]].

Phir crime report karo. National cyber crime helpline 1930 pe call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in pe complaint file karo, jise Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) chalata hai [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]]; yeh portal khaas taur pe women aur children ke against crimes ko dhyaan mein rakhkar banaya gaya tha [[pib-mha-i4c-launch-2020]]. Acknowledgement number sambhaal ke rakho. Agar pay kar chuke ho, toh woh bhi batao aur transaction details do.

Tum kisi bhi police station bhi ja sakte ho, behtar hai kisi adult ke saath. Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ke Section 173 ke under police ko cognizable offence ki complaint record karni hogi, chahe crime kahin bhi hua ho (Zero FIR). Complaint electronically bhi di ja sakti hai agar tum teen din ke andar sign kar do, aur FIR ki copy tumhe free milegi [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Ek warning: kabhi-kabhi blackmail ke baad aise logon ke calls aate hain jo khud ko police batate hain [[bhaskar-alwar-sextortion-2021]], aur "case band karne" ke liye paise maangte hain. Video-call racket pe humari investigation isi second wave ke baare mein batati hai. Asli police UPI pe case settle nahi karti; phone kaato aur apne local police station ka number khud dhoondh ke call karo.

## Agar images 18 se kam age mein li gayi thi: Take It Down

Agar photo ya video tab ka hai jab tum 18 se chhote the, toh NCMEC ka Take It Down use participating platforms se hatwane aur dobara upload hone se rokne mein help kar sakta hai. Yeh free aur anonymous hai, Hindi mein bhi hai, aur kabhi image nahi maangta: yeh image ka ek digital fingerprint (hash) banata hai aur sirf wahi bhejta hai [[ncmec-take-it-down]]. 2025 ke end tak yeh 36 languages mein tha, aur US ke baad sabse zyada visitors India se aaye [[ncmec-cybertipline-data-2025]].

Kuch post hone se pehle bhi tum ise use kar sakte ho. Yeh sirf un public ya unencrypted platforms pe kaam karta hai jo isse jude hain, encrypted private chats ke andar nahi. 18 ya usse zyada age mein li gayi images ke liye StopNCII.org yahi kaam karta hai [[swgfl-stopncii-2-million-2025]].

## Parent ko batana, aur parent ko kya kehna chahiye

Aaj hi ek adult ko batao: mummy-papa, koi bada cousin, koi teacher. "Kisi ko bataya toh post kar dunga" blackmailer ki sabse important line hai, kyunki batana hi use haraata hai. Aur bachche batate bhi hain: NCMEC ko public se mili jin sextortion reports mein rishta pata tha, unme se 94% khud bachche ya unke parent ne ki thi, aur zyada tar bachchon ne khud [[ncmec-sextortion-data-2026]].

Parents, aapka pehla ek minute decide karta hai ki bachcha aage kabhi koi problem aapke paas layega ya nahi. Chillaiye mat. "Bheji hi kyun?" mat poochiye. Phone cheen kar blackmailer ko reply karna shuru mat kijiye. Kahiye: "Achha kiya jo tumne bataya. Tum kisi trouble mein nahi ho. Criminal woh hai jo yeh kar raha hai, aur hum milkar handle karenge." Phir yeh steps bachche ke saath kijiye: koi payment nahi, screenshots, report, 1930.

Phir agle kuch din dhyaan rakhiye, jab sharam dhamki se bhi zyada bhaari pad sakti hai. Agar bachcha khana-sona chhod de, sabse kat jaaye, ya jeene ka mann na hone jaisi koi baat kahe, toh uske paas rahiye aur Tele-MANAS ko 14416 pe call kijiye, jo Health Ministry ki free, din-raat chalne wali helpline hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Blackmail jhel rahe adults bhi call kar sakte hain; steps har age mein same hain.

spot-and-report-human-trafficking-fast.en:
The trafficking story most families fear has a stranger, a van and a child snatched off the street. But trafficking can just as easily begin with an offer: a neighbour's relative with a job in the city, a groom's family in a hurry, an "agent" who pays for the train ticket. In 2024, 6,018 people were recorded as trafficked in India, 2,297 of them children, and that counts only cases that reached Anti-Human Trafficking Units [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. What follows is general information, not legal advice.

## The offer that is too good: warning signs

Of 5,839 trafficking victims rescued in 2024, 2,347 (40%) had been trafficked for sexual exploitation for prostitution, 1,493 (26%) for forced labour, 105 for domestic servitude and 98 for forced marriage [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Many of these purposes can hide behind something a family might welcome: work, a salary, a wedding. Boys are targets too: of the 2,297 trafficked children, 1,384 were boys and 913 were girls [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Red flags, whoever makes the offer:

- **Hurry.** A real employer or a real family can wait while you check.
- **Vagueness.** No written offer, no address you can verify, nobody to speak to who has done the job.
- **Money that becomes debt.** A ticket, a "registration fee" or an advance to your parents that you are later told to work off.
- **Your ID or phone "kept safe"** by someone else.
- **Secrecy.** "Don't tell your family yet", or an online friend who wants you to travel alone to meet them.
- **A fast marriage from far away,** through a broker, with money offered to your parents.

Before anyone travels, keep your own documents and leave the agent's name, number and photo with someone at home.

## Someone has gone missing: the first hours

Imagine a family in Malda. A neighbour's relative found their 17-year-old daughter "hotel work" in Mumbai, and her phone has been off since the train left. The parents hesitate: they agreed to the job, and they took an advance. That hesitation helps only the trafficker.

In 2024, 98,375 children were reported missing in India, 75,603 of them girls. Police traced 98,826 missing children that year, some of them missing since earlier years, yet 48,349 were still untraced when it ended [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The data does not say how many were trafficked. But in the first hours a phone may still be on and the journey unfinished, so every hour of delay matters.

There is no waiting period. Under a 2013 Supreme Court direction, a missing-child complaint must be registered as an FIR, with an initial presumption of abduction or trafficking [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. If you suspect an adult has been trafficked, any police station must record that information, wherever the offence took place, and give you a free copy of the FIR [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Take with you:

- a recent photo, their age and what they were wearing;
- when and where they were last seen or heard from, and the train or bus if you know it;
- every name and number linked to the offer: the agent, the "friend", the agency, the groom's family;
- screenshots of chats and advertisements, call logs and any payments. Delete nothing.

## Who to call: 112, 1098, police and Anti-Human Trafficking Units

- **112** is the emergency number [[mha-erss]]. Use it for anyone in danger now, including yourself, if you are the one being held.
- **1098,** the Child Helpline, is for anyone under 18. It runs 24x7 and is integrated with 112. In March 2023 it covered 568 districts, 135 railway stations and 11 bus stands [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].
- **The nearest police station** registers the FIR. An officer who fails to record an FIR about trafficking commits an offence under Section 199 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), punishable with 6 months to 2 years' rigorous imprisonment [[indiacode-bns-2023]].
- **Anti-Human Trafficking Units (AHTUs)** are specialised police units. The Nirbhaya Fund had supported 827 of them by March 2025 [[pib-wcd-nirbhaya-fund-2025]]. Ask the station to involve the district AHTU, especially if the person has been taken to another state, and note the investigating officer's number.

## What the law says: consent is no defence for traffickers

Under Section 143 of the BNS, trafficking a person for exploitation, including sexual exploitation, carries 7 to 10 years' rigorous imprisonment, at least 10 years when the victim is a child, and imprisonment for the rest of natural life for a police officer or public servant involved. The section says the victim's consent is immaterial. Under Section 144, knowingly sexually exploiting a trafficked child carries 5 to 10 years, and a trafficked adult 3 to 7 years [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

So "she went on her own", "he signed a contract" and "the parents took money" are not defences. Nor are they reasons for a police officer to turn you away.

Convictions are rare. Of 586 trafficking trials completed in 2024 in cases reported to Anti-Human Trafficking Units, 43 ended in a conviction, a rate of 7.3% [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. That is a reason to report early and keep every piece of evidence. Finding the person depends on the first complaint, whatever happens at trial.

> The law does not ask whether a trafficked person agreed to go. Neither should the family.

## After rescue: helping without blaming

A person who comes back may have been deceived, controlled and threatened. They may be silent, angry, or insist they went willingly. Do not ask "why did you go?" or "why didn't you run?". The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook on gender stereotypes replaces "child prostitute" with "child who has been trafficked" [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. Apply that at home: this is the victim of a crime, not the family's shame.

- **Health first.** Any hospital, public or private, must treat a survivor of rape or a POCSO offence immediately and free of cost [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Ask about HIV and STI tests; HIV PEP needs urgent assessment and must start as soon as possible, no later than 72 hours after exposure [[who-pep]].
- **Protect identity.** No name or photo in WhatsApp groups, no "safely home" posts.
- **No quick marriage** to "settle" things.
- **Mental health.** Tele-MANAS on 14416 is free and runs round the clock [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].
- **Compensation and a lawyer.** Every state must run a victim compensation scheme, and a victim can apply to the District Legal Services Authority even if the offender is never traced [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Its legal aid is free [[nalsa]].

Report fast, with names and numbers. When someone comes home, meet them with a doctor and a lawyer, not with questions about why they left.
spot-and-report-human-trafficking-fast.hg:
Zyada tar families jis trafficking se darti hain, uski kahani mein ek ajnabi hota hai, ek van hoti hai, aur sadak se uthaya gaya bachcha. Lekin trafficking utni hi aasani se ek offer se bhi shuru ho sakti hai: padosi ka rishtedaar jo sheher mein job dila raha hai, ladke wale jinhe shaadi ki bahut jaldi hai, ya ek "agent" jo train ka ticket khud kharid deta hai. 2024 mein India mein 6,018 logon ko trafficked record kiya gaya, jinmein 2,297 bachche the. Aur yeh ginti sirf un cases ki hai jo Anti-Human Trafficking Units tak pahunche [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Aage jo likha hai woh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Offer jo kuch zyada hi achha hai: warning signs

2024 mein rescue hue 5,839 trafficking victims mein se 2,347 (40%) ko prostitution ke liye sexual exploitation ke maqsad se traffic kiya gaya tha, 1,493 (26%) ko forced labour ke liye, 105 ko domestic servitude ke liye aur 98 ko forced marriage ke liye [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Inmein se kai maqsad aisi cheez ke peeche chhupe ho sakte hain jise family khushi se haan keh de: kaam, salary, shaadi. Ladke bhi target hote hain: 2,297 trafficked bachchon mein 1,384 ladke the aur 913 ladkiyan [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Offer koi bhi de, yeh red flags hain:

- **Jaldbaazi.** Asli employer ya asli rishta itna intezaar kar sakta hai ki aap check kar lein.
- **Gol-mol baatein.** Na likhit offer, na aisa address jo verify ho sake, na koi aisa insaan jisne wahan kaam kiya ho aur jisse aap baat kar sakein.
- **Paisa jo baad mein karz ban jaata hai.** Ticket, "registration fee" ya maa-baap ko diya gaya advance, jise baad mein kaam karke chukane ko kaha jaata hai.
- **Aapka ID ya phone** koi aur "sambhaal kar" rakhta hai.
- **Secrecy.** "Abhi ghar par mat batana", ya koi online dost jo chahta hai ki aap akele usse milne aayein.
- **Door ki, jaldbaazi wali shaadi,** kisi dalal ke through, jismein aapke maa-baap ko paise offer kiye jaate hain.

Kisi ke nikalne se pehle: documents apne paas rakhiye, aur agent ka naam, number aur photo ghar par kisi ke paas chhod kar jaiye.

## Koi gayab ho gaya hai: pehle kuch ghante

Sochiye, Malda ki ek family hai. Padosi ke ek rishtedaar ne unki 17 saal ki beti ke liye Mumbai mein "hotel ka kaam" dhoondha, aur train chhootne ke baad se uska phone band hai. Maa-baap hichkichate hain: job ke liye haan unhone hi kaha tha, aur advance bhi liya tha. Is hichkichahat ka fayda sirf trafficker ko milta hai.

2024 mein India mein 98,375 bachche missing report hue, jinmein 75,603 ladkiyan thin. Us saal police ne 98,826 missing bachchon ko dhoondh nikala, jinmein kuch pichhle saalon se gayab the. Phir bhi saal ke end mein 48,349 bachchon ka pata nahi chala tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Data yeh nahi batata ki inmein se kitne traffic hue. Lekin pehle kuch ghanton mein phone shayad abhi on ho aur safar poora na hua ho, isliye der ka har ghanta maayne rakhta hai.

Koi waiting period nahi hai. Supreme Court ke 2013 ke ek direction ke mutabik, missing bachche ki complaint FIR ke roop mein darj honi chahiye, aur shuru mein yahi maana jayega ki bachche ka abduction ya trafficking hui hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Agar aapko shak hai ki kisi adult ko traffic kiya gaya hai, toh koi bhi police station yeh information record karega, offence chahe kahin bhi hua ho, aur aapko FIR ki copy free milegi [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Saath le jaiye:

- recent photo, umar, aur unhone kya pehna tha;
- unhe aakhri baar kab aur kahan dekha ya suna gaya, aur pata ho toh kaun-si train ya bus;
- offer se juda har naam aur number: agent, woh "dost", agency, ladke wale;
- chats aur ads ke screenshots, call logs aur jo bhi payment hui. Kuch bhi delete mat kijiye.

## Kise call karein: 112, 1098, police aur Anti-Human Trafficking Units

- **112** emergency number hai [[mha-erss]]. Jo bhi abhi khatre mein hai uske liye call kijiye. Apne liye bhi, agar aap hi woh insaan hain jise rok kar rakha gaya hai.
- **1098,** yaani Child Helpline, 18 saal se kam umar ke har bachche ke liye hai. Yeh 24x7 chalti hai aur 112 se judi hai. March 2023 mein yeh 568 districts, 135 railway stations aur 11 bus stands par chal rahi thi [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].
- **Nazdeeki police station** FIR darj karta hai. Jo officer trafficking ki FIR record nahi karta, woh Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke Section 199 ke tahat offence karta hai, jiski saza 6 mahine se 2 saal tak ki rigorous imprisonment hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].
- **Anti-Human Trafficking Units (AHTUs)** police ki specialised units hain. March 2025 tak Nirbhaya Fund se aisi 827 units ko support mil chuka tha [[pib-wcd-nirbhaya-fund-2025]]. Station se kahiye ki district ki AHTU ko case mein shaamil kare, khaas kar tab jab insaan ko doosre state le jaya gaya ho. Investigating officer ka number bhi note kar lijiye.

## Law kya kehta hai: traffickers ke liye consent koi bachaav nahi

BNS ke Section 143 ke tahat, kisi insaan ko exploitation ke liye traffic karne par, jismein sexual exploitation bhi shaamil hai, 7 se 10 saal ki rigorous imprisonment hai. Victim bachcha ho toh kam se kam 10 saal, aur agar koi police officer ya public servant shaamil ho toh baaki poori zindagi ki qaid. Yahi section kehta hai ki victim ki consent se koi farq nahi padta. Section 144 ke tahat, jo jaante-boojhte kisi trafficked bachche ka sexual exploitation kare use 5 se 10 saal, aur trafficked adult ka kare toh 3 se 7 saal ki saza hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Yaani "woh apni marzi se gayi thi", "usne contract sign kiya tha" ya "maa-baap ne paise liye the" koi bachaav nahi hai. Na hi yeh police officer ke liye aapko lauta dene ki wajah hai.

Conviction kam hi hoti hai. Anti-Human Trafficking Units tak pahunche cases mein, 2024 mein poore hue 586 trafficking trials mein se 43 mein conviction hui, yaani rate 7.3% [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Isiliye jaldi report karna aur har saboot sambhaal kar rakhna zaroori hai. Trial mein aage jo bhi ho, insaan ko dhoondhna pehli complaint par hi tika hota hai.

> Law yeh nahi poochta ki trafficked insaan jaane ko raazi tha ya nahi. Family ko bhi nahi poochna chahiye.

## Rescue ke baad: bina blame kiye saath dena

Jo log laut kar aate hain, unhe shayad dhokha diya gaya ho, control mein rakha gaya ho aur dhamkaya gaya ho. Woh chup reh sakte hain, gusse mein ho sakte hain, ya zid kar sakte hain ki woh apni marzi se gaye the. "Gaye hi kyun the?" ya "bhaage kyun nahi?" mat poochiye. Supreme Court ki gender stereotypes wali 2023 ki handbook "child prostitute" ki jagah "child who has been trafficked" likhne ko kehti hai [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. Ghar mein bhi yahi soch rakhiye: yeh ek crime ka victim hai, family ki badnaami nahi.

- **Pehle health.** Rape ya POCSO offence ke survivor ka ilaaj har hospital ko, sarkari ho ya private, turant aur free karna hota hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. HIV aur STI tests ke baare mein poochiye. HIV PEP ke liye turant doctor ko dikhaiye: ise jitni jaldi ho sake shuru karna hota hai, aur exposure ke 72 ghante ke baad nahi [[who-pep]].
- **Pehchaan chhupaiye.** WhatsApp groups mein naam ya photo nahi, "sahi-salamat ghar aa gaye" jaise posts bhi nahi.
- **Maamla "settle" karne ke liye** jaldi mein shaadi nahi.
- **Mental health.** Tele-MANAS 14416 free hai aur din-raat chalti hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].
- **Compensation aur lawyer.** Har state ko victim compensation scheme chalani hoti hai, aur offender ka kabhi pata na chale tab bhi victim District Legal Services Authority mein apply kar sakta hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Wahan legal aid free hai [[nalsa]].

Jaldi report kijiye, naam aur number ke saath. Aur jab koi ghar laute, toh doctor aur lawyer ke saath miliye, is sawaal ke saath nahi ki woh gaye kyun the.

stop-child-marriage-before-wedding.en:
One in five Indian women aged 20 to 24 surveyed in 2023-24 (20.1%) had been married before she turned 18. In West Bengal it was 36.4%, in Bihar 34.6% [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]]. Every one of those weddings had a date, a venue and guests. Somebody knew in advance: a sibling, a classmate, a teacher looking at an empty bench.

This guide is for that somebody, and for the girl herself. It applies equally to a boy being married before 21. It is general information, not legal advice.

## Why the days before the wedding matter most

Under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006, a marriage is a child marriage if the bride is under 18 or the groom under 21 [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. Performing, promoting or permitting one is a crime. But once the ceremony is over, the marriage itself usually stands. It is "voidable": only the person who was married as a child can ask a court to cancel it [[indiacode-pcma-2006]].

So the wedding day shifts the burden. Before it, stopping the marriage is the state's job. After it, undoing the marriage is hers: a teenager in her in-laws' house who must find a lawyer and a district court.

In October 2024 the Supreme Court issued guidelines that put "prevention before protection and protection before penalisation" [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. The states' own figures show why. Over three years Telangana reported 4,440 child marriage cases and filed 149 FIRs. Maharashtra said it prevented 2,043 marriages and registered 178 FIRs [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. Read honestly, the numbers say this: told in time, officials do stop weddings; punishment afterwards is rare. The win on offer is the one before the wedding.

## Who to call: 1098, 112 and the Child Marriage Prohibition Officer

**1098, the Child Helpline.** It runs 24x7, is operated by state and district child-protection staff and is linked to the 112 emergency system [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]. Anyone can call: the child, a brother or sister, a friend, a neighbour, a teacher.

**112.** Use the emergency number if the wedding is today or tonight, or if the child is being locked in, beaten or taken away [[mha-erss]]. Offences under the Act are cognisable and non-bailable, so police can act without a warrant [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]].

**The Child Marriage Prohibition Officer.** In October 2024 the Supreme Court directed states to appoint one in every district, with no other duties, and to publish their quarterly reports online [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. Whether your district has complied, we could not verify. Ask the helpline or the Collector's office for the officer's number. If nobody has one, do not wait: 1098 and the police are enough to start.

## What to say, and what happens next

Give facts an official can act on in one visit:

- the child's name, age, and school or class;
- a parent's name and the full address;
- the wedding date and venue, and the other family's village or town;
- any proof of age, such as a school record or birth certificate;
- whether it is safe to call you back.

You can ask that your name not be shared with the family.

Imagine a 16-year-old in Class 11 who overhears that her wedding is fixed for next month. She can call 1098 herself from any phone, or ask a teacher she trusts to call.

What follows varies by district. Child-protection staff or police may visit the home, check the child's age against school or birth records, and tell both families the wedding is illegal.

Few such cases go further. Andhra Pradesh told the Supreme Court of about 3,400 cases over three years, most of them marriages that were stopped, and 10 FIRs [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. That is prevention working as designed. It also means the family faces little consequence and may try again: an earlier date, a relative's village, a small ceremony at night. Stay in touch with her. If she stops coming to school or is sent away, call again and say it is a second attempt. If she is not safe at home, say so, and ask what protection can be arranged for her.

## Injunctions: how a magistrate can stop the wedding

The strongest tool is a court order. A magistrate can issue an injunction prohibiting a planned child marriage [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. In 2024 the Supreme Court told magistrates to use that power on their own, especially around "auspicious days" known for mass weddings [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. If the wedding is part of a mass ceremony, say so when you call.

A child marriage held in breach of an injunction is void, not merely voidable [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. The girl does not have to go to court later to undo it.

Some people may hold back because they fear sending their own parents to jail. The maximum for an adult groom, and for whoever performs, promotes or permits the marriage, is two years' rigorous imprisonment and a fine of Rs 1 lakh, with no minimum sentence, and women cannot be sent to prison for promoting or permitting one [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. A wedding stopped in time usually ends with no case at all.

## Married as a child: the two-year window to annul

If the wedding has already happened, the law leaves one door open. The person who was a child at the time can ask a district court to annul the marriage at any time until two years after reaching adulthood [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. Adulthood is 18, so the window closes at 20.

A marriage is void from the start if the child was enticed away from her guardian, forced or deceived into it, or sold [[indiacode-pcma-2006]].

Marriage does not make sex with a girl under 18 legal: the Supreme Court held in 2017 that sex with a minor wife is rape [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. She does not need money to start: she can ask the District Legal Services Authority for a free lawyer [[nalsa]].

The law gives her until 20. It gives everyone around her until the wedding day. Use the earlier deadline.
stop-child-marriage-before-wedding.hg:
2023-24 ke survey mein 20 se 24 saal ki har paanch mein se ek Indian woman (20.1%) ki shaadi 18 ki hone se pehle ho chuki thi. West Bengal mein yeh 36.4% tha, Bihar mein 34.6% [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]]. In mein se har shaadi ki ek date thi, ek venue tha, mehmaan the. Kisi na kisi ko pehle se pata tha: koi bhai ya behen, koi classmate, koi teacher jise class mein khaali bench dikh rahi thi.

Yeh guide usi "kisi" ke liye hai, aur khud us ladki ke liye bhi. Yeh us ladke pe bhi utni hi laagu hoti hai jiski shaadi 21 se pehle karwayi ja rahi hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Shaadi se pehle ke din sabse zyada kyun maayne rakhte hain

Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 ke hisaab se agar dulhan 18 se kam ya dulha 21 se kam umar ka hai, toh woh shaadi child marriage hai [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. Aisi shaadi karwana, uska badhawa dena ya use hone dena crime hai. Lekin ek baar rasm ho gayi, toh shaadi khud aam taur pe bani rehti hai. Woh "voidable" hai: sirf wahi insaan court se use cancel karwa sakta hai jiski shaadi bachpan mein hui thi [[indiacode-pcma-2006]].

Yaani shaadi ka din bojh ko ek kandhe se doosre pe daal deta hai. Us din se pehle shaadi rokna state ka kaam hai. Us din ke baad shaadi todna us ladki ka kaam ban jaata hai: ek teenager, jo sasural mein reh rahi hai aur jise khud lawyer aur district court dhoondhna hai.

October 2024 mein Supreme Court ne aisi guidelines di jo "prevention before protection and protection before penalisation" ko aage rakhti hain, yaani pehle rokna, phir bachana, phir saza [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. States ke apne figures batate hain kyun. Teen saal mein Telangana ne child marriage ke 4,440 cases report kiye aur 149 FIRs file ki. Maharashtra ne kaha ki usne 2,043 shaadiyan roki aur 178 FIRs register ki [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. Imaandaari se padhein toh yeh numbers yeh kehte hain: time pe bataya jaaye toh officials shaadi rok dete hain; baad mein saza kam hi hoti hai. Jo jeet sach mein mil sakti hai, woh shaadi se pehle wali hai.

## Kise call karein: 1098, 112 aur Child Marriage Prohibition Officer

**1098, Child Helpline.** Yeh 24x7 chalti hai, ise state aur district ka child-protection staff chalata hai, aur yeh 112 emergency system se judi hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]. Koi bhi call kar sakta hai: khud bachcha, bhai ya behen, dost, padosi, teacher.

**112.** Agar shaadi aaj ya aaj raat hai, ya bachche ko band kiya ja raha hai, maara ja raha hai ya kahin le jaaya ja raha hai, toh emergency number pe call kijiye [[mha-erss]]. Is Act ke offences cognisable aur non-bailable hain, isliye police bina warrant ke action le sakti hai [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]].

**Child Marriage Prohibition Officer.** October 2024 mein Supreme Court ne states ko kaha ki har district mein aisa ek officer appoint karein jiske paas koi aur duty na ho, aur unki quarterly reports online daalein [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. Aapke district ne yeh kiya hai ya nahi, yeh hum verify nahi kar sake. Helpline ya Collector office se officer ka number poochhiye. Agar kisi ke paas number nahi hai, toh rukiye mat: shuruaat ke liye 1098 aur police kaafi hain.

## Kya bolna hai, aur uske baad kya hota hai

Aisi jaankari dijiye jis pe official ek hi visit mein action le sake:

- bachche ka naam, umar, aur school ya class;
- maa ya pita ka naam aur poora address;
- shaadi ki date aur venue, aur doosri family ka gaon ya sheher;
- umar ka koi bhi saboot, jaise school record ya birth certificate;
- aapko wapas call karna safe hai ya nahi.

Aap keh sakte hain ki aapka naam family ko na bataya jaaye.

Sochiye, Class 11 mein padhne wali ek 16 saal ki ladki sun leti hai ki uski shaadi agle mahine fix ho gayi hai. Woh kisi bhi phone se khud 1098 pe call kar sakti hai, ya kisi aise teacher se call karne ko keh sakti hai jis pe use bharosa ho.

Aage kya hota hai, yeh har district mein alag hai. Child-protection staff ya police ghar aa sakti hai, school ya birth records se bachche ki umar check kar sakti hai, aur dono families ko bata sakti hai ki yeh shaadi illegal hai.

Aise kam hi cases aage badhte hain. Andhra Pradesh ne Supreme Court ko teen saal mein lagbhag 3,400 cases bataye, jin mein se zyada tar roki gayi shaadiyan thi, aur 10 FIRs [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. Yeh prevention hai, aur system isi tarah design hua hai. Lekin iska matlab yeh bhi hai ki family ko koi khaas nateeja nahi bhugatna padta aur woh dobara koshish kar sakti hai: pehle ki date, kisi rishtedaar ka gaon, raat mein chhoti si rasm. Us ladki se contact mein rahiye. Agar woh school aana band kar de ya use kahin bhej diya jaaye, toh dobara call kijiye aur bataiye ki yeh doosri koshish hai. Agar woh ghar mein safe nahi hai, toh yeh bhi bataiye, aur poochhiye ki uski hifaazat ke liye kya intezaam ho sakta hai.

## Injunction: magistrate shaadi kaise rok sakte hain

Sabse mazboot tool court ka order hai. Magistrate plan ki gayi child marriage pe rok lagane wala injunction de sakte hain [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. 2024 mein Supreme Court ne magistrates se kaha ki woh yeh power khud se istemaal karein, khaas taur pe un "auspicious days" ke aas-paas jo mass weddings ke liye jaane jaate hain [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. Agar shaadi kisi mass ceremony ka hissa hai, toh call pe yeh zaroor bataiye.

Injunction todkar hui child marriage void hoti hai, sirf voidable nahi [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. Ladki ko baad mein use todne ke liye court nahi jaana padta.

Kuch log shayad isliye chup reh jaate hain ki unhe dar hota hai ki unke apne maa-baap jail chale jaayenge. Adult dulhe ke liye, aur shaadi karwane, uska badhawa dene ya use hone dene wale ke liye maximum saza do saal ki rigorous imprisonment aur Rs 1 lakh ka fine hai, koi minimum saza nahi hai, aur shaadi ka badhawa dene ya use hone dene ke liye women ko jail nahi bheja ja sakta [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. Jo shaadi time pe ruk jaati hai, us mein aam taur pe koi case banta hi nahi.

## Bachpan mein shaadi ho chuki hai: annul karwane ki do saal ki window

Agar shaadi ho chuki hai, tab bhi law ek darwaaza khula rakhta hai. Jo insaan shaadi ke waqt child tha, woh adult hone ke do saal baad tak kabhi bhi district court se shaadi annul karwane ki maang kar sakta hai [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. Adult hone ki umar 18 hai, isliye yeh window 20 pe band ho jaati hai.

Agar bachche ko uske guardian se behla-phuslakar le jaaya gaya, zabardasti ya dhokhe se shaadi karwayi gayi, ya use becha gaya, toh shaadi shuru se hi void hai [[indiacode-pcma-2006]].

Shaadi ho jaane se 18 se kam umar ki ladki ke saath sex legal nahi ho jaata: Supreme Court ne 2017 mein kaha ki minor wife ke saath sex rape hai [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. Shuru karne ke liye use paise ki zaroorat nahi hai: woh District Legal Services Authority se free lawyer maang sakti hai [[nalsa]].

Law us ladki ko 20 ki umar tak ka time deta hai. Uske aas-paas ke sab logon ko woh shaadi ke din tak ka time deta hai. Pehle wali deadline ka istemaal kijiye.

support-a-survivor-who-tells-you.en:
Imagine your closest friend calls at midnight: "Something happened at the party. I don't know who else to tell." In NFHS-5, 77% of women who had faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone. Of those who did seek help, 61% turned to their own family and only 6% went to the police [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. If someone tells you, you are among the few they trusted. What you say next can decide whether they ever tell anyone else.

## The first five minutes: what to say and what never to say

Your job is not to investigate. It is to make them feel believed and safe. Say:

- "I believe you."
- "It is not your fault."
- "Thank you for telling me. You don't have to tell me everything."
- "What do you need right now?"

Do not ask why they were there, what they were wearing, whether they had been drinking, why they did not scream or why they waited. Each question sounds like doubt, and doubt is what keeps survivors silent. Do not touch them without asking, and do not take over: the assault took control away from them, and help should give it back.

Use the words they use: the Supreme Court's 2023 handbook on gender stereotypes says both "survivor" and "victim" are correct and the person's preference should be respected [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. Then ask: are you safe tonight, and do you need a doctor?

## When you know the accused

In 96.8% of rape cases registered in India in 2024, 28,597 of 29,536, the accused was someone the survivor knew, most often a friend, partner, neighbour or family friend [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. So the name you hear may be your cousin, your friend's boyfriend, your colleague or your hostel-mate; our breakdown of who the accused were goes deeper.

This is where listening gets hardest. You may want to "hear both sides". That is a court's job, and asking for it now tells the survivor you doubt them. Do not confront or warn the accused: it can put the survivor in danger and give him time to delete messages. Do not arrange a "compromise" or suggest marriage. The Supreme Court's handbook says it plainly: "Marriage is not a remedy to the violence of rape" [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

Do not post about it, even to show support. Publishing a rape survivor's name, or any detail that could identify her, is a crime under Section 72 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), punishable with up to 2 years in prison, unless she authorises it in writing [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. A forward in a college WhatsApp group can travel just as far.

## Unlearn the myths: clothes, 'not fighting back', 'not crying'

The Supreme Court has already rejected many of these doubts. Its handbook calls these false stereotypes: that clothing, drinking or smoking invites sexual contact, that rapists are usually strangers, that a genuine survivor cries incessantly or never speaks to the accused again, and that a woman who delays reporting is lying [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

> "There is no 'correct' or 'appropriate' way in which a survivor or victim behaves." (Supreme Court handbook, 2023)

Not fighting back is not consent either. Section 63 of the BNS defines consent as an "unequivocal voluntary agreement" and says a woman who does not physically resist is not, for that reason alone, consenting [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Many people freeze. Someone who stays calm, keeps attending the same class or replies to the accused's messages may be coping, not consenting.

Men and transgender people are assaulted too. Believe them the same way, even though the BNS has no offence of rape against an adult man or a transgender person [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

## Practical help without taking control: hospital, FIR, One Stop Centre

Offer, don't decide. "Would it help if I came with you?" works better than "We're going to the police."

- **Hospital.** Every hospital, government or private, must treat a rape survivor immediately and free of cost under Section 397 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. If the assault was recent, HIV PEP should start as soon as possible and no later than 72 hours [[who-pep]], and emergency contraception works up to 5 days after [[who-ec]]. Our 72-hour plan has the details.
- **FIR.** For an adult, filing is their decision, and waiting does not make a complaint false. Any police station must take it, wherever the crime happened, or it can be filed online; a woman officer must record a woman's rape complaint, and the FIR copy is free [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].
- **One Stop Centre.** Sakhi centres bring medical, police, legal and counselling help to one place [[wcd-mission-shakti]]; 985 were operational in July 2026 [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]].

This is general information, not legal advice.

One exception changes your role. If the person who told you is under 18, the POCSO Act makes reporting a duty for anyone who knows, and failing to report can mean up to 6 months in prison [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Tell them honestly that you have to report, do it together if you can, and stay with them. Our guide to reporting child sexual abuse explains how.

## Looking after yourself as a supporter

Hearing this can leave you shaking, furious or guilty, especially if you know the accused. Those feelings are real, but they are yours to carry: do not ask the survivor to calm you down.

Talk to someone yourself, without naming the survivor. Tele-MANAS, the Health Ministry's free, round-the-clock mental health helpline, answers on 14416 [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Set limits, and help the survivor build a small circle: a One Stop Centre counsellor, one more trusted person. In the weeks after, keep checking in; do not expect them to "move on" on your schedule.

You do not have to fix what happened. You have to believe it, and stay.
support-a-survivor-who-tells-you.hg:
Socho, aadhi raat ko tumhari sabse close dost ka call aata hai: "Party mein kuch hua. Samajh nahi aa raha kise bataun." NFHS-5 mein, physical ya sexual violence jhel chuki 77% auraton ne na kabhi help maangi, na kisi ko bataya. Jinhone help maangi, unmein se 61% apni family ke paas gayin, aur police ke paas sirf 6% [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Yaani agar koi tumhe bata raha hai, toh tum un gine-chune logon mein ho jin par unhone bharosa kiya. Ab tum kya kehte ho, isi se tay ho sakta hai ki woh phir kabhi kisi aur ko batayenge ya nahi.

## Pehle paanch minute: kya kehna hai, aur kya kabhi nahi kehna

Tumhara kaam poochtaachh karna nahi hai. Tumhara kaam hai ki unhe lage ki tum un par yakeen karte ho aur woh safe hain. Yeh kaho:

- "Mujhe tumhari baat par yakeen hai."
- "Isme tumhari koi galti nahi hai."
- "Mujhe batane ke liye thank you. Sab kuch batana zaroori nahi hai."
- "Abhi tumhe kis cheez ki zaroorat hai?"

Yeh mat poocho ki woh wahan kyun gaye the, kya pehna tha, drink kiya tha ya nahi, chillaye kyun nahi, ya itni der se kyun bata rahe hain. Aisa har sawaal shak jaisa lagta hai, aur yahi shak survivors ko chup kara deta hai. Pooche bina unhe touch mat karo, aur sab kuch apne haath mein mat lo. Assault ne unse unka control chheena hai. Tumhari help ko woh control wapas dena chahiye.

Wahi words use karo jo woh khud use karte hain. Gender stereotypes par Supreme Court ki 2023 ki handbook kehti hai ki "survivor" aur "victim", dono words sahi hain, aur jo word woh insaan khud chune, usi ki respect honi chahiye [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. Phir do baatein poocho: kya aaj raat tum safe ho? Kya doctor ki zaroorat hai?

## Jab tum accused ko jaante ho

2024 mein India mein jitne rape cases darj hue, unmein se 96.8% mein accused survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha: 29,536 mein se 28,597 cases. Zyada tar woh koi dost, partner, padosi ya family ka jaankar tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Isliye jo naam tum sunoge, woh tumhare cousin ka ho sakta hai, tumhari dost ke boyfriend ka, colleague ka, ya hostel ke kisi saathi ka. Accused kaun-kaun the, is par hamara alag article detail mein batata hai.

Yahin par sunna sabse mushkil ho jaata hai. Mann karega ki "dono side sun lein". Yeh court ka kaam hai, tumhara nahi. Abhi aisa karne ka matlab hai survivor ko jatana ki tumhe un par shak hai. Accused se mat bhido, aur use khabar bhi mat do. Isse survivor khatre mein pad sakte hain, aur accused ko messages delete karne ka time mil jaata hai. "Compromise" mat karwao, aur shaadi ki baat toh bilkul mat chhedo. Supreme Court ki handbook saaf kehti hai: "Shaadi rape ki hinsa ka ilaaj nahi hai" [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

Social media par bhi kuch mat daalo, chahe support dikhane ke liye hi kyun na ho. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke Section 72 ke tahat rape survivor ka naam, ya aisi koi bhi detail jisse uski pehchaan ho jaaye, publish karna crime hai. Isme 2 saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai, jab tak survivor khud likh kar permission na de [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. College ke WhatsApp group mein ek forward bhi utni hi door tak ja sakta hai.

## Yeh myths chhodo: kapde, 'ladi kyun nahi', 'royi kyun nahi'

Sunne wale ke mann mein jo shak uthte hain, unmein se kai ko Supreme Court pehle hi galat bata chuka hai. Uski handbook ke hisaab se yeh sab galat soch hai:

- Kapde, drinking ya smoking sexual contact ka invitation hain.
- Rapists zyada tar ajnabi hote hain.
- Sachchi survivor lagataar roti hai, ya accused se phir kabhi baat nahi karti.
- Jo aurat der se report kare, woh jhooth bol rahi hai [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

> "There is no 'correct' or 'appropriate' way in which a survivor or victim behaves." (Supreme Court handbook, 2023)

Resist na karna bhi consent nahi hai. BNS ka Section 63 consent ko "unequivocal voluntary agreement", yaani saaf aur apni marzi se di gayi haan, kehta hai. Yeh bhi kehta hai ki agar aurat ne physically resist nahi kiya, toh sirf is wajah se uski haan nahi maani jayegi [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Bahut log us pal freeze ho jaate hain. Koi calm dikhe, usi class mein jaata rahe, ya accused ke message ka reply kar de, toh ho sakta hai woh bas kisi tarah khud ko sambhal raha ho. Iska matlab consent nahi hai.

Mard aur transgender log bhi sexual assault jhelte hain. Un par bhi waise hi yakeen karo, bhale hi BNS mein adult mard ya transgender person ke saath rape ka koi offence nahi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

## Control chheene bina help: hospital, FIR, One Stop Centre

Poocho, faisla thopo mat. "Kya main saath chaloon?" kehna, "Chalo, police ke paas chalte hain" se kahin behtar hai.

- **Hospital:** Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ke Section 397 ke tahat har hospital ko, sarkari ho ya private, rape survivor ka ilaaj turant aur free karna hoga [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Agar assault haal hi mein hua hai, toh HIV se bachane wali PEP jitni jaldi ho sake shuru honi chahiye, 72 ghante ke andar hi [[who-pep]]. Emergency contraceptive pill 5 din tak kaam karti hai [[who-ec]]. Poori jaankari hamari '72 ghante wali guide' mein hai.
- **FIR:** Adult survivor ke liye FIR karna ya na karna unka apna faisla hai, aur der se complaint karne se woh jhoothi nahi ho jaati. Koi bhi police station FIR lega, ghatna chahe kahin bhi hui ho, aur complaint online bhi bheji ja sakti hai. Aurat ki rape complaint lady officer hi record karegi, aur FIR ki copy free milegi [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].
- **One Stop Centre:** In 'Sakhi' centres mein medical, police, legal aur counselling help ek hi jagah milti hai [[wcd-mission-shakti]]. July 2026 mein poore India mein aise 985 centres chal rahe the [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]].

Yeh general jaankari hai, legal advice nahi.

Ek situation mein tumhara role badal jaata hai. Agar batane wala 18 saal se kam ka hai, toh POCSO Act ke tahat jise bhi pata ho, use report karna hi hoga. Report na karne par 6 mahine tak ki jail ho sakti hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. Unhe imaandari se batao ki tumhe report karna hoga. Ho sake toh saath milkar karo, aur unke saath bane raho. Yeh kaise karna hai, hamari guide "bachchon ke sexual abuse ko report kaise karein" mein bataya gaya hai.

## Support karne wale, apna bhi khayal rakho

Yeh sab sunkar tum kaanp sakte ho, gusse se bhar sakte ho, ya khud ko guilty feel kar sakte ho, khaas kar jab tum accused ko jaante ho. Yeh feelings real hain, par inka bojh tumhe uthana hai, survivor ko nahi. Unse yeh ummeed mat rakho ki woh tumhe shaant karein.

Khud bhi kisi se baat karo, par survivor ka naam liye bina. Tele-MANAS Health Ministry ki free mental health helpline hai jo din-raat chalti hai, number hai 14416 [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Apni limits bhi set karo, aur survivor ke aas-paas bharose ka ek chhota circle banane mein help karo: One Stop Centre ka koi counsellor, aur ek aur bharosemand insaan. Aane wale hafton mein haal-chaal poochte raho. Yeh ummeed mat rakho ki woh tumhare hisaab se jaldi "move on" kar lein.

Jo hua, use theek karna tumhara kaam nahi hai. Tumhara kaam hai yakeen karna, aur saath bane rehna.

survivor-identity-published-remove-repor.en:
Consider a 19-year-old in Indore who reported a rape on Monday. By Wednesday a local news portal has carried her college, her father's shop and a blurred photo of her lane. By Friday the link is in her hostel WhatsApp group. Nobody printed her name. Everybody knows.

Exposing her is a crime, separate from the rape. Disclosing a rape survivor's identity has been an offence since 25 December 1983 [[sc-nipun-saxena-2018]]. Today it is Section 72 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), punishable with up to 2 years in prison and a fine [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Yet in the first six months of the new code, July to December 2024, police across India registered just 11 cases under it [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. These are registered cases only, but the gap is plain: the law is strong and rarely invoked, so survivors and families usually have to set it in motion themselves. This is general information, not legal advice.

## What counts as 'identifying' a survivor?

Far more than a name. In Nipun Saxena v. Union of India (11 December 2018), the Supreme Court ruled that no one may publish a survivor's name in print, electronic or social media, "or even in a remote manner" disclose facts that could identify her. Its examples: giving her exam rank and state, or blurring her face while showing her relatives, neighbours or village. FIRs in rape and POCSO cases must not be put in the public domain at all [[sc-nipun-saxena-2018]].

For anyone under 18, boy or girl, Section 23 of the POCSO Act bars media reports from revealing the child's name, address, photograph, family details, school or neighbourhood [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

One gap: Section 72 covers the sexual offences in Sections 64 to 71, and the BNS has no rape offence for an adult man or a transgender person [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. The removal route below is open to everyone.

## Who is breaking the law: media, posts and forwards

Section 72 punishes "Whoever prints or publishes" [[indiacode-bns-2023]], not journalists alone. A news site, a YouTube channel, an Instagram "justice" page and a neighbour's Facebook post all fall under a bar that names print, electronic and social media [[sc-nipun-saxena-2018]]. Do not count on "I only forwarded it" as a defence: every forward puts her identity before new people.

On 18 April 2018 the Delhi High Court directed 12 media houses that had revealed the identity of the child in the Kathua case to pay Rs 10 lakh each [[thehindu-delhi-hc-kathua-media-2018]]. Under POCSO the publisher or owner is jointly liable, with 6 months to 1 year in prison, a fine, or both [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

## Getting it removed: platforms, editors and the 3-hour order

1. **Save proof first.** Screenshot the link, account name, date and time; for WhatsApp, the group name and the number that posted.
2. **Report to the platform, twice.** Use the in-app report button, then write to the platform's Grievance Officer, named on its website, saying the post identifies a survivor of a sexual offence and is unlawful under Section 72 BNS or Section 23 POCSO. Under the IT Amendment Rules, 2026, a platform must resolve a user's grievance within seven days, down from 15. For a nude, sexual or morphed image of you, the deadline is two hours from your complaint [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]].
3. **Write to the editor.** Email the editor and publisher of the news site or channel: the link, the identifying details, the section, and a demand to remove them from the story, headline and social posts.
4. **Ask for the three-hour order.** Once a court order or an authorised government notice reaches a platform, it has three hours to remove unlawful content, down from 36. A police notice counts only if it comes from an officer of at least Deputy Inspector General rank [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]], so ask in your written complaint for a takedown notice through that channel. You can also report at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930 [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]].

Removal cannot recall screenshots, but it slows the spread and proves the publisher was told.

## Filing a complaint under Section 72 BNS or Section 23 POCSO

To start a criminal case, give a written complaint at any police station and ask for an FIR under Section 72. Section 173 of the BNSS lets you report a cognizable offence at any station or electronically, and entitles you to a free copy of the FIR [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

- Name who published: the reporter and editor, the page owner, or the person who posted in the group.
- Attach the screenshots, links and your emails.
- Quote the FIR number of the original case. You do not have to describe the assault again.

If the survivor is a child, the complaint is under Section 23 POCSO. Tell the Special Court hearing the case as well, through the public prosecutor, since only that court can permit disclosure [[indiacode-pocso-2012]].

With 11 cases in six months nationwide [[ncrb-cii-2024]], many officers have never applied this section, so carry a printout. If the leak came from the station itself, or the station will not act, write to the Superintendent of Police; the District Legal Services Authority gives free legal aid [[nalsa]].

## If you want to speak publicly yourself

The ban binds everyone else, not you. Section 72 exempts publication by the survivor or with her authorisation in writing [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. An adult survivor may speak under her own name or let one journalist identify her.

If you authorise someone, do it in writing and narrowly: which outlet, which details, which story. Consent to one interview is not consent to every page that reposts it.

A child cannot waive anonymity, and neither can the parents; only the Special Court can permit it, in the child's interest [[indiacode-pocso-2012]]. A family cannot authorise naming a survivor who has died without a Sessions Judge's order [[sc-nipun-saxena-2018]]. And Section 73 punishes publishing rape-case court proceedings without the court's permission with up to 2 years [[indiacode-bns-2023]], so speak to your lawyer before posting about a hearing.

Anonymity is a shield the law hands you, not a sign that you have something to hide. Keeping it or setting it down is your decision alone.
survivor-identity-published-remove-repor.hg:
